# 계산 모델 API 목록

이 문서는 `scripts/build_model_reference.py`가 실행 가능한 입력 스키마와 직접 작성한 합성 예제로 생성한다. 입력 숫자는 설명용이며 재료 권장값이나 설계 허용값이 아니다. Python 입력은 `ModelRegistry.run(model_id, inputs, context)`, JSON 입력은 `run_json(model_id, inputs_json, context)`로 호출한다. 상세 수학과 해석 한계는 `METHODS_KO.md`를 함께 읽는다.

## `adapter.corrosion_rate_history_to_fault_tree_basic_event`

The deterministic corrosion calculation defines the reviewed condition and finite support but never supplies an event probability. The mapped event is first crossing of required thickness within the finite supplied period; only conditional first-failure-in-period probability semantics are accepted, while probability, conditioning, shared scope, Evidence and rights remain caller-owned. The output is an exchange binding for the existing FTA basic-event contract; it neither evaluates the tree nor validates the caller probability.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.corrosion_fta_binding_request.v1", "default": "matintegrity.corrosion_fta_binding_request.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `corrosion_request` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CorrosionRateThicknessHistoryRequest"}` |
| `corrosion_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Calculation"}` |
| `probability_input` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"$ref": "#/$defs/CorrosionFaultTreeProbabilityInput"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `basic_event.probability` | `1` |
| `integrity_event_basis.horizon_start_s` | `s` |
| `integrity_event_basis.horizon_end_s` | `s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_corrosion_fta_event_probability_binding`: Bind a computed finite caller-reviewed corrosion thickness history and its required-thickness condition to an existing fault-tree basic-event contract only when the caller separately supplies the event probability, semantics, conditioning, common scope, Evidence and rights boundary. Preserve both request/result digests and asset/location/clock/horizon identity; never derive or infer probability from deterministic metal loss or crossing, evaluate the fault tree, or establish event validity.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `adapter.crevice_faradaic_to_fault_tree_basic_event`

Only a computed integration.crevice_faradaic_spatial_chemistry_coupling result whose model ID, exact request digest, assessment ID and all interval endpoints match is eligible for binding. Asset, location, physical scope and clock are carried from the matching caller request; the finite event horizon is its exact time support. Probability, probability meaning, conditioning, probability scope and probability Evidence are explicit caller inputs and are never inferred from transport or Faradaic quantities. The calculation Evidence must be a model-prediction record whose digest equals the complete source Calculation digest. This module creates an existing FaultTreeBasicEvent payload; it does not assess the fault tree or qualify the underlying integrity model.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_faradaic_fta_binding.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_faradaic_fta_binding.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `integrity_request` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CreviceFaradaicSpatialChemistryRequest"}` |
| `integrity_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Calculation"}` |
| `calculation_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `probability_input` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CreviceFaradaicFaultTreeProbabilityInput"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `basic_event.probability` | `1` |
| `horizon_start_s` | `s` |
| `horizon_end_s` | `s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crevice_faradaic_fta_probability_binding`: Bind only an exact-digest computed Crevice Faradaic Calculation with every adjacent requested clock interval committed. Carry the caller request's asset, location, physical scope, clock and horizon; require caller-supplied probability semantics, conditioning, probability scope, probability Evidence, calculation Evidence pinned to the whole result, and rights boundary. Never infer probability from current or reaction extents, evaluate the tree, or qualify the event.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `adapter.fad_assessment_history_to_fault_tree_basic_event`

Only the exact computed structural.failure_assessment_history result for the supplied request is eligible; the full deterministic source calculation is recomputed and digest-compared. The event is caller-defined first passage outside the exact pinned FAD boundary during the finite source history; only the source knot interval bracket is reported. Probability, conditional_first_failure_in_period semantics, conditioning, shared probability scope, Evidence and rights boundary are explicit caller inputs; probability is never inferred from FAD margins. The output is an existing FaultTreeBasicEvent exchange payload and does not evaluate the FTA, validate probability calibration, or qualify provider mechanics or the FAD curve.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.fad_fta_binding_request.v1", "default": "matintegrity.fad_fta_binding_request.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `fad_request` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/FADAssessmentHistoryRequest"}` |
| `fad_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Calculation"}` |
| `probability_input` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/FADFaultTreeProbabilityInput"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `basic_event.probability` | `1` |
| `horizon_start_s` | `s` |
| `horizon_end_s` | `s` |
| `initial_margin` | `1` |
| `final_margin` | `1` |
| `nominal_first_outside_boundary_interval_bracket.left_time_s` | `s` |
| `nominal_first_outside_boundary_interval_bracket.right_time_s` | `s` |
| `nominal_first_outside_boundary_interval_bracket.left_margin` | `1` |
| `nominal_first_outside_boundary_interval_bracket.right_margin` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_fad_boundary_first_passage_probability_binding`: Bind a recomputed, digest-matched FAD time-history first-boundary event to the existing FTA basic-event contract using only an independent caller-supplied conditional first-failure-in-period probability, conditioning, scope, evidence and rights boundary; reject start-of-period exceedance and never infer probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `adapter.scc_crack_growth_to_fault_tree_basic_event`

Only the exact computed degradation.scc_crack_velocity_history result for the supplied request is eligible; the complete source calculation is recomputed and digest-compared. The event condition is caller-defined crack-advance limit reached within the exact finite SCC history support; the output records endpoint status and an interval bracket only. Probability and conditional_first_failure_in_period semantics, conditioning, common scope, Evidence and rights boundary are explicit caller inputs; probability is never inferred from deterministic growth. The output is an existing FaultTreeBasicEvent exchange payload and does not evaluate the FTA, validate the caller probability, or qualify the SCC growth law.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.scc_fta_binding_request.v1", "default": "matintegrity.scc_fta_binding_request.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `scc_request` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/SCCCrackVelocityHistoryRequest"}` |
| `scc_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Calculation"}` |
| `crack_advance_limit_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `limit_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `probability_input` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/SCCFaultTreeProbabilityInput"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `basic_event.probability` | `1` |
| `crack_advance_limit_m` | `m` |
| `initial_crack_advance_m` | `m` |
| `final_crack_advance_m` | `m` |
| `horizon_start_s` | `s` |
| `horizon_end_s` | `s` |
| `crossing_interval_bracket.start_time_s` | `s` |
| `crossing_interval_bracket.end_time_s` | `s` |
| `crossing_interval_bracket.left_crack_advance_m` | `m` |
| `crossing_interval_bracket.right_crack_advance_m` | `m` |
| `crossing_interval_bracket.limit_m` | `m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_scc_crack_advance_limit_probability_binding`: Bind a deterministic SCC crack-advance limit history to an existing FTA basic-event exchange contract using a separately caller-supplied finite-period first-failure probability, conditioning, evidence and rights boundary. Recompute and digest-compare the source history; do not infer probability or an exact crossing time.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `calibration.crevice_slit_hydraulic_law_parameters`

Fit only two positive global correction multipliers on the caller-declared reduced lumped slit law; each observation record is digest-pinned. Split complete independent groups before fit; holdout groups are predicted after fitting and are never included in the objective. Weighted least squares uses caller measurement standard uncertainties; covariance is local linearized covariance and is conditional on the chosen model and declared data.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_hydraulic_parameter_fit.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_hydraulic_parameter_fit.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `calibration_runs` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/HydraulicFlowObservationRun"}, "maxItems": 100, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `holdout_runs` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/HydraulicFlowObservationRun"}, "maxItems": 100, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `resistance_multiplier_bounds` | 아니오 | `{"default": [0.1, 10.0], "maxItems": 2, "minItems": 2, "prefixItems": [{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}], "type": "array"}` |
| `inertance_multiplier_bounds` | 아니오 | `{"default": [0.1, 10.0], "maxItems": 2, "minItems": 2, "prefixItems": [{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}], "type": "array"}` |
| `maximum_nfev` | 아니오 | `{"default": 2000, "maximum": 100000, "minimum": 10, "type": "integer"}` |
| `same_reduced_law_family_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `calibration_holdout_independence_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `observed_volumetric_flow_m3_s[]` | `m^3/s` |
| `standard_uncertainty_m3_s[]` | `m^3/s` |
| `resistance_multiplier` | `1` |
| `inertance_multiplier` | `1` |
| `optimizer_nfev` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_group_separated_transient_slit_flow_parameter_fit`: Fit positive lumped resistance and inertance correction factors to uncertainty-weighted, digest-pinned transient slit-flow observations from independent calibration groups; retain disjoint groups for holdout prediction and report local covariance. This is a caller-selected reduced law fit, not universal hydraulic qualification.
- `caller_lumped_slit_inertance_resistance`: Evaluate the caller-reviewed reduced planar-slit momentum law with the declared resistance and inertance correction factors; factors default to unity and non-unity values require exact fit-result Evidence and an applicability review.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.aqueous_bdot_self_consistent_speciation`

Caller-defined aqueous mass-action balances are iterated with species-specific extended Debye-Huckel B-dot coefficients evaluated from the resulting molal ionic strength. Requires caller-supplied temperature-specific A and B constants, water-mass conversion, ion-size and B-dot parameter records, explicit support limits, evidence, and reviewed molarity-to-molality activity mapping. The solver retains a molarity 1 mol/L standard state and maps molality coefficients by gamma_c=gamma_m/w, where w is kg water per L solution. A neutral-species B-dot term is used only when explicitly supplied by the caller; no salting law, missing parameter, phase, precipitation, corrosion rate, or acceptance criterion is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.aqueous_bdot_iteration.v1", "default": "matintegrity.aqueous_bdot_iteration.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `system` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AqueousMassActionSystem"}` |
| `water_mass_per_solution_volume_kg_L` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `debye_huckel_A_at_temperature` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `debye_huckel_B_at_temperature_sqrt_kg_mol_per_angstrom` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `parameter_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `temperature_match_tolerance_K` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.01, "maximum": 5.0, "minimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `parameter_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_configuration_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `maximum_supported_ionic_strength_mol_kg` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `charge_balance_tolerance_mol_kg` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `species_parameters` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/BdotSpeciesParameter"}, "maxItems": 100, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `maximum_outer_iterations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 100, "maximum": 1000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |
| `log_gamma_tolerance` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-09, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 0.001, "type": "number"}` |
| `damping_fraction` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.5, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `water_mass_conversion_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `molarity_to_molality_standard_state_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `temperature_solvent_and_parameter_basis_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `complete_inventory_and_charge_scope_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `species_parameter_completeness_and_applicability_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `fixed_point_solver_settings_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `single_liquid_no_precipitation_scope_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `temperature_K` | `K` |
| `ionic_strength_mol_kg` | `mol/kg` |
| `charge_balance_residual_mol_kg` | `mol/kg` |
| `water_mass_per_solution_volume_kg_L` | `kg/L` |
| `species.activity_coefficient` | `1` |
| `species.Bdot_target_log10_gamma_molality` | `1` |
| `species.Bdot_target_gamma_molality` | `1` |
| `species.Bdot_target_gamma_molarity_standard_state` | `1` |
| `species.dimensionless_activity` | `1` |
| `species.concentration_mol_L` | `mol/L` |
| `species.molality_mol_kg` | `mol/kg` |
| `species.ionic_strength_contribution_mol_kg` | `mol/kg` |
| `species.activity_coefficient_fixed_point_residual_ln` | `1` |
| `maximum_log_gamma_fixed_point_residual` | `1` |
| `inner_normalized_residual_norm` | `1` |
| `outer_iterations` | `1` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_general_aqueous_mass_action_speciation`: Solve a caller-defined square single-phase aqueous network in natural-log dimensionless activities. Use caller-supplied fixed activity coefficients and temperature-matched log10 equilibrium constants; solve caller-provided linear species amount and/or charge constraints after normalization by declared positive scales. A damped Newton method with finite-range checks and line search returns species activities, concentrations, balance closure, reaction residuals and full input/provider digests only within the declared tolerance. At a computed root, solve the converged Jacobian for implicit local derivatives of log activities and concentrations with respect to each log10(K), constraint target and fixed ln(gamma), without finite differencing. If explicitly reviewed, propagate a finite symmetric positive-semidefinite caller parameter covariance through those derivatives using first-order JΣJᵀ; condition and finite checks can make sensitivities unavailable while preserving the equilibrium result. No automatic electroneutrality, ionic-strength iteration, water balance, gas/solid phase, precipitation, kinetics, corrosion, or acceptance is inferred.
- [USGS PHREEQC 3 documentation: LLNL extended Debye-Huckel B-dot activity model](https://water.usgs.gov/water-resources/software/PHREEQC/documentation/phreeqc3-html/phreeqc3-26.htm) (`usgs_phreeqc_llnl_bdot_activity`)
- `molality_to_molarity_activity_standard_state_bridge`: Map a molality-standard-state coefficient to a molarity-standard-state coefficient by equating the same dimensionless activity: gamma_c*c/(1 mol/L) = gamma_m*m/(1 mol/kg-water), with m=c/w and caller-supplied w in kg-water/L-solution, giving gamma_c=gamma_m/w. Require review of the water-mass conversion and standard-state mapping, preserve both coefficients, and fail closed outside finite numeric range. This algebraic basis does not infer solution water content or validate an activity model.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.aqueous_davies_self_consistent_speciation`

Caller-defined square aqueous equilibrium/constraint system is solved repeatedly while Davies coefficients are recalculated from speciation-derived molal ionic strength. Requires caller water-mass-per-solution-volume conversion, temperature-specific Davies A, charge tolerance and explicit single-liquid applicability; ionic strength is limited to the declared ceiling no greater than 0.5 mol/kg. The mass-action solver uses the molarity standard state; Davies molality gamma is mapped by gamma_c=gamma_m/w and both values are reported. No species, reactions, charge constraints, gas/solid phases, kinetic scale, salting-out, corrosion rate or acceptance are inferred.

## `chemistry.aqueous_extended_debye_huckel_activity`

All Debye-Huckel A/B coefficients, ionic-strength support, and charged-species ion-size parameters are caller supplied and Evidence-bound. The result is a single-ion extended Debye-Huckel approximation within explicit reviewed temperature, solvent, ionic-strength and activity standard-state support. Neutral species use unit activity coefficient with no salting correction; this model does not infer CO2 solubility, phase equilibrium or corrosion kinetics.

## `chemistry.aqueous_extended_debye_huckel_self_consistent_speciation`

Caller-defined square mass-action constraints are solved repeatedly while extended Debye-Huckel gamma is updated from speciation-derived ionic strength. A, B, ion-size records, parameter support, water-mass conversion, standard-state mapping and all reaction/equilibrium data are caller-supplied and Evidence-bound. Requires a complete reviewed ionic inventory, acceptable charge closure and a single aqueous liquid phase without precipitation. Does not generate reactions or species, select phases, model precipitation kinetics, estimate corrosion or establish material qualification.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_general_aqueous_mass_action_speciation`: Solve a caller-defined square single-phase aqueous network in natural-log dimensionless activities. Use caller-supplied fixed activity coefficients and temperature-matched log10 equilibrium constants; solve caller-provided linear species amount and/or charge constraints after normalization by declared positive scales. A damped Newton method with finite-range checks and line search returns species activities, concentrations, balance closure, reaction residuals and full input/provider digests only within the declared tolerance. At a computed root, solve the converged Jacobian for implicit local derivatives of log activities and concentrations with respect to each log10(K), constraint target and fixed ln(gamma), without finite differencing. If explicitly reviewed, propagate a finite symmetric positive-semidefinite caller parameter covariance through those derivatives using first-order JΣJᵀ; condition and finite checks can make sensitivities unavailable while preserving the equilibrium result. No automatic electroneutrality, ionic-strength iteration, water balance, gas/solid phase, precipitation, kinetics, corrosion, or acceptance is inferred.
- `caller_extended_debye_huckel_activity_parameters`: Compute ion activity coefficients from the extended Debye-Hückel equation using caller-supplied, evidence-pinned solvent constants, ion-size parameters, charges and temperature support. No database parameters are embedded; outside declared ionic-strength/temperature support the evaluator fails closed. This activity provider is not a complete aqueous speciation or corrosion model.
- [USGS PHREEQC Version 3 documentation: extended Debye-Hückel activity model](https://water.usgs.gov/water-resources/software/PHREEQC/Phreeqc_3_2013_manual.pdf) (`usgs_phreeqc_extended_debye_huckel_method`)
- `molality_to_molarity_activity_standard_state_bridge`: Map a molality-standard-state coefficient to a molarity-standard-state coefficient by equating the same dimensionless activity: gamma_c*c/(1 mol/L) = gamma_m*m/(1 mol/kg-water), with m=c/w and caller-supplied w in kg-water/L-solution, giving gamma_c=gamma_m/w. Require review of the water-mass conversion and standard-state mapping, preserve both coefficients, and fail closed outside finite numeric range. This algebraic basis does not infer solution water content or validate an activity model.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.aqueous_mass_action_scenario_envelope`

Each complete scenario is caller-provided and solved independently by the existing fixed-topology aqueous mass-action solver. All scenarios share exact species order, charge/formula declarations, reaction stoichiometry, balance topology, solution identity, standard state, and provider family/revisions; numerical data such as temperature, fixed activities, equilibrium constants and constraint targets may differ. Report unweighted minima and maxima among exactly the supplied finite cases only; no sampling, probability, confidence, interpolation, omitted-case treatment or global bound is provided. A failed case prevents a complete envelope and is preserved with the successfully computed input-order prefix; no phase, kinetics, precipitation or corrosion is inferred.

| `finite_scenario_set_is_caller_owned_and_complete_for_comparison_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `provider_family_and_revision_are_comparable_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `no_probability_or_distribution_interpretation_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|

| `scenario_results[].result_values.species[].dimensionless_activity` | `1` |
| `scenario_results[].result_values.species[].concentration_mol_L` | `mol/L` |
| `species_envelope[].dimensionless_activity_min` | `1` |
| `species_envelope[].dimensionless_activity_max` | `1` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_aqueous_candidate_saturation_screen`: For each explicitly declared candidate solid, calculate the logarithmic ion-activity product from caller-supplied dimensionless aqueous activities and positive exponents, then subtract the caller-supplied temperature-applicable log10 solubility product. Require a row-level solubility record ID and a matching Evidence source ID per candidate, and carry citation, license and checksum into each result. A Python composition adapter accepts computed fixed-gamma, Davies, B-dot, or tabulated-activity aqueous Calculation results or registered AssessmentResults, checks supported model identity for the latter, carries the complete upstream digest plus activity provider/record lineage, and rejects noncomputed or untraceable states. It also accepts a digest-pinned candidate-network speciation AssessmentResult by verifying wrapper input digest, embedded workflow result and input digests, assembled mass-action system digest, and nested speciation result digest before forwarding its activity state and retaining workflow/system/speciation lineage. It accepts a registered exact-knot B-dot history only with an explicit knot index, verifies full assessment/input/history/knot/request/result and parameter-record digests, and preserves selected time, temperature and parameter lineage in the saturation result. Callers may add absolute log10 activity bounds keyed by the exact upstream species ID set; partial or extra mappings return needs_data rather than silently dropping bounds. Propagate caller-supplied absolute log10 bounds for species activities and each solubility product by conservative interval arithmetic, reporting lower/upper saturation-index bounds and whether the interval lies wholly below, wholly above, or overlaps saturation. Nonzero activity and solubility bounds require separate caller review flags; otherwise the calculation returns needs_data without an interval classification. These deterministic intervals are not probabilities or confidence bounds. Return ordered candidate results with activity-state and solubility-data digests. The time-history adapter additionally requires an exact computed van't Hoff history digest, aligned Ksp records at every knot, matching candidate definitions and explicit per-record temperature support; it does not interpolate between knots. Do not choose stable phases, solve competing-solid mass balance, infer precipitation amount or kinetics, or predict corrosion.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.aqueous_sit_self_consistent_speciation`

Caller-defined square aqueous mass-action equations are iterated with caller-parameterized SIT coefficients evaluated from the resulting molal ionic inventory and directional interaction records. Requires explicit water-mass conversion, standard-state mapping, temperature-specific Debye-Huckel A, interaction parameter provenance and a complete applicable directional parameter set; ionic strength cannot exceed 6 mol/kg. The mass-action solver uses the molarity standard state; SIT molality gamma is mapped by gamma_c=gamma_m/w and both values are reported. The API does not infer reactions, parameter values, phase stability, precipitation kinetics, salting effects outside the declared SIT expression, corrosion rates or model qualification.

```json
  ],
  "sit_provider_id": "synthetic-SIT-provider",
  "sit_provider_revision": "example-only-1",
```

구현 근거:

- `caller_general_aqueous_mass_action_speciation`: Solve a caller-defined square single-phase aqueous network in natural-log dimensionless activities. Use caller-supplied fixed activity coefficients and temperature-matched log10 equilibrium constants; solve caller-provided linear species amount and/or charge constraints after normalization by declared positive scales. A damped Newton method with finite-range checks and line search returns species activities, concentrations, balance closure, reaction residuals and full input/provider digests only within the declared tolerance. At a computed root, solve the converged Jacobian for implicit local derivatives of log activities and concentrations with respect to each log10(K), constraint target and fixed ln(gamma), without finite differencing. If explicitly reviewed, propagate a finite symmetric positive-semidefinite caller parameter covariance through those derivatives using first-order JΣJᵀ; condition and finite checks can make sensitivities unavailable while preserving the equilibrium result. No automatic electroneutrality, ionic-strength iteration, water balance, gas/solid phase, precipitation, kinetics, corrosion, or acceptance is inferred.
- [OECD Nuclear Energy Agency Thermochemical Database Project: SIT method](https://www.oecd-nea.org/upload/docs/application/pdf/2020-09/tdb2_2020-09-02_11-51-54_735.pdf) (`nea_thermochemical_database_sit_method`)
- [USGS PHREEQC 3 documentation: SIT aqueous model data block](https://water.usgs.gov/water-resources/software/PHREEQC/documentation/phreeqc3-html/phreeqc3-46.htm) (`usgs_phreeqc_sit_model_documentation`)
- `molality_to_molarity_activity_standard_state_bridge`: Map a molality-standard-state coefficient to a molarity-standard-state coefficient by equating the same dimensionless activity: gamma_c*c/(1 mol/L) = gamma_m*m/(1 mol/kg-water), with m=c/w and caller-supplied w in kg-water/L-solution, giving gamma_c=gamma_m/w. Require review of the water-mass conversion and standard-state mapping, preserve both coefficients, and fail closed outside finite numeric range. This algebraic basis does not infer solution water content or validate an activity model.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.aqueous_tabulated_activity_speciation`

Caller-defined single-liquid mass-action equations are iterated with species-specific caller activity tables using bounded piecewise-linear interpolation of ln(gamma) in ionic strength and, when supplied, temperature. No extrapolation, table fitting, solvent transfer, alternative phase, precipitation kinetics or model qualification is inferred.

- `caller_tabulated_aqueous_activity_coefficients`: Iterate a caller-defined single-liquid mass-action network with species-specific activity-coefficient tables indexed by molal ionic strength. Recalculate ionic strength from caller water-mass conversion and solved concentrations, interpolate ln(gamma) using caller-selected piecewise linear or explicitly reviewed shape-preserving PCHIP only inside each caller table support, and damp updates in log space. Require measured/open dataset knots to map both source_id and source_record_id to declared licensed Evidence. Preserve separate normalized-table, row-lineage, Evidence, provider and configuration digests through speciation and transport callbacks, together with charge/reaction closure, fixed-point history and explicit temperature/solvent/species mapping review. This is a user-supplied table evaluator, not a qualified electrolyte law; no extrapolation, table fitting, phase change, precipitation, scale protection or corrosion rate is inferred.

## `chemistry.aqueous_thermodynamic_cycle_audit`

All species formulas, charges, activity standard state, temperature and equilibrium-constant records are caller supplied and explicitly reviewed. The reaction-cycle basis is derived from the declared stoichiometric matrix; numerical rank and log10(K) closure tolerance are caller-reviewed. This API checks balance and algebraic cycle consistency only; it does not discover species/phases, solve speciation, infer missing constants or qualify corrosion.

구현 근거:

- `aqueous_reaction_cycle_nullspace_consistency`: Construct the caller-declared species-by-reaction stoichiometric matrix after checking elemental and charge balance. An orthonormal right-null-space basis identifies linear reaction cycles; equilibrium constants are algebraically consistent on that declared cycle space when the L2 norm of the basis projection of log10(K) is within a caller-reviewed tolerance. Numerical rank tolerance and the supplied species, reactions and conditions remain caller responsibilities. No reaction or phase discovery, speciation solve, or parameter qualification is performed.

## `chemistry.caller_scale_coverage_kinetics`

A caller-supplied first-order surface-coverage attachment/detachment law uses a closed-form solution for constant saturation and adaptive RK4 step doubling for reviewed piecewise-linear saturation paths. Optional caller-supplied Arrhenius activation energies scale both reference rate constants only inside the declared absolute-temperature support. The output is an area-average coverage variable; rate-law calibration, morphology and any protective effect remain caller-owned.

| `substrate_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_scale_coverage_attachment_detachment_law`: For one caller-identified scale phase, integrate the first-order area-average coverage balance d(theta)/dt = a(1-theta)-b*theta with caller-selected attachment and detachment power laws. Use a closed-form update for interval-constant saturation; for caller-reviewed piecewise-linear saturation use bounded adaptive RK4 step doubling on coverage and separate attachment/detachment inventories with caller absolute/relative tolerances. Optionally scale both caller rate constants from a reference temperature with separate supplied activation energies using the Arrhenius relation, only when target/reference and every declared piecewise-constant interval temperature lie inside the absolute-temperature support and explicit applicability review is present. Interval temperatures require complete per-interval values and an explicit profile review; no temperature interpolation occurs between intervals. Record effective temperature-specific rates, inventory closure and integration diagnostics. No nucleation, morphology, porosity, adhesion, transport protection or corrosion law is inferred.
- `arrhenius_kinetics`: Rate ratio for a single supplied activation energy between two absolute temperatures.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.caller_surface_scale_kinetics`

Integrate caller-calibrated single-phase precipitation and dissolution flux laws over constant or explicitly reviewed linear saturation intervals, with inventory-bounded dissolution. Caller supplies phase identity, condition-specific rate constants, reaction orders, molar volume and saturation history; linear positive-part power exposure is integrated analytically, and optional Arrhenius scaling is bounded by explicit temperature support and review. The uniform-layer thickness is descriptive and confers no protective credit.

구현 근거:

- `caller_surface_scale_kinetic_balance`: Integrate caller-calibrated precipitation and dissolution molar flux laws for one identified scale phase over ordered intervals with either constant saturation or explicitly reviewed linear saturation endpoints. Analytically integrate positive-part power laws max(Ω−1,0)^n and max(1−Ω,0)^n across the threshold Ω=1. Bound dissolution by the existing uniform scale inventory; for a descending supersaturated-to-undersaturated interval, generated precipitate may dissolve after the crossing, whereas an ascending path cannot spend future precipitation. Convert cumulative net molar amount per area to thickness using caller molar volume. Optionally scale both rate constants from a reference temperature with separate activation energies inside explicitly reviewed absolute-temperature support. Preserve physical scope, specimen/source/condition/provider/configuration digests and every interval balance. Do not solve saturation chemistry, phase competition, nucleation, morphology, transport, scale protection, corrosion rate, life or acceptance.
- `arrhenius_kinetics`: Rate ratio for a single supplied activation energy between two absolute temperatures.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.carbonate_alkalinity_speciation`

Aqueous carbonate-only alkalinity balance with caller activity-based K1, K2, Kw and activity coefficients. The activity standard state is fixed to 1 mol/L and requires explicit caller review; molality-standard coefficients are not directly accepted. No additional alkalinity species, gas-liquid equilibrium, gas pressure, corrosion rate, life, or acceptance is included.

## `chemistry.co2_henry_vant_hoff_temperature_correction`

The caller supplies a Henry solubility coefficient, dissolution enthalpy, optional constant heat-capacity change, solvent identity, thermochemical support and source lineage. The integrated van't Hoff form uses a positive enthalpy for endothermic dissolution and no extrapolation outside the declared temperature interval. This calculator does not infer the source parameters or calculate gas fugacity, aqueous speciation, corrosion kinetics, or engineering acceptance.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `target_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `sample_solvent_composition_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `reference` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Co2HenryTemperatureReference"}` |
| `henry_coefficient_convention_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `solvent_composition_match_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `constant_heat_capacity_correction_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `thermochemical_support_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `maximum_absolute_log_temperature_factor` | 아니오 | `{"default": 40.0, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 100.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `review_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `reference_temperature_K` | `K` |
| `target_temperature_K` | `K` |
| `coefficient_mol_L_Pa` | `mol/L/Pa` |
| `temperature_factor` | `1` |
| `delta_log_coefficient` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_co2_henry_vant_hoff_thermochemistry`: Apply the integrated van't Hoff temperature correction to a caller-supplied CO2* Henry solubility coefficient using caller dissolution enthalpy and optional constant heat-capacity difference. Preserve solvent identity, reference/target temperature support, parameter record digest and Evidence. No Henry coefficient, thermochemical table, fugacity, speciation, corrosion rate or acceptance value is embedded or inferred.
- [IDAES: Equilibrium Constant Forms — van 't Hoff equation](https://idaes-pse.readthedocs.io/en/2.13.0/explanations/components/property_package/general_reactions/equil_constant.html) (`idaes_van_t_hoff_equilibrium_constant`)
- [NIST CODATA 2022: molar gas constant](https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?r%7Csearch_for=R) (`nist_molar_gas_constant`)

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.competitive_solid_bdot_equilibrium`

The caller supplies temperature-matched, Evidence-linked extended Debye-Huckel A/B, ion-size and B-dot parameters for every phase species. No species/phase discovery, precipitation kinetics, neutral-species salting or corrosion-rate qualification is inferred.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

독립 JSON fixture 대신 호출자가 직접 구성하는 Python request 예제를 제공한다: `examples/competitive_solid_bdot_equilibrium.py`. 이 값은 API 배선 예시일 뿐 parameter 권고나 물성 검증이 아니다.

구현 근거:

- `competitive_pure_solid_fixed_gamma_equilibrium`: Minimize the dimensionless ideal-mixing Gibbs potential for a closed fixed-volume aqueous species set and declared neutral solid phases with fixed activity coefficients. Extent constraints enforce aqueous nonnegativity and nonnegative final solid inventories; equilibrium is checked with phase saturation inequalities, complementarity residuals, and species extent balances.
- [USGS PHREEQC 3 documentation: LLNL extended Debye-Huckel B-dot activity model](https://water.usgs.gov/water-resources/software/PHREEQC/documentation/phreeqc3-html/phreeqc3-26.htm) (`usgs_phreeqc_llnl_bdot_activity`)
- `molality_to_molarity_activity_standard_state_bridge`: Map a molality-standard-state coefficient to a molarity-standard-state coefficient by equating the same dimensionless activity: gamma_c*c/(1 mol/L) = gamma_m*m/(1 mol/kg-water), with m=c/w and caller-supplied w in kg-water/L-solution, giving gamma_c=gamma_m/w. Require review of the water-mass conversion and standard-state mapping, preserve both coefficients, and fail closed outside finite numeric range. This algebraic basis does not infer solution water content or validate an activity model.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.competitive_solid_davies_equilibrium`

Caller-declared competing neutral pure-solid equilibrium is iterated with Davies coefficients recalculated from the resulting single-liquid ionic strength. Requires explicit complete phase/species inventory, charge closure, source-backed Ksp, caller water-mass conversion and temperature-specific Davies A; ionic strength is limited to the declared ceiling no greater than 0.5 mol/kg. No species or phase discovery, precipitation kinetics, concentrated-electrolyte law, evolving scale, corrosion rate or acceptance is inferred.

Require explicit charge tolerance, a Davies ionic-strength ceiling no greater than 0.5 mol/kg water, convergence tolerance and iteration budget. Preserve inner solver diagnostics and input/provider digests; do not add species or equations, infer water content, substitute Pitzer/SIT, model other phases, kinetics, scale, corrosion or acceptance.

Limit dissolution by available phase inventory, then limit simultaneous precipitation with one common aqueous-reactant factor that preserves the supplied phase-rate ratios. Verify each declared reaction's charge and elemental stoichiometry and report time-resolved dissolved and solid inventories with balance residuals. This is conservative bookkeeping for user-supplied rate outputs; it does not estimate kinetic laws, phase selection, saturation, scale morphology or corrosion protection.

## `chemistry.competitive_solid_saturation_kinetics`

- `arrhenius_kinetics`: Rate ratio for a single supplied activation energy between two absolute temperatures.

## `chemistry.competitive_solid_sit_equilibrium`

The caller supplies source-linked directional SIT interactions, temperature-specific A, standard-state mapping and complete phase chemistry; aqueous ionic strength is limited to the caller ceiling, capped at 6 mol/kg. No phase or species discovery, precipitation kinetics, corrosion rate or concentrated-mixture qualification is inferred.

## `chemistry.crevice_closed_batch_aqueous_equilibrium`

A complete explicit constraint role map distinguishes dynamic conserved components from caller-fixed targets and exact zero-target charge neutrality. Only caller-declared aqueous reactions, fixed activity model, equilibrium constants and single-liquid phase scope are used. Conserved component totals are computed from initial species amounts and fixed solution volume, then checked against the final aqueous equilibrium. No solid phase, gas exchange, transport, external reservoir, corrosion acceptance or qualification is modeled.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `closed_batch_conserved_aqueous_component_mass_action_davies`: Derive conserved-component molar targets from caller initial species moles and fixed solution volume, preserve caller fixed-target and exact zero-charge constraints, solve the declared single-liquid Davies mass-action system, and verify final component inventory closure. No solids, gas exchange, reservoirs, transport or BDF coupling are implied.
- `caller_general_aqueous_mass_action_speciation`: Solve a caller-defined square single-phase aqueous network in natural-log dimensionless activities. Use caller-supplied fixed activity coefficients and temperature-matched log10 equilibrium constants; solve caller-provided linear species amount and/or charge constraints after normalization by declared positive scales. A damped Newton method with finite-range checks and line search returns species activities, concentrations, balance closure, reaction residuals and full input/provider digests only within the declared tolerance. At a computed root, solve the converged Jacobian for implicit local derivatives of log activities and concentrations with respect to each log10(K), constraint target and fixed ln(gamma), without finite differencing. If explicitly reviewed, propagate a finite symmetric positive-semidefinite caller parameter covariance through those derivatives using first-order JΣJᵀ; condition and finite checks can make sensitivities unavailable while preserving the equilibrium result. No automatic electroneutrality, ionic-strength iteration, water balance, gas/solid phase, precipitation, kinetics, corrosion, or acceptance is inferred.
- `caller_explicit_aqueous_constraint_role_partition`: Require every aqueous mass-action linear constraint to have exactly one caller-declared role: conserved analytical component, fixed target, or charge neutrality. Validate a single zero-target charge row against the exact species charge map; role labels are explicit caller semantics and are not inferred from constraint names.
- `caller_species_to_conserved_component_stoichiometric_map`: Bind each conserved aqueous component to the exact coefficient row of its declared mass-action constraint and require the mapping to remain invariant under all declared aqueous reaction stoichiometries.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.crevice_competing_solid_equilibrium`

One fixed, homogeneous solution volume and one temperature are used with fixed caller activity coefficients and standard states. Each candidate phase is a neutral pure solid with explicit charge and elemental balance in its dissolution/precipitation reaction. The bounded sequential active-set iteration must converge and satisfy present/absent phase complementarity before values are committed. The calculation is an equilibrium screen, not a kinetic or global phase-stability solver.

## `chemistry.crevice_component_solid_partition`

Total component inventory includes all liquid and candidate solid material; the caller reviews candidate-set completeness and instantaneous equilibrium applicability. Active solid phases satisfy their caller tabulated saturation product; absent phases are not supersaturated. Davies/mass-action is recomputed after each bounded phase redistribution and liquid-plus-solid component inventories close before commit. This is a standalone one-cell equilibrium partition; it is not a BDF-stage hook, kinetic precipitation model or material qualification.

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |

## `chemistry.crevice_nucleation_kinetic_history`

Saturation is caller supplied and held constant over each exact interval. Below the caller-declared phase seed inventory, a thresholded molar nucleation source is used; after the seed threshold is reached, the caller growth/dissolution law is used. Each interval's constant rates are applied through the existing dissolution-first, common aqueous-resource-limited ledger with element and charge checks. The nucleation source is expressed as moles of formed solid per solution volume per time, not nuclei count or a particle population balance. No automatic chemistry/phase discovery, moving geometry, spatial transport or qualification is included.

구현 근거:

- `digest_bound_saturation_nucleation_and_growth_kinetic_history`: Apply Evidence-pinned caller saturation intervals and bounded phase-specific molar nucleation/growth/dissolution laws to a closed aqueous batch. Before a caller inventory threshold is met, evaluate the declared supersaturation-dependent nucleation source; thereafter use the caller seeded growth/dissolution law. Delegate each interval to the conservative aqueous/solid kinetic ledger and record phase inventory, element/charge balance and law digests. No automatic thermodynamic phase discovery, particle population balance or qualification is inferred.
- `caller_evidenced_crevice_molar_nucleation_source`: Define an Evidence/digest-bound caller-calibrated nucleation molar source with critical supersaturation, source coefficient, order, phase inventory seed threshold and rate ceiling. The record is a caller law, not a universal nucleation model or particle-number theory.
- `caller_rate_competitive_solid_mass_balance_ledger`: Apply explicitly supplied signed molar extent rates for a caller-declared set of neutral solid phases over contiguous time intervals. Limit dissolution by available phase inventory, then limit simultaneous precipitation with one common aqueous-reactant factor that preserves the supplied phase-rate ratios. Verify each declared reaction's charge and elemental stoichiometry and report time-resolved dissolved and solid inventories with balance residuals. This is conservative bookkeeping for user-supplied rate outputs; it does not estimate kinetic laws, phase selection, saturation, scale morphology or corrosion protection.

## `chemistry.crevice_spatial_activity_solid_fixed_point`

Each caller cell is solved independently at one fixed geometry knot using the existing Davies activity/speciation and finite competing-solid equilibrium evaluators. Solid transfer updates only caller-declared linear aqueous conservation targets; no intercell flux or Faradaic source is introduced. Convergence requires caller tolerances for aqueous concentration, solid inventory, and constraint target changes. The finite solid list is caller selected; global Gibbs minimization, automatic species/phase discovery, kinetics, and corrosion qualification are not provided.

Runtime 의존성: `scipy` 이름으로 실행 시점에 Python callable/provider를 주입한다. 해당 provider 객체는 JSON 입력에 포함되지 않으며, 입력 계약에 기록한 provider ID·revision·configuration/record digest와 Evidence가 실행계보를 식별한다.

## `chemistry.crevice_steady_wall_sink`

The calculation does not replace transient transport, speciation, phase equilibrium, geometry feedback or qualification.

## `chemistry.davies_activity_coefficients`

Ionic strength is calculated from the caller-reviewed complete molal species inventory; electroneutrality is checked against an explicit tolerance. Davies A is a caller-supplied, evidenced value for the declared temperature and solvent; the declared applicability ceiling cannot exceed 0.5 mol/kg water. Neutral-species gamma is unity by convention; no salting-out, concentrated-brine correction, gas equilibrium, or corrosion-rate inference is included.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `solution_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `ionic_strength_limit_mol_kg` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 0.5, "type": "number"}` |
| `davies_A_at_temperature` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `A_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `A_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `A_configuration_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `A_record_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `charge_balance_absolute_tolerance_mol_kg` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `species` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/DaviesActivitySpecies"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `complete_ionic_inventory_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `charge_balance_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `ionic_strength_convention_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `davies_scope_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `temperature_solvent_A_lineage_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `ionic_strength_mol_kg` | `mol/kg` |
| `charge_balance_residual_mol_kg` | `mol/kg` |
| `activity_standard_state` | `1` |
| `species.activity_coefficient` | `1` |
| `species.dimensionless_activity` | `1` |
| `species.log10_activity_coefficient` | `1` |

## `chemistry.fixed_fugacity_carbonate_equilibrium`

Fixed caller-supplied CO2 fugacity reservoir and Henry coefficient at the sample temperature; carbonate-only aqueous activity equilibrium and total-alkalinity closure. Caller supplies reviewed fugacity, Henry coefficient, solvent composition, activity constants and all source lineage; no fitted universal corrosion or solubility parameters are bundled.

## `chemistry.fixed_fugacity_carbonate_history`

Solves each caller-supplied fixed-fugacity carbonate/alkalinity state at one exact ordered time point; no interpolation or kinetics are added. Each point retains independent gas, Henry, solvent, activity-constant and alkalinity lineage; the first failed point stops evaluation and preserves the computed prefix. The history does not close a finite gas inventory, discover species/phases, predict corrosion, scale, life, failure probability or acceptance.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.fixed_fugacity_carbonate_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.fixed_fugacity_carbonate_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `history_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_basis` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 20000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `equilibria` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/FixedFugacityCarbonateEquilibrium"}, "maxItems": 20000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `history_clock_and_sample_alignment_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `maximum_point_evaluations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 20000, "maximum": 20000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `history_id` | `1` |
| `asset_id` | `1` |
| `location_id` | `1` |
| `physical_scope_id` | `1` |
| `time_basis` | `1` |
| `time_s[]` | `s` |

| `co2_fugacity_Pa_history[]` | `Pa` |

| `co2star_mol_L_history[]` | `mol/L` |

| `co3_mol_L_history[]` | `mol/L` |

Each row is a complete reviewed fixed-fugacity carbonate-equilibrium case with common sample identity and caller-normalized weights. All rows must compute before weighted summaries are returned; summaries are descriptive and do not infer probability or corrosion rate.

Weights do not represent failure probability, event frequency or corrosion-rate distribution.

## `chemistry.layered_scale_diffusion_limit`

Caller-supplied layered effective diffusivity, partition coefficients, thickness, concentration endpoints and covered-area fraction define a steady diffusion-limit bound. The result is not a Butler-Volmer or corrosion-rate solution and does not infer scale formation, morphology, adhesion or protection from scale thickness.

구현 근거:

- `caller_layered_scale_diffusion_limit`: Calculate steady series diffusion resistance across caller-defined scale layers and a bare solution film, then mix covered and uncovered patch fluxes in parallel using a caller-reviewed area fraction. Convert transported-species flux to its electron-equivalent Faraday current bound. Preserve species, condition, layer order and provider digests. This does not determine layer morphology or coverage, solve charge balance or electrode kinetics, infer a corrosion current or claim an actual protection factor.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `chemistry.layered_scale_history_series_transport`

One digest-pinned, caller-calibrated thickness history is supplied for each ordered diffusion layer, with identical exact time knots and shared physical context. At each shared knot the existing layered steady diffusion-bound calculation is evaluated independently; no history interpolation or transient transport is performed. Phase-to-layer mapping, quasi-steady interpretation, common time/scope and computational-use rights are caller reviewed. No scale reaction, corrosion-rate, wall-loss, acceptance or qualification result is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.layered_scale_history_series_transport.v1", "default": "matintegrity.layered_scale_history_series_transport.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `transport_request` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/LayeredScaleDiffusionLimit"}` |
| `layer_bindings` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ScaleLayerHistoryBinding"}, "maxItems": 20, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `layer_history_order_and_phase_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `common_scope_time_and_knot_alignment_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `independent_quasi_steady_knot_interpretation_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `scale_history_sources[].scale_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `knots[].time_s` | `s` |
| `knots[].transport_result.values.area_average_flux_limit_mol_m2_s` | `mol/m^2/s` |

- `caller_planar_scale_reaction_demand_balance`: Advance a single dense planar scale with a monotone scalar moving-boundary balance between series-resistance diffusion supply and caller-specified interfacial consumption over ordered constant-parameter intervals. Accept either a nonnegative scale consumption flux or a sign-reviewed partial current with explicit Faraday and solid stoichiometry mapping; stop at complete scale depletion and report area-based supply, consumption, transported-reactant and net-scale ledgers with provider and evidence lineage. Do not derive demand from net current, infer chemistry or substrate attack, or solve potential feedback, porosity, finite reservoirs, phase competition or qualification.

## `chemistry.scale_precipitation_inventory_budget`

Use the gross per-area precipitation amounts from one exact digest-pinned caller scale history and multiply by one caller-declared exposed area. Subtract caller-declared formula-unit stoichiometric reactant demand from initial and interval-added finite species inventories. Require caller review of stoichiometry, area/scope mapping, inventory accessibility, supplied interval additions, gross-only accounting and computational use. Do not infer equilibrium, speciation, transport, kinetic feedback, scale dissolution recycling, corrosion, wall loss, acceptance or probability.

Fit only predeclared calibration source groups by ordinary least squares and evaluate untouched holdout source groups. Preserve calibration support, conditional coefficient covariance and predeclared transfer criteria. This screening relation is not wet-CO2 corrosion, localized penetration, multi-year growth, remaining life, code acceptance or failure probability.

The interval excludes covariate, source, model-form and population uncertainty.

## `corrosion.charge_to_loss`

Declared alloy dissolution equivalent and current efficiency; cathodic current is not included in anodic charge.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `anodic_charge_C` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `equivalent_weight_kg_mol_electron` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `density_kg_m3` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `current_efficiency` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `dissolved_mass_kg` | `kg` |
| `dissolved_volume_m3` | `m^3` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "anodic_charge_C": 1.0,
  "equivalent_weight_kg_mol_electron": 0.0279225,
  "density_kg_m3": 7800.0,
  "current_efficiency": 1.0
}
```

구현 근거:

- `faraday_electrolysis`: Dissolution mass follows charge, molar equivalent and declared current efficiency. Faraday constant is derived from SI elementary charge and Avogadro constant.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.chronoamperometry_window_summary`

Time and current units, strict sample order, current sign and source trace digest are explicitly reviewed. Trapezoidal integration represents the supplied trace as piecewise linear; requested boundaries are exact samples or explicit linear interpolants. Raw signal summaries do not classify corrosion events, infer metal loss or pit dimensions, or establish probability, POD, life or acceptance.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.chronoamperometry_window_summary.v1", "default": "matintegrity.chronoamperometry_window_summary.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `trace_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_specimen_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `source_group_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `source_trace_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `source_archive_sha256` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `source_member_sha256` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `time_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 200000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `current_A` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 200000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `analysis_window_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 2, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `baseline_window_s` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 2, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `boundary_policy` | 아니오 | `{"default": "piecewise_linear", "enum": ["exact_samples", "piecewise_linear"], "type": "string"}` |
| `sample_order_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `time_unit_reviewed_as_seconds` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `current_unit_reviewed_as_amperes` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `current_sign_basis` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `current_sign_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `analysis_window_s` | `s` |
| `analysis_duration_s` | `s` |
| `signed_charge_C` | `C` |
| `absolute_charge_C` | `C` |
| `positive_polarity_charge_C` | `C` |
| `negative_polarity_charge_C` | `C` |
| `time_mean_current_A` | `A` |
| `minimum_current_A` | `A` |
| `minimum_time_first_s` | `s` |
| `minimum_time_last_s` | `s` |
| `maximum_current_A` | `A` |
| `maximum_time_first_s` | `s` |
| `maximum_time_last_s` | `s` |
| `baseline_window_s` | `s` |
| `baseline_signed_charge_C` | `C` |
| `baseline_time_mean_current_A` | `A` |
| `minimum_minus_baseline_A` | `A` |
| `maximum_minus_baseline_A` | `A` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "trace_id": "authored-ca-trace",
  "physical_specimen_id": "authored-specimen",
  "source_group_id": "authored-ca-program",
  "source_trace_sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",

    0.0,
```

구현 근거:

- `authored_chronoamperometry_window_contract`: Independently summarize one provenance-bound, strictly time-ordered current trace over caller-declared analysis and optional baseline windows. Preserve the reviewed seconds, amperes, current sign, physical specimen, source group and source digest. Use either exact observed endpoints or explicit piecewise-linear boundary interpolation; integrate signed current and absolute piecewise-linear magnitude while retaining extrema plateaus. Do not filter, classify events, infer metal loss or pit dimensions, pool map points as specimens, or produce POD, life, acceptance or failure probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.coupled_wall_metal_loss`

Signed integrated lateral-wall species flux is converted with reviewed metal stoichiometry, physical reference area, reactive wall area, molar mass and density; no local thinning map or acceptance is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `coupled_result` | 예 | `{"additionalProperties": true, "type": "object"}` |
| `coupled_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `selection` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/WallMetalLossSelection"}` |

구현 근거:

Bind the full coupled result digest and retain source amount per reference area. Positive uptake denotes loss, negative uptake denotes redeposition. This is a whole-selected-area volume balance, not a local thinning field, corrosion-rate qualification, capacity or acceptance result.

## `corrosion.coupon_loss`

Uniform average loss over the declared exposed area; cleaning loss is corrected upstream.

| `mass_loss_kg` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `exposed_area_m2` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `density_kg_m3` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `duration_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `mean_penetration_m` | `m` |
| `rate_m_s` | `m/s` |
| `rate_mm_year` | `mm/year` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "mass_loss_kg": 0.001,
  "exposed_area_m2": 0.01,
  "density_kg_m3": 7800.0,
```

## `corrosion.crevice_hydraulic_stage_rhs`

The API evaluates one instantaneous series-slit momentum RHS. Schema v1 retains fixed-volume flow; v2 applies caller digest-bound cell volume rates to incompressible face-flow continuity. Cell pressure losses use the declared parallel-plate resistance and lumped fluid inertance relations, with cellwise pressure closure returned for inspection. Stage aperture, volume rate, pressure forcing and fluid properties are caller-provided digest-pinned records; flow integration and reactive BDF coupling remain external. The declared wide-slit and laminar/Reynolds support must hold in every cell; no pressure-flow law qualification or general flow solution is inferred.

## `corrosion.crevice_moving_volume_hydraulic_history`

Aperture varies linearly within each caller interval, so liquid volume rate is interval constant. One common pressure forcing drives the series momentum balance; continuity determines downstream face-flow offsets from cell volume rates. The reduced slit resistance/inertance law is only used inside declared wide-slit, laminar and fluid-property support.

구현 근거:

- `caller_evidenced_pressure_driven_moving_slit_volume_history`: Use caller-supplied exact-knot cell apertures, ordered dimensions, fluid density/viscosity, signed total pressure-drop intervals and initial inlet flow. Treat aperture as linear and pressure as constant inside each declared interval; apply incompressible continuity to recover cell face-flow differences and independently integrate the resulting reduced series momentum ODE. No pressure, geometry, fluid property, deposit morphology or applicability parameter is inferred.

## `corrosion.crevice_solid_volume_rate`

Positive phase molar rate denotes precipitation and negative rate denotes dissolution. Only phases explicitly marked as gap occupying contribute to solid volume change; the liquid volume rate is the equal-and-opposite signed result. Phase rate and molar-volume geometry maps are separately digest bound by licensed Evidence; this conversion does not qualify the rates or the molar volumes. The output is a stage quantity and does not integrate a coupled chemistry, solid, hydraulic or moving-boundary system.

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_solid_volume_rate.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_solid_volume_rate.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `clock_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_s` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `cell_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 300, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_evidenced_crevice_phase_molar_volume_gap_occupancy_map`: Consume a caller-evidenced ordered cell/phase map of solid molar volumes and explicit gap-occupancy flags. This map supplies geometric conversion factors only; phase identity, thermodynamic stability and property qualification remain caller responsibilities.
- `caller_evidenced_crevice_cell_phase_molar_rate_stage`: Consume signed caller-evidenced solid molar rates at one exact physical-scope clock stage, preserving ordered cell and phase identities. Positive values denote formation and negative values dissolution; the adapter does not calibrate or qualify a kinetic law.
- `composed_crevice_stage_geometry_and_phase_volume_rate`: Bind a caller-authorized composite license record to the exact digest of a hydraulic stage geometry and phase-derived liquid-volume rates. The record authorizes only the declared composition and makes no claim that source licenses transfer automatically.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.crevice_wall_shear_exposure`

Derive wide-planar-slit wall shear per cell from a digest-pinned exact interval flow history; analytically integrate absolute shear exposure while honoring reported internal flow reversal. The wall velocity profile is quasi-steady and fully developed even though volumetric flow follows a lumped inertance model. This is a descriptor only; no erosion, corrosion or qualification law is included.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_wall_shear_exposure.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_wall_shear_exposure.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `hydraulic_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `hydraulic_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `wall_shear_relation_and_wide_slit_profile_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `quasi_steady_wall_shear_on_lumped_flow_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `shear_exposure_is_descriptor_only_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `dynamic_viscosity_Pa_s` | `Pa*s` |
| `transverse_width_m` | `m` |
| `wall_shear_history[].start_time_s` | `s` |
| `wall_shear_history[].end_time_s` | `s` |
| `wall_shear_history[].integrated_signed_volume_m3` | `m^3` |
| `wall_shear_history[].integrated_absolute_volume_m3` | `m^3` |
| `wall_shear_history[].cells[].aperture_m` | `m` |
| `wall_shear_history[].cells[].start_signed_wall_shear_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `wall_shear_history[].cells[].end_signed_wall_shear_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `wall_shear_history[].cells[].time_average_absolute_wall_shear_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `wall_shear_history[].cells[].signed_wall_shear_impulse_Pa_s` | `Pa*s` |
| `wall_shear_history[].cells[].absolute_wall_shear_impulse_Pa_s` | `Pa*s` |
| `cumulative_absolute_wall_shear_impulse_by_cell_Pa_s` | `Pa*s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crevice_laminar_wall_shear_exposure`: Bind one exact computed, digest-pinned planar-slit transient hydraulic AssessmentResult and derive each cell's fully developed wide-slit wall shear tau_w=6*mu*Q/(w*h^2). Use the hydraulic source's exponential first-order flow path to integrate signed shear impulse and exact absolute shear exposure, splitting at each reported internal flow reversal. Preserve hydraulic result, geometry, pressure and fluid-property provider digests and identities. Require explicit wide-slit, profile and descriptor-only reviews. This quasi-steady shear descriptor does not solve a velocity field, local turbulence, erosion, corrosion, damage or qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.faraday`

Declared dissolution valence and current efficiency; no automatic pit geometry inference.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `current_density_A_m2` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `molar_mass_kg_mol` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `electrons_per_atom` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `density_kg_m3` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `current_efficiency` | 예 | `{"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `duration_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `rate_m_s` | `m/s` |
| `penetration_m` | `m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "current_density_A_m2": 0.01,
  "molar_mass_kg_mol": 0.055845,
  "electrons_per_atom": 2.0,
  "density_kg_m3": 7800.0,
  "current_efficiency": 1.0,
  "duration_s": 86400.0
}
```

구현 근거:

- `faraday_electrolysis`: Dissolution mass follows charge, molar equivalent and declared current efficiency. Faraday constant is derived from SI elementary charge and Avogadro constant.

## `corrosion.mixed_potential`

Reviewed compatible signed net polarization curves share one reference, electrolyte and temperature; negligible ohmic drop and quasi-steady response are required. Area-scaled electrode currents sum to zero on the common measured support; all piecewise-linear roots and zero intervals are preserved. A unique algebraic equilibrium does not establish dynamic stability, total metal loss, structural acceptance or failure probability.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `electrodes` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/PolarizedElectrode"}, "maxItems": 32, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `quasi_steady_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `negligible_ohmic_drop_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `condition_compatibility_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `anodic_positive_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `absolute_balance_tolerance_A` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-12, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `relative_balance_tolerance` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-10, "exclusiveMaximum": 0.01, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `mixed_potential_V` | `V` |
| `electrode_net_current_A` | `A` |
| `total_positive_net_current_A` | `A` |
| `common_potential_interval_V` | `V` |
| `zero_balance_intervals_V` | `V` |

```json
        "point_ids": [
          "A-0",

        ],
        "potential_V": [
          -1.0,
          0.0
        ],
        "signed_net_current_density_A_m2": [
          -2.0,
          8.0
        ],
        "evidence": [
          {
            "source_id": "authored",
            "origin": "synthetic",
            "citation": "Authored linear balance fixture"
          }
        ]

    {
      "electrode_id": "authored-B",
      "exposed_area_m2": 0.0003,
      "curve": {
        "curve_id": "authored-B-curve",
        "surface_condition_id": "synthetic-B",
        "protocol_id": "synthetic-steady",
        "electrolyte_id": "synthetic-common-bath",
        "reference_electrode_id": "synthetic-reference",
        "temperature_K": 298.15,

          "B-0",
          "B-1"
        ],

          -1.0,

          -7.0,

            "source_id": "authored",

            "citation": "Authored linear balance fixture"
```

구현 근거:

- [IUPAC mixed-potential definition and signed partial-current balance](https://goldbook.iupac.org/terms/view/M03944) (`iupac_mixed_potential`)
- [Gamry explanation of measured net current, partial reactions and polarization limitations](https://www.gamry.com/application-notes/corrosion-coatings/basics-of-electrochemical-corrosion-measurements/) (`gamry_net_polarization`)
- `signed_interpolant_balance`: Independently form the area-scaled sum of signed net electrode-current interpolants on their common potential support. The union of knots partitions the balance into linear segments; retain every isolated zero and contiguous zero interval. Normalize finite currents, check cancellation and final residuals, and select a scalar result only for one numerically resolved root with no zero intervals. Do not extrapolate, convert potential references automatically, equate net current to metal-dissolution current, or infer physical stability and failure probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.piecewise_linear_rate_thickness_history`

Each rate knot is caller supplied with Evidence and a canonical record digest; the rate path is piecewise linear only between adjacent knots. Baseline thickness evidence must be measured; required-thickness evidence must be caller-declared or from an open dataset. No probability, future extrapolation, field transferability, acceptance or material qualification is inferred.
