| `first_required_thickness_crossing.time_upper_s` | `s` |
| `first_required_thickness_crossing.time_estimate_s` | `s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_piecewise_linear_corrosion_rate_thickness_history`: Require caller-evidenced, nonnegative corrosion-rate knots starting at elapsed exposure time zero, measured baseline-thickness Evidence, caller-declared or open-dataset required-thickness Evidence, and reviewed asset/location/material/time scope. Reconstruct rate linearly only between adjacent knots and integrate each segment by the exact trapezoid, retaining knot/input digests and all interval evidence. Report a required-thickness crossing bracket conditional on that reconstruction; do not commit an interval that consumes more than the measured baseline. No extrapolation, probability, field transfer, acceptance or qualification is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.planar_slit_aperture_history`

Sequential geometry remapping from a caller-pinned cell-average signed wall-recession history within declared aperture support; support failure preserves an out-of-scope prefix and failed interval, and subsequent transport is a separate calculation.

입력 필드:

| `wall_loss_source_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |

| `transverse_width_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_cross_section_m2` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reactive_broad_face_count` | 예 | `{"enum": [1, 2], "type": "integer"}` |
| `elapsed_time_s` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 5000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

| `wall_loss_result` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"additionalProperties": true, "type": "object"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `supported_minimum_aperture_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `supported_maximum_aperture_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `wall_recession_is_per_combined_reactive_area_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `opposing_face_recession_is_equal_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `cell_center_to_face_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

구현 근거:

- `planar_slit_aperture_evolution`: Map either a caller-pinned cumulative signed cell-average wall recession or a digest-pinned cellwise wall-metal-loss result to sequential planar-slit apertures, cross sections, volumes and RestrictedTransportRequest-compatible geometry fields within a declared provider aperture range. Preserve cell order and clock; reconcile the source reactive wall areas against the declared face count, transverse width, reference area and cell widths. Positive recession denotes metal loss and increases aperture; negative recession denotes net deposition and reduces aperture. Two opposing reactive faces and piecewise-linear center-to-face area interpolation with constant boundary extrapolation require review. Support failures preserve the accepted geometry prefix and first failed interval with status out_of_scope. This is a geometry remap for a subsequent fixed-geometry solve; no within-step flow, chemistry, deposit mechanics or constitutive coupling is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.planar_slit_geometry`

Explicit constant-aperture planar slit and selected reactive broad faces; no kinetics or advection inferred.

| `cell_widths_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 2000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `aperture_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `transverse_width_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reactive_broad_face_count` | 예 | `{"maximum": 2, "minimum": 0, "type": "integer"}` |
| `constant_aperture_cross_section_and_transverse_uniformity_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `length_m` | `m` |
| `axial_cross_section_m2` | `m2` |
| `cell_volume_m3` | `m3` |
| `wall_area_per_volume_m2_m3` | `1/m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "geometry_id": "authored-slit",
  "source_sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "cell_widths_m": [
    1e-05,
    3e-05,
    6e-05
  ],
  "aperture_m": 1e-05,
  "transverse_width_m": 0.01,
  "reactive_broad_face_count": 2,
  "constant_aperture_cross_section_and_transverse_uniformity_reviewed": true
}
```

구현 근거:

- `planar_slit_geometry_reduction`: Reduce explicit constant-aperture, constant-cross-section slit dimensions and axial cell widths to cell volumes, selected broad-wall areas and reactive wall area per solution volume. Keep axial-area molar ledgers distinct from wall-area fluxes. No wall kinetics, side-edge area, advection, transverse gradients or aperture evolution is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.planar_slit_hydraulic_flow`

Steady incompressible Newtonian laminar flow in caller-declared variable-gap planar-slit cells; optional aperture state is digest-bound, and unsupported Reynolds/aspect ratios fail closed.

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |

| `cell_widths_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 2000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |

| `pressure_drop_Pa` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `dynamic_viscosity_Pa_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `density_kg_m3` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `minimum_width_to_aperture_ratio` | 아니오 | `{"default": 20.0, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1000.0, "minimum": 20.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_reviewed_reynolds_number` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1000.0, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1000.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `geometry_and_boundary_pressures_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `incompressible_newtonian_fluid_properties_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `laminar_fully_developed_slit_assumption_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `volume_flow_rate_m3_s` | `m3/s` |
| `transport_face_velocity_m_s` | `m/s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "flow_id": "synthetic-flow",
  "geometry_source_sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",

    0.01,
    0.01,
    0.02
  ],
  "cell_aperture_m": [
    0.0001,
    8e-05,
    6e-05
  ],

  "incompressible_newtonian_fluid_properties_reviewed": true,
  "laminar_fully_developed_slit_assumption_reviewed": true
}
```

구현 근거:

- `planar_slit_steady_laminar_hydraulic_reduction`: For each caller-defined axial cell, calculate the wide-slit resistance 12 mu L/(w h^3), sum cell resistances in series, and derive a steady flow from the explicit pressure difference. Convert the common flow to cell and interpolated face velocities, reconstruct cell pressure drops, and report hydraulic-diameter Reynolds diagnostics. A supplied aperture-history result must be digest-bound to the final cell apertures.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.planar_slit_transient_hydraulic_history`

Exact interval propagation for the caller-reviewed reduced balance I dQ/dt + R Q = pressure_drop with piecewise-constant pressure and aperture. Uses a quasi-steady fully developed laminar slit resistance and lumped incompressible fluid inertance; it is not a Navier–Stokes, compressible, roughness, entrance, or moving-boundary solver.


구현 근거:

- `empirical_power_law`: Dimensioned reference penetration times a dimensionless exposure ratio raised to a supplied exponent.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.rate_joint_scenario`

Each rate and weight is a caller-supplied complete scenario; one-per-specimen sample lineage is preserved separately. Weights retain caller-declared scenario meaning and are not promoted to probability semantics without an explicit reliability model. Material, environment transfer and constant linear-loss reviews are required; wall exhaustion is reported out of scope.

| `sample` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CorrosionRateSampleSummary"}` |
| `current_thickness_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `required_thickness_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `horizon_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `material_state_compatibility_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `material_state_review_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `condition_transferability_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `condition_transfer_review_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `linear_loss_model_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `linear_loss_model_review_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `scenario_rate_m_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `scenario_weights` | 예 | `{"items": {"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `scenario_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `scenario_set_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `scenario_source_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `weight_meaning` | 예 | `{"const": "caller_declared_scenario_weight", "type": "string"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |

| `scenario_remaining_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `weighted_remaining_thickness_m` | `m` |

Preserve the weight meaning and report weighted threshold or wall-exhaustion mass without interpreting them automatically as event probabilities.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `corrosion.scale_diffusion_metal_loss_bound`

A single computed layered-scale flux limit caps a caller-declared complete set of branches that produce the same transported species. For each branch, transported-species stoichiometry maps its area molar-flux ceiling to an extent ceiling, then caller metal stoichiometry and pinned mass/density map that ceiling to uniform recession. The maximum branch ratio is a conditional upper envelope when the branch allocation is unknown; it is not a current, corrosion-rate prediction or probability. The caller-reviewed steady transport ceiling and material state are assumed maintained for the supplied duration; no time integration of changing scale state is performed.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.scale_diffusion_metal_loss_bound.v1", "default": "matintegrity.scale_diffusion_metal_loss_bound.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `scale_transport_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `scale_transport_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `surface_area_basis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `exposure_duration_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `candidate_pathways` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ScaleLimitedMetalDissolutionPathway"}, "maxItems": 64, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `sustained_steady_flux_limit_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `complete_productive_branch_set_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `reaction_stoichiometry_and_metal_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `common_area_density_and_uniform_recession_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `scope_state_and_duration_transfer_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `no_other_metal_loss_path_over_duration_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| `pathway_rate_ceilings[].reactant_flux_ceiling_mol_m2_s` | `mol/m^2/s` |

The embedded source assessment, its registry input digest, complete result digest, and nested mass-balance digest are caller-pinned and independently verified. The caller supplies baseline-thickness Evidence and approves uniform area basis and density/material applicability. Remaining thickness equals baseline minus positive cumulative penetration only; negative source ledger values do not restore thickness. Only exact source observation knots are reported; no interpolation, localization, life, or risk inference is performed.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.ti12mo5zr_remaining_thickness_request.v1", "default": "matintegrity.ti12mo5zr_remaining_thickness_request.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `expected_assessment_input_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `expected_assessment_result_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `expected_mass_balance_result_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `expected_run_context` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/RunContext"}` |
| `baseline_thickness_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `baseline_thickness_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `uniform_area_basis_authorized` | 예 | `{"const": true, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `density_material_applicability_authorized` | 예 | `{"const": true, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"const": true, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `local_only_authorized` | 예 | `{"const": true, "type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `remaining_thickness_history.knots[].remaining_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `remaining_thickness_history.knots[].provider_time_s` | `s` |
| `remaining_thickness_history.knots[].signed_net_mass_flux_kg_m2_s` | `kg/m^2/s` |
| `remaining_thickness_history.knots[].signed_equivalent_penetration_velocity_m_s` | `m/s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- [Ti-Mo-Zr aqueous hydrogen-peroxide corrosion archive: pinned OCP, EIS and AESEC row access](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14981665) (`zenodo-ti12mo5zr-aqueous-corrosion`)
- `caller-baseline-thickness-evidence`: Use a traceable caller-provided baseline thickness measurement for the declared asset, location, material condition, method, date and uncertainty. No baseline value or acceptance criterion is bundled or inferred.
- `caller-density-evidence`: Use only caller-supplied traceable density evidence applicable to the exact material/product condition and temperature range. No density value or empirical table is bundled.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `creep.accelerated_lognormal_rupture_fit`

Log rupture time is linear in log(reference stress / stress) and reciprocal-temperature difference. Weighted rupture density and right-censored survival likelihood share one constant log-time scatter. Calibration and holdout specimen, source and independence groups are disjoint.

## `creep.conditional_life`

Condition-bounded lognormal population under unchanged conditions from a fresh-material age origin.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `model` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CreepLifeModel"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `stress_basis` | 예 | `{"enum": ["initial_nominal_constant_load", "constant_true_stress"], "type": "string"}` |
| `temperature_basis` | 예 | `{"enum": ["nominal_specified", "measured_representative"], "type": "string"}` |
| `initial_stress_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `current_age_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `horizon_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_time_extrapolation_factor` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `constant_conditions_since_fresh_material_confirmed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

## `degradation.archard_wear`

User-calibrated dimensionless wear coefficient, SI hardness and uniformly distributed loss.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `dimensionless_wear_coefficient` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `normal_force_N` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `sliding_distance_m` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `hardness_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `distributed_area_m2` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `wear_volume_m3` | `m^3` |
| `mean_wear_depth_m` | `m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "dimensionless_wear_coefficient": 1e-06,
  "normal_force_N": 1000.0,
  "sliding_distance_m": 1000.0,
  "hardness_Pa": 2000000000.0,
  "distributed_area_m2": 0.01
}
```

구현 근거:

- `archard_relation`: Caller-calibrated dimensionless coefficient multiplies normal work divided by hardness to obtain wear volume.

## `degradation.archard_wear_coefficient_calibration`

Calibration is restricted to one material/counterface/contact/lubrication regime with SI force, distance, hardness and wear volume. The dimensionless coefficient follows V*H/(F*s) for each valid caller observation. Calibration and holdout physical specimens and source groups are disjoint.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `calibration_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `counterface_material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `contact_geometry_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `lubrication_regime_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `observations` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ArchardCalibrationObservation"}, "minItems": 4, "type": "array"}` |
| `minimum_calibration_specimen_count` | 예 | `{"minimum": 2, "type": "integer"}` |
| `minimum_calibration_source_group_count` | 예 | `{"minimum": 2, "type": "integer"}` |
| `minimum_holdout_specimen_count` | 예 | `{"minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

| `si_units_load_distance_hardness_and_volume_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `hardness_identity_and_measurement_basis_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `specimen_source_groups_and_partitions_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `uncertainty_weights_missingness_and_validity_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `calibration_support_and_no_extrapolation_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|

| `holdout_observation_ids` | `1` |

| `holdout_log_coefficient_rmse` | `1` |

구현 근거:

- `weighted_archard_wear_coefficient_calibration`: Derive one positive dimensionless Archard coefficient per valid calibration record from measured wear volume, hardness, normal force and sliding distance, then form a caller-weighted geometric mean for one reviewed material, counterface, contact and lubrication regime. Preserve disjoint specimen/source partitions, uncertainties and excluded records; evaluate holdout only inside calibration support without modeling fretting-corrosion interaction, service life, acceptance or probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `degradation.atmospheric_multi_year_loss_history`

First-year loss and time exponent are externally supplied, reviewed quantities in exact caller units. Exposure zone, material, surface and climate/pollutant descriptor identities are constant over the history. The power transfer is evaluated only inside a caller-qualified envelope and is not a general atmospheric corrosion law.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `history_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `exposure_zone_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `surface_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `climate_pollutant_descriptor_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `first_year_loss` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `loss_unit_token` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `first_year_loss_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `first_year_loss_result_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `time_exponent` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `elapsed_time_years` | 예 | `{"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `transfer_envelope` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AtmosphericTimeTransferEnvelope"}` |
| `exposure_material_surface_and_environment_identity_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `first_year_endpoint_value_and_unit_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `time_exponent_definition_and_support_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `clock_and_ordered_time_knots_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `provider_lineage_and_digests_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `qualification_partitions_and_source_groups_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `transfer_envelope_authority_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `history_id` | `1` |
| `asset_id` | `1` |
| `location_id` | `1` |
| `physical_scope_id` | `1` |
| `transfer_envelope_id` | `1` |
| `outside_support_reasons` | `1` |
| `elapsed_time_years` | `year` |
| `cumulative_loss` | `caller_unit` |
| `loss_increment` | `caller_unit` |
| `time_exponent` | `1` |
| `qualification_partition_counts` | `count` |
| `declared_transfer_outcome` | `1` |

- `reviewed_atmospheric_first_year_time_transfer_envelope`: Apply the caller-qualified transfer identity loss(t)=loss at one year times t raised to a caller-supplied exponent only at ordered supported exposure times. Preserve material, surface, exposure-zone, climate/pollutant descriptors, provider digests and independent calibration/holdout evidence; do not infer climate effects, extrapolate, or create localized penetration, acceptance, life or probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `degradation.atmospheric_scenario_ensemble`

Each scenario is independently passed to the registered first-year atmospheric prediction model. Scenario weights and transfer applicability require caller review; no dependence model is introduced.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `ensemble_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `scenarios` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/AtmosphericScenario"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `quantile_probabilities` | 아니오 | `{"default": [0.05, 0.5, 0.95], "items": {"type": "number"}, "type": "array"}` |
| `independence_assumption_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `scenario_weights_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `ensemble_id` | `1` |
| `asset_id` | `1` |
| `location_id` | `1` |
| `input_digest` | `1` |
| `scenario_count` | `count` |
| `scenario_rows` | `mixed` |
| `summary` | `mixed` |
| `independence_assumption_used` | `1` |
| `remaining_life_or_probability_generated` | `1` |
| `report_digest` | `1` |

On every declared linear time segment, locate zero-margin crossings exactly, union contiguous nonpositive-margin intervals and integrate the clipped negative linear margin as pressure-deficit exposure. Duration and pressure deficit are sampling-dependent screening descriptors, not nuclei, inception, collapse energy, erosion damage, life or probability.

## `degradation.crevice_aperture_displacement_flow`

A pinned complete aperture history supplies fixed cell widths, transverse width and exact cell volumes. The slit is represented as a one-dimensional incompressible control volume with one mouth and a sealed blind end. Cell volume varies linearly between adjacent supplied knots; resulting face flows are displacement continuity requirements only. No pressure drop, viscosity, momentum, velocity profile, solute transport, wall kinetics or corrosion response is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_aperture_displacement_flow.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_aperture_displacement_flow.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `history_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_basis` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_history_result` | 예 | `{"additionalProperties": true, "type": "object"}` |
| `geometry_history_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `blind_end_single_mouth_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `incompressible_liquid_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `one_dimensional_cellwise_continuity_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `linear_cell_volume_change_between_knots_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `displacement_flow_only_interpretation_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `intervals[].start_time_s` | `s` |
| `intervals[].end_time_s` | `s` |
| `intervals[].duration_s` | `s` |
| `intervals[].cell_volume_change_m3[]` | `m3` |
| `intervals[].cell_volume_change_rate_m3_s[]` | `m3/s` |
| `intervals[].face_displacement_flow_m3_s[]` | `m3/s` |
| `intervals[].mouth_displacement_flow_m3_s` | `m3/s` |
| `intervals[].blind_tip_flow_m3_s` | `m3/s` |
| `intervals[].cell_continuity_residual_m3_s[]` | `m3/s` |
| `committed_prefix_length` | `count` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crevice_aperture_displacement_flow_continuity`: From a digest-pinned complete blind-slit aperture/volume history, compute interval-mean one-dimensional incompressible mouth displacement flow by summing downstream cell-volume change rates, with zero flow beyond the blind tip. Preserve exact source/result lineage and caller cell order. This is kinematic bookkeeping only; no pressure, momentum, face-velocity profile, transport, reaction or corrosion is solved.

## `degradation.crevice_wall_sink_arrhenius_calibration`

The supplied observations already represent an effective first-order wall-transfer velocity in m/s; this fit does not derive velocity from penetration, current or mass loss. One Arrhenius law with a nonnegative activation energy is adequate only over the declared material, surface, fluid-chemistry and calibration temperature support. Only predeclared calibration rows estimate parameters; holdout source groups are separate and remain unused in fitting. Optional uncertainties are standard deviations in log velocity and define relative weighted-least-squares weights; without them, residual scatter estimates parameter covariance. No use outside calibration support, mechanism assignment, corrosion rate, wall protection, probability or qualification is implied.

구현 근거:

- `authored_weighted_erosion_corrosion_power_law_calibration`: Fit a positive combined measured loss rate as a weighted log-linear power law in velocity and particle concentration for one reviewed material, fluid, geometry and mechanism regime. Preserve provider digests and disjoint partitions; evaluate holdout only inside the two-dimensional calibration hull without separating erosion from corrosion, changing regimes, forecasting service loss, or inferring acceptance or probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `degradation.erosion_corrosion_synergy_decomposition`

Pure erosion, pure corrosion and combined loss are caller-supplied matched observations; residual synergy is their signed arithmetic difference. Optional interaction partition requires a separately supplied corrosion rate measured during erosion; no mechanism, prediction, probability or acceptance is inferred. Optional rate endpoint propagation is deterministic interval arithmetic, not a confidence or probability interval. An optional digest-linked wall thickness limit state reports deterministic margins only, not failure probability or code acceptance.

구현 근거:

- `caller_erosion_corrosion_component_accounting`: For strictly matched caller-supplied thickness-loss rates, define signed residual synergy as the combined erosion-corrosion rate minus the independently supplied pure erosion and pure corrosion rates. When a corrosion rate measured during erosion is also supplied, derive the concurrent erosion contribution by subtraction from the total and retain both signed changes relative to the pure baselines. Optional caller-reviewed lower/upper rate endpoints propagate by interval arithmetic without a statistical interpretation. Integrate each piecewise-constant rate only over its explicitly recorded interval. Do not infer an interaction mechanism, clamp negative values, extrapolate, or qualify the material.
- [S. Zhou, M. M. Stack and R. C. Newman, Characterization of synergistic effects between erosion and corrosion in an aqueous environment using electrochemical techniques (1996)](https://doi.org/10.5006/1.3292087) (`erosion_corrosion_1996_electrochemical_measurements`)
- `erosion_corrosion_wall_limit_state_link`: At each complete contiguous erosion-corrosion interval, subtract cumulative caller-supplied combined thickness loss from a digest-linked measured wall thickness and then compare with the caller-required minimum thickness. When complete deterministic loss endpoints exist, propagate the margin by reversing the cumulative loss bounds and report the earliest possible/definite crossing only as an observed interval bracket. Require asset/location/physical-scope/material/geometry identity and exact baseline-clock continuity. Report a deterministic threshold relation only; do not interpolate a crossing root or infer failure probability, inspection reliability, code acceptance or remaining life.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `degradation.galvanic_coupling`

Caller-reviewed, condition-compatible signed polarization curves are solved only on their common measured support. Connection resistance must remain within the caller-declared negligible-resistance bound; otherwise this model is out of scope. Net current and separately supplied partial dissolution evidence are not interchangeable, and no rate, life, acceptance, or probability is produced.

## `degradation.galvanic_resistive_coupling`

Exactly two reviewed signed net polarization curves share one environment and reference electrode; every root is bounded by both supplied curve supports. Caller-owned electrolyte, contact and lead resistance components sum to the finite declared series resistance used in the voltage balance. No current-to-loss conversion, corrosion rate, acceptance, life, stability claim, or failure probability is produced.

## `degradation.nonisothermal_parabolic_oxidation`

A retained protective scale follows a caller-qualified parabolic law over the full history. Temperature is linear between ordered history knots and rate is linear between table temperatures. The rate table is not extrapolated and material, surface and environment identities are exact.

## `degradation.parabolic_oxidation`

Retained protective scale in one declared isothermal parabolic-growth regime; spallation excluded.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `initial_oxide_thickness_m` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `parabolic_constant_m2_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `exposure_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `oxide_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `oxide_growth_m` | `m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "initial_oxide_thickness_m": 1e-06,
  "parabolic_constant_m2_s": 1e-15,
  "exposure_s": 1000.0
}
```

구현 근거:

- `parabolic_kinetics`: Integrate a declared inverse-thickness scale growth rate to obtain squared thickness linear in exposure; no material parameters bundled.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `degradation.scc_crack_velocity_history`

One caller-owned material/metallurgy/environment/loading state and thresholded K_I-to-da/dt law apply over the finite history. K_I is supplied by the caller and linearly interpolated between knots; crack geometry and K_I are not updated from computed advance. Crack velocity is interpolated linearly in K_I without extrapolation and remains a user model rather than qualified service behavior.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.scc_crack_velocity_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.scc_crack_velocity_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_reviewed_scc_crack_velocity_time_integration`: Integrate a licensed caller-tabulated, thresholded mode-I stress-intensity-to-crack-velocity law along a finite, piecewise-linear K_I history, splitting intervals exactly at crossed curve knots and refusing extrapolation. The calculation holds material, metallurgy, environment and loading identities fixed and excludes crack-geometry feedback, initiation, probability and qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `degradation.sulfidation_exposure_applicability`

Material condition, sulfur definition, units, flow and deposit descriptors require exact identity matching. Temperature, absolute pressure, sulfur quantity and duration are checked only against caller-declared ranges. Qualification test records are preserved as evidence links and are not converted into an empirical rate law. Every linked qualification record is checked against the cited envelope identities and declared support ranges.

## `degradation.under_deposit_calibrated_loss`

Each interval has a reviewed deposit state and an external calibrated local-loss rate within one provider support. Rates are constant over their explicit intervals and are not generated from deposit observations.

| `assessed_surface_area_m2` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `intervals` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/UnderDepositLossInterval"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `rate_support` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/UnderDepositRateSupport"}` |
| `material_and_environment_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `clock_and_interval_completeness_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `deposit_coverage_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

## `degradation.wet_co2_cylindrical_scale_geometry_history`

Caller-supplied lineal phase inventories and molar volumes map to an annular cylindrical scale volume. Initial tube outer radius is fixed; metal loss moves the inner steel interface radially outward. Uniform axisymmetric geometry is required and independently reviewed by the caller. This model computes geometry only; it does not solve chemistry, kinetics, transport, corrosion or pressure loss.

| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 160, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 160, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 160, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_basis_id` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 160, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `outer_radius_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `initial_inner_radius_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `initial_wall_thickness_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `segment_length_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `geometry_provider_id` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 160, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `geometry_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `history_provider_id` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 160, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `history_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 160, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `history_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `history_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `phases` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/WetCo2CylindricalScalePhase"}, "maxItems": 32, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `history` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/WetCo2CylindricalGeometryKnot"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

## `degradation.wet_co2_gas_side_mass_transfer`

Caller supplies one turbulent gas state with mean velocity, wall shear, density, viscosity and CO2 diffusivity. The friction analogy exponent is explicit and caller reviewed; no multiphase or flow-pattern correlation is inferred. The fugacity-basis coefficient uses caller-provided dCgas/d(fCO2), which may come from a thermodynamic provider. Only a gas-side coefficient is calculated; interfacial area, liquid film, aqueous reaction and corrosion remain separate.

| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.wet_co2_gas_side_mass_transfer.v1", "default": "matintegrity.wet_co2_gas_side_mass_transfer.v1", "type": "string"}` |

| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `gas_flow_regime` | 예 | `{"enum": ["single_phase_turbulent", "two_phase_gas_core", "other"], "type": "string"}` |
| `gas_mean_velocity_m_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `gas_wall_shear_stress_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

| `gas_dynamic_viscosity_Pa_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

| `hydrodynamics_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `gas_property_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `degradation.wet_co2_liquid_side_mass_transfer`

The caller supplies the liquid-phase mean velocity and wall shear stress for one exact region/time from a separately identified hydrodynamics provider. The aqueous species is dilute enough for a molecular-diffusivity-based Schmidt number and an integral coefficient to be meaningful. The liquid phase is turbulent and the pipe hydraulic diameter is the characteristic length used only for dimensionless reporting. The default friction exponent 0.96 is a literature-supported choice over a limited Schmidt-number range; any replacement exponent is caller-selected and reviewed. The result estimates liquid-side mass transfer only; the gas film, chemistry, reaction and corrosion response remain separate models.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.wet_co2_liquid_side_mass_transfer.v1", "default": "matintegrity.wet_co2_liquid_side_mass_transfer.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

## `electrochemistry.crevice_mixed_potential_history`

At every aligned knot, evaluate multiple caller-provided Nernst half-cell profiles and caller-calibrated Butler-Volmer reactions, area-normalize the currents, and solve for a common zero-net-current potential within all reaction overpotential supports. Branches must carry the same explicit source-history lineage. Raw inventory digests remain available where supplied; aqueous mass-action and B-dot activity-history digests are retained under separate names. The API requires the complete declared reaction set, shared clock/temperature/reference, area partition, quasi-steady state and negligible-ohmic-drop review. It returns instantaneous partial reaction currents only; no time integration, dynamic stability, activity/kinetic fitting or total corrosion qualification is included.

구현 근거:

- `crevice_multireaction_nernst_butler_volmer_balance`: At aligned caller crevice inventory knots, combine two or more digest-pinned half-cell potential profiles and calibrated Butler-Volmer branches, scale each partial current by caller exposed area relative to a reference area, and solve a common zero-net-current potential over the shared calibrated support. Require common clock, temperature and potential reference, complete caller reaction/area review, quasi-steady balance and negligible solution ohmic drop. Return instantaneous branch current and stoichiometric flux without time interpolation/integration, activity or kinetic inference, dynamic stability, total metal loss or acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `electrochemistry.mendeley_mdea_eis_complex_channel_conversion`

Caller explicitly maps source headers and the imaginary-axis sign convention. Only rows from one digest-pinned local source file and one declared experimental or simulated class are accepted. The calculation preserves source row order and computes complex components, magnitude and phase only; it performs no circuit fit or corrosion inference.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.mendeley_mdea_eis_complex_conversion.v1", "default": "matintegrity.mendeley_mdea_eis_complex_conversion.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 160, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `authorization` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/MDEAEISReadAuthorization"}` |
| `rows` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/MDEAEISPointRow"}, "maxItems": 100000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `frequency_column` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 256, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `frequency_unit` | 아니오 | `{"const": "Hz", "default": "Hz", "type": "string"}` |
| `real_impedance_column` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 256, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `real_impedance_unit` | 아니오 | `{"const": "Ohm", "default": "Ohm", "type": "string"}` |
| `imaginary_impedance_column` | 예 | `{"maxLength": 256, "minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `imaginary_impedance_unit` | 아니오 | `{"const": "Ohm", "default": "Ohm", "type": "string"}` |
| `imaginary_axis_multiplier` | 예 | `{"enum": [-1, 1], "type": "integer"}` |
| `column_mapping_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `column_mapping_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `column_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `experimental_or_simulated_kind` | 예 | `{"enum": ["experimental", "simulated"], "type": "string"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|

| `points[].phase_radians` | `rad` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_mendeley_eis_column_mapping`: Caller-reviewed exact source-header mapping, units, complex imaginary-axis sign and optional source-magnitude consistency tolerances; no provider-independent interpretation is inferred.
- `explicit_real_imaginary_eis_channel_to_complex_impedance`: Calculate complex impedance magnitude and phase from caller-selected finite frequency, real and imaginary channels, preserving the source row order and row/file digests. No sorting, smoothing, circuit fitting or corrosion-rate inference is performed.
- `mendeley_mdea_co2_eis_version3`: Mendeley Data v3 raw text spectra for experimental and simulated carbon-steel EIS in MDEA/CO2 environments, retained as separate provenance groups under CC BY 4.0; the local reader preserves row tokens and does not fit circuits or infer corrosion rates.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `electrochemistry.nernst_driven_butler_volmer_history`

Evaluate one caller-calibrated Butler-Volmer reaction at exact common time knots using an upstream digest-bound Nernst equilibrium-potential history. Caller must match the potential reference, redox/kinetic direction, reaction identity and temperature support. The API does not interpolate or integrate time and does not determine mixed potential or total corrosion rate.

| `reaction_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `clock_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `equilibrium_potential_reference_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `electrode_potential_reference_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

구현 근거:

- `nernst_driven_butler_volmer_history`: Bind a computed, input- and output-digest-checked caller Nernst half-cell potential history to one caller-calibrated Butler-Volmer reaction at an identical declared clock ID and exact time knots. Require matching reaction identity and explicitly identical potential reference identifiers, caller electrode-potential difference history, valid overpotential/temperature support, calibration lineage and direction/species-flux mapping review. Report signed partial current density, reaction extent and stoichiometric species flux only at supplied knots. Do not interpolate or integrate time, solve mixed potential, infer kinetics/activity, or convert partial current into total corrosion loss, protection or acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `electrochemistry.restricted_transport_campaign`

Caller-calibrated homogeneous ionic reactions and Butler-Volmer tip/wall boundaries on a fixed one-dimensional transport grid; an optional digest-matched activity-coefficient correction multiplies species concentrations in homogeneous rates only when separately reviewed. Wall kinetics require explicit area-density, local potential and reviewed equipotential-metal assumptions.

| `surface_reactions` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ButlerVolmerReaction"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

| `equipotential_wall_and_metal_potential_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `homogeneous_reaction_activity_correction_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `metal_potential_V` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `common_potential_reference_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `surface_composition_and_reference_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `free_corrosion_zero_current_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |

구현 근거:

- `electrochemical_transport_composition`: Compose exact species/charge-ordered homogeneous mass-action sources with Butler-Volmer tip and optional cellwise wall boundary fluxes at imposed potential or an explicitly reviewed zero-current condition. Bind tip and wall reaction configurations to separate digests; wall reactions use cell-local solution potential, caller-supplied area density, and an explicit reviewed equipotential-metal assumption. An optional ideal single-solid split transport request must match the base transport exactly and retain elemental, time and phase-input identities. Do not infer competing phases, protective-scale effects, calibrated CO2 chemistry or qualified metal recession.
- `caller_gamma_corrected_effective_concentration_kinetics`: For a caller-calibrated concentration-basis homogeneous mass-action network, optionally multiply each local species concentration by the matching caller-supplied activity coefficient before evaluating the unchanged forward and reverse concentration-rate expressions. Require an explicit review gate and the exact pinned transport activity provider identity/configuration. Preserve the original rate-constant units and calibration. This effective-concentration correction is not a standard-state transformation, equilibrium solver, automatic kinetic law, or validation of the activity model or rate coefficients.

## `fabrication.chemical_cleaning_bath_component_inventory`

Component masses are caller-declared and expressed on one consistent component identity basis. The vessel is spatially uniform and each liquid withdrawal removes components in proportion to the current mixed concentration. Operation order within an event is liquid/component additions, mixed liquid withdrawal, then caller-declared component consumption.

## `fabrication.flange_contact_compliance_reduction`

This accepts external solver matrices; it does not assemble an FE model, infer loads/material data, solve nonlinear gasket contact, or qualify sealing/leakage/acceptance.

## `fabrication.flange_contact_field`

Caller-supplied symmetric positive-semidefinite relative flange compliance and per-node linear gasket springs define the spatial contact response. A deterministic active-set complementarity solve enforces nonnegative contact force and nonnegative gap; every load, coordinate and response operator requires explicit scope and computational-use review. No FE response, bolt/load distribution, geometry, nonlinear gasket law, local pressure stress, leakage, seal criterion or acceptance is inferred.

A caller-supplied symmetric positive-semidefinite flange operator is coupled to per-node reversible monotone piecewise-linear gasket force-compression curves. 구현 근거:

- `caller_spatial_nonlinear_flange_contact_compliance`: Solve compression-only nodal equilibrium from a caller-supplied symmetric positive-semidefinite flange compliance matrix, free-closure vector, contact areas and strictly increasing reversible piecewise-linear gasket force-compression curves. A damped Newton method solves only inside each declared curve support and preserves provider configuration/result digests. It does not generate a flange finite-element response, infer loading, transfer material curves, represent gasket hysteresis or viscoelasticity, resolve local stress, predict leakage or establish acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.flange_nonlinear_viscoelastic_contact_history`

Caller nonlinear Maxwell branch backbones and equilibrium gasket backbone are coupled to caller-supplied positive-semidefinite flange compliance. An optional time-varying matrix history is linearly interpolated only after explicit caller review and each evaluation matrix is checked for positive semidefiniteness. Optional replayed-path bisection narrows observed contact-state transition brackets only with caller-reviewed sampling and a single-transition-per-bracket assumption; it does not establish exact event timing. Each bracket preserves both sampled endpoint states and response quantities; each refinement replay also records its sampled midpoint response, applied compliance-operator digest, and replay-input digest. These records expose the bounded search history but do not establish an exact event root or detect unobserved transitions. No extrapolation, constitutive fitting/transfer, flange FE generation, leakage or seal acceptance is inferred.

구현 근거:

- `caller_nonlinear_maxwell_spatial_gasket_contact`: Couple caller-supplied monotone equilibrium and nonlinear generalized-Maxwell stress-strain backbones to a caller flange-compliance matrix at spatial contact nodes. Advance each branch over explicit piecewise-linear strain intervals with exact exponential updates split at backbone knots, and solve unilateral quasi-static contact at declared time knots using a bounded damped Newton active set. Preserve material and structural provider digests; fail closed on loss of local positive tangent, curve/support exceedance, nonconvergence or work-budget exhaustion. The initial knot is an instantaneous load from a reviewed zero-strain state. No flange FE response generation, intermediate contact transition, leakage, seal performance or acceptance is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.flange_viscoelastic_contact_history`

Caller-supplied linear generalized-Maxwell gasket branches evolve exactly over declared piecewise-linear compression segments and are coupled to a caller-supplied symmetric positive-semidefinite flange compliance operator, optionally supplied as a digest-bound operator at every declared time knot. Unilateral quasi-static contact is solved at declared time knots; the initial knot is an instantaneous load from the reviewed zero-compression branch state. No between-knot operator interpolation, transition time, FE response, leakage, peak stress or acceptance is inferred.

구현 근거:

- `caller_spatial_linear_prony_flange_contact_history`: Advance caller-calibrated linear generalized-Maxwell gasket branches at spatial contact nodes over explicitly sampled free-closure history, using exact exponential branch updates over piecewise-linear strain segments. At each declared knot, solve a unilateral quasi-static contact problem against a caller-supplied symmetric positive-semidefinite flange compliance matrix. Preserve provider result lineage and fail closed on unsupported compliance, unmet review gates or contact iteration limits. The initial knot is an instantaneous load from a reviewed zero-compression branch state. No flange FE response, within-interval contact transition, nonlinear hysteresis, leakage or acceptance is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

Matched material sections and SI areas are explicitly reviewed; no material constitutive law is inferred.

| `area_ratio` | `1` |

구현 근거:

- `section_area_change_kinematics`: Authored dimensionless section comparison: signed fractional reduction is the original-minus-deformed area divided by original area; logarithmic ratio uses a difference of logarithms. No material response or standard acceptance threshold is supplied.

## `fabrication.gasket_bolt_cyclic_damage`

Nominal tensile stress histories are read from one digest-pinned computed gasket multi-bolt equilibrium result. Cycle lives use caller-provided material-condition-specific Basquin parameters and tensile ultimate strength; all curve records require Evidence and an explicit usage license. Rainflow cycle counting, linear Goodman mean correction and Miner accumulation are screening assumptions; no universal fatigue acceptance is asserted.

Runtime 의존성: `rainflow` 이름으로 실행 시점에 Python callable/provider를 주입한다. 해당 provider 객체는 JSON 입력에 포함되지 않으며, 입력 계약에 기록한 provider ID·revision·configuration/record digest와 Evidence가 실행계보를 식별한다.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.gasket_bolt_cyclic_damage.v1", "default": "matintegrity.gasket_bolt_cyclic_damage.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `bolt_history_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `bolt_history_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `curves` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/BoltFatigueCurve"}, "maxItems": 256, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `declared_damage_limit` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `time_history_interpretation` | 예 | `{"const": "ordered_repeated_service_record", "type": "string"}` |
| `load_history_scope_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `bolt_identity_and_stress_area_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `material_condition_and_temperature_applicability_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `calibration_lineage_license_and_computational_use_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `cycle_counting_and_record_boundary_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `bolt_results[].cycles[].stress_range_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `bolt_results[].cycles[].goodman_equivalent_range_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `bolt_results[].cycles[].cycles_to_failure` | `cycle` |
| `bolt_results[].cycles[].miner_damage_increment` | `1` |
| `bolt_results[].linear_miner_damage` | `1` |
| `bolt_results[].damage_margin` | `1` |
| `maximum_bolt_damage` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_gasket_bolt_sn_calibration`: Map bolt nominal stress ranges to same-condition caller Basquin calibration and apply caller ultimate-strength Goodman mean-stress correction to each rainflow cycle before linear Miner accumulation. Require explicit repeated-service history and rights review; no local notch, corrosion, fretting, hydrogen or joint qualification is inferred.
- [rainflow upstream Python package](https://github.com/iamlikeme/rainflow) (`rainflow_library`)
- `caller_basquin_goodman_miner`: Use a caller-declared constant-amplitude Basquin curve, linear tensile-mean Goodman correction and linear Miner rule on rainflow-counted bolt stress cycles. The calculation is a conditional screening model, not a general bolt fatigue law or acceptance criterion.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.gasket_bolt_nominal_strength_screen`

Consume a computed caller multi-bolt/sector equilibrium and compare its nominal axial bolt stresses with per-bolt caller strength curves at exact common knots. Proof-strength curves are linearly interpolated only inside their caller-declared temperature support. Output is descriptive nominal stress margin, not code acceptance or local stress qualification.

## `fabrication.gasket_bolt_preload_sequence_redistribution`

Each tightening operation adds its applied target increment multiplied by the corresponding caller interaction-matrix column to the complete bolt preload vector. The same interaction matrix and linear superposition assumption are held across every ordered operation. The model does not calculate the interaction matrix, torque-to-preload response, nonlinear contact or sealing acceptance.

## `fabrication.gasket_calibrated_leakage_history`

Caller-calibrated pressure-dependent leakage flux is evaluated at each contact node and integrated over its declared area for an aligned joint history. Piecewise-linear pressure paths are split at calibration-axis knots and integrated exactly by Simpson quadrature on each resulting quadratic-or-lower segment. Calibration transfer, between-knot contact evolution, leak-tightness criteria and sealing acceptance remain caller-owned.

구현 근거:

- `caller_qualified_gasket_leakage_flux_calibration`: Use a joint- and condition-matched caller calibration table of local molar leakage flux versus measured or solver-derived mean contact pressure and differential pressure. Interpolate only within its declared rectangular support and integrate over a reviewed complete partition of contact areas. For interval totals, assume linearly reconstructed pressure paths, split at every crossed calibration-axis knot, then apply Simpson integration on each resulting at-most-quadratic segment, which is exact for the declared bilinear surface and reconstruction. Enforce the declared total integration subinterval budget and a two-million-cell maximum calibration table. Preserve calibration, pressure, transfer and area-partition reviews. No universal gasket law, leakage mechanism, between-knot contact evolution, seal acceptance limit or design qualification is provided.

## `fabrication.gasket_calibrated_leakage_rate_envelope`

Bound a caller-calibrated bilinear leakage flux at each node over independent declared contact-pressure and differential-pressure intervals. Partition each rectangle at every calibration-axis knot and inspect all subcell corners, which give the exact minimum and maximum for a bilinear surface on each cell; sum area-weighted node bounds. This is a deterministic envelope for the supplied fixed calibration and bounded pressures, not a probability distribution, correlated joint uncertainty model, temporal integral, sealing criterion or qualification.

## `fabrication.gasket_circumferential_contact_continuity`

A computed gasket contact-pressure field is classified against a caller-evidenced minimum pressure and caller-evidenced periodic ring geometry. Each node is assigned a periodic Voronoi angular cell; connected open arcs are resolved on this finite discretization and wrap-around runs are joined. Coverage and arc lengths are geometric summaries only; no leakage, seal acceptance, local between-node field, qualification or probability is inferred.

구현 근거:

This finite mesh descriptor does not reconstruct pressure between nodes.

## `fabrication.gasket_compression_curve_monotone_fit`

Observed force values are fit by weighted least-squares isotonic regression at sorted measured compression knots. An optional caller-selected positive tangent floor is enforced by subtracting its linear component before isotonic fitting and adding it back afterward. The fitted monotone loading curve remains tied to the specific supplied specimen condition and must not be extrapolated or transferred automatically.

## `fabrication.gasket_compression_hysteresis_energy`

Every cycle is a caller-segmented ordered compression force-displacement loop with a reviewed repeated count and closed endpoints. The path between measurement points is reconstructed as piecewise linear and integrated by the trapezoidal work rule. Energy is normalized by caller initial thickness times loaded area; no constitutive law or damage criterion is inferred.

- `caller_gasket_compression_force_displacement_loops`: Caller-supplied ordered measured compression force-displacement loops and repeat counts with specimen Evidence.

- `piecewise_linear_force_displacement_loop_work_integral`: Piecewise-linear reconstruction with trapezoidal force-displacement work integration.
- `closed_loop_work_as_measured_hysteresis_energy_summary`: Signed loop work and its magnitude are reported as measured-loop summaries only; no constitutive or damage law is fitted.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_gasket_contact_subthreshold_exposure_threshold`: Compare a digest-pinned computed gasket contact history against a caller-owned, evidence- and license-linked pressure threshold; integrate finite-node area-time below that level and positive pressure-deficit dose under explicit piecewise-linear interpolation between exact solver knots. This does not model leakage or establish sealing acceptance.
- `piecewise_linear_threshold_area_time_integral`: For each finite contact node, integrate the area-time portion below a fixed threshold over a segment whose endpoint pressures are linearly interpolated, resolving a single crossing exactly. Integrate the positive threshold deficit over the same segment without inferring between-knot solver events or leakage.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.gasket_evidence_bound_prony_history`

The underlying caller-calibrated generalized-Maxwell strain update is reused unchanged; this adapter adds source/license/temperature support requirements. Positive branch moduli and relaxation times, finite inputs/states and nonnegative total compressive response are required by the underlying contract and evaluator. One isothermal material condition is evaluated. No temperature interpolation or condition transfer is performed. The output is a one-dimensional constitutive stress/force history and is not a multi-bolt joint equilibrium, flange field or seal decision.

| `compression_area_m2` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `compression_area_basis_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `elapsed_time_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `compressive_strain` | 예 | `{"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `piecewise_linear_strain_history_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.gasket_evidence_bound_prony_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.gasket_evidence_bound_prony_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |

|---|---|

| `compressive_strain` | `1` |
| `equilibrium_stress_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `branch_stress_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `total_compressive_stress_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `compressive_force_N` | `N` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_evidence_bound_gasket_prony_parameter_lineage`: Wrap the existing caller-parameterized generalized-Maxwell gasket history with exact source/material-condition Evidence and declared use-license identity, and require the requested temperature to remain inside caller-reviewed material support. Delegate the constitutive calculation unchanged; do not fit or transfer Prony parameters, add flange mechanics, predict leakage or establish qualification.
- `caller_gasket_prony_constitutive_response`: Integrate caller-authorized generalized Maxwell branch stresses over a piecewise-linear compressive-strain history using the closed-form update for each declared relaxation time. Preserve initial internal stresses, material condition, specimen, temperature, provider revision and source/configuration digests. Do not fit or transfer coefficients, model tensile contact loss, flange flexibility, leakage or acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.gasket_leakage_box_envelope`

Returns deterministic extrema over caller-specified independent pressure, area and calibration-flux intervals using the piecewise-bilinear map without extrapolation. Exactness applies only to the declared rectangular input set; no probability, covariance, correlated uncertainty or seal acceptance is inferred.

구현 근거:

- `caller_gasket_leakage_independent_box_envelope`: Compute minimum and maximum total gasket leak rate over a caller-declared independent rectangular set of node contact pressures, positive areas, one common differential pressure and entrywise calibration-flux bounds. Require the nominal calibration table to lie inside the declared flux intervals, exact calibration-grid shapes, matching Evidence and usage rights, explicit box-independence and coverage reviews, and no extrapolation. Evaluate contact-pressure endpoints and table knots within each node interval, and common differential-pressure endpoints and table knots within the common interval; use nonnegative interpolation weights and positive area bounds to combine witnesses. The extrema are exact only for this finite-dimensional rectangular set and piecewise-bilinear reconstruction, not correlated/continuous mechanics, a probability/confidence interval, seal acceptance or qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.gasket_leakage_covariance_propagation`

A caller-supplied symmetric positive-semidefinite covariance is propagated through the local piecewise-bilinear calibrated leakage map. This is a first-order local uncertainty estimate, not a nonlinear interval or probability guarantee.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

Report parameter support, rank diagnostics, residuals and fit provenance; require evidence and reuse rights to accompany observations. The fitted surface is an empirical caller calibration and does not establish a universal gasket law, extrapolation validity, seal acceptance or qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.gasket_leakage_weighted_scenario_moments`

Evaluate the calibrated leakage response within each complete correlated scenario, then compute descriptive finite-set moments using caller-supplied ordered weights. Weights are not converted into event probabilities, confidence intervals or continuous uncertainty bounds; use only the explicitly reviewed weight semantics and finite scenario manifest.

| `weight_semantics` | 예 | `{"enum": ["empirical_frequency", "quadrature_weight", "user_declared_weight"], "type": "string"}` |
| `weight_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `weight_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `weight_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `weight_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `weight_usage_rights_evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `weight_usage_license_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `weight_meaning_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `weight_usage_rights_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `weight_computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `weighted_mean_molar_leak_rate_mol_s` | `mol/s` |
| `weighted_population_variance_mol2_s2` | `mol^2/s^2` |
| `weighted_standard_deviation_mol_s` | `mol/s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 계산기는 선행 AssessmentResult를 받아 구성하는 모델이어서 독립 JSON 입력 대신 registry 실행을 포함한 합성 Python wiring example `examples/gasket_leakage_weighted_scenario_moments.py`를 제공한다. 예제 입력은 구조 연결 설명용 합성값이며 물성 검증 자료가 아니다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_weighted_gasket_leakage_joint_scenario_moments`: Evaluate the calibrated total leakage response separately for each complete caller-supplied joint scenario, preserving each scenario's node pressures, common differential pressure, areas and calibration flux table. Bind an explicitly reviewed strictly positive ordered weight vector and its Evidence/license lineage to the exact scenario order; require the weights to sum to one without silent renormalization. Report weighted finite-set mean, population variance and standard deviation plus extrema/witnesses. These are descriptive moments of the declared finite weighted support, not failure probabilities, confidence bounds, continuous uncertainty bounds, extrapolation or seal acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.gasket_multi_bolt_sector_equilibrium`

Each bolt is an independent caller-specified linear axial spring that carries tension only; each gasket sector carries compression only. All bolts and sectors share one axial opening; cross-sector flange bending and spatial interaction are excluded. Gasket force-compression curves are linearly interpolated only inside their supplied support and never extrapolated. Each load step is an independent quasi-static equilibrium relative to the declared zero-time assembly preload; no relaxation or path memory is included. Bolt stress is nominal axial force divided by caller-supplied tensile area and is not a thread-root/local stress or allowable comparison.

입력 필드:

| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.gasket_multi_bolt_sector_equilibrium.v1", "default": "matintegrity.gasket_multi_bolt_sector_equilibrium.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `joint_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `bolts` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketJointBolt"}, "maxItems": 256, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `gasket_sectors` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketJointSector"}, "maxItems": 256, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `load_steps` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketJointLoadStep"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `minimum_opening_m` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_opening_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `initial_force_balance_tolerance_N` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `force_balance_tolerance_N` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `opening_tolerance_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_bisection_iterations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 160, "maximum": 1000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |
| `common_axial_opening_assumption_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `per_bolt_preload_stiffness_area_basis_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `sector_force_curve_support_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `tension_only_bolts_and_compression_only_gasket_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `load_step_interpolation_and_quasistatic_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

구현 근거:

Preserve preloads, tensile areas, sector areas, source digests and Evidence. No flange bending, leakage, relaxation, code limit or qualification is inferred.

Preserve material/provider/source identity, initial branch state, input digest and force residual. Restrict the result to reviewed closed contact and declared strain support; do not fit or transfer Prony coefficients, model contact opening, spatial flange flexibility, leakage or acceptance.
