## `fabrication.gasket_prony_relaxation_spectrum_fit`

Fit a finite positive generalized-Maxwell relaxation spectrum from caller step-strain observations at one exact material condition and temperature. Residuals are normalized by caller standard measurement uncertainties; no automatic branch-count selection, robust loss, or cross-condition transfer is performed. The fitted curve is a calibration result only and is not independent validation, seal acceptance or a qualified gasket constitutive law.

Runtime 의존성: `scipy` 이름으로 실행 시점에 Python callable/provider를 주입한다. 해당 provider 객체는 JSON 입력에 포함되지 않으며, 입력 계약에 기록한 provider ID·revision·configuration/record digest와 Evidence가 실행계보를 식별한다.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.gasket_prony_relaxation_spectrum_fit.v1", "default": "matintegrity.gasket_prony_relaxation_spectrum_fit.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `analysis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `tests` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketPronyRelaxationTest"}, "maxItems": 500, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `prony_branch_count` | 예 | `{"maximum": 8, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |
| `maximum_modulus_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `relaxation_time_min_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `relaxation_time_max_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `data_source_id` | 아니오 | `{"default": "caller_gasket_prony_step_strain_relaxation_tests", "type": "string"}` |
| `data_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `protocol_and_sign_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `common_material_condition_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `isothermal_linear_viscoelastic_applicability_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `rights_and_computational_use_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `maximum_function_evaluations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 20000, "maximum": 200000, "minimum": 100, "type": "integer"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `temperature_K` | `K` |
| `equilibrium_modulus_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `prony_branches[].modulus_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `prony_branches[].relaxation_time_s` | `s` |
| `maximum_modulus_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `weighted_sum_squared_residual` | `1` |
| `normalized_residual_rms` | `1` |
| `relaxation_time_fit_support_s[]` | `s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_gasket_prony_step_strain_relaxation_tests`: Use caller-provided finite step-strain relaxation tests with explicit specimen/source-group identity, time and temperature support, data rights, and uncertainty basis to fit a generalized-Maxwell Prony spectrum. The observations remain caller-owned and are not bundled.
- `nonlinear_weighted_generalized_maxwell_relaxation_fit`: Fit a finite generalized-Maxwell relaxation spectrum to caller-observed step-strain stress records with weighted nonlinear least squares, caller bounds, specimen/source-group identities and explicit data-use lineage. Report optimizer and rank diagnostics; a fitted spectrum is not unique, independently validated, temperature transferable or a sealing qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.gasket_prony_temperature_shift_history`

A caller-calibrated, thermorheologically simple time-temperature shift modifies the Prony relaxation clock while other material parameters remain at the reference condition. The existing exact piecewise-linear strain/generalized-Maxwell solver is reused in reduced time; actual interval temperatures are piecewise constant caller inputs. This is an isothermal-equivalent constitutive screening history, not a thermally coupled joint or seal qualification model.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.gasket_prony_temperature_shift_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.gasket_prony_temperature_shift_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `base_history` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketViscoelasticHistoryRequest"}` |
| `shift_law` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketPronyTemperatureShiftLaw"}` |
| `interval_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `interval_temperature_piecewise_constant_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `reference_temperature_K` | `K` |
| `interval_temperature_K[]` | `K` |
| `reduced_time_s[]` | `s` |
| `temperature_shift_history[].shift_factor` | `1` |
| `temperature_shift_history[].reduced_interval_time_s` | `s` |
| `constitutive_response_history[].total_compressive_stress_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `constitutive_response_history[].compressive_force_N` | `N` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_gasket_prony_time_temperature_shift_parameters`: Use caller-evidenced Arrhenius or WLF parameters to compute a time-temperature shift factor for an existing generalized-Maxwell Prony response within explicit review and temperature support. No parameters are inferred or transferred between formulations.
- `caller_gasket_prony_constitutive_response`: Integrate caller-authorized generalized Maxwell branch stresses over a piecewise-linear compressive-strain history using the closed-form update for each declared relaxation time. Preserve initial internal stresses, material condition, specimen, temperature, provider revision and source/configuration digests. Do not fit or transfer coefficients, model tensile contact loss, flange flexibility, leakage or acceptance.
- `arrhenius_reduced_time_prony_shift`: Scale elapsed Prony time by an Arrhenius shift factor from caller activation energy and reference temperature, then pass reduced-time increments to the existing linear viscoelastic generalized-Maxwell solver. This does not shift modulus, solve heat transfer, or imply contact or leakage performance.
- `wlf_reduced_time_prony_shift`: Scale elapsed Prony time by a caller WLF shift factor using caller constants and reference temperature, then reuse the existing generalized-Maxwell solver. The implementation enforces supplied support and does not establish a universal shift law or material qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.gasket_radial_open_path_screen`

The supplied cell pressure map is interpreted on an annulus partitioned by radial and full-ring angular edges. Cells below a caller threshold are open; four-neighbor connectivity wraps around the angular coordinate. The minimum bottleneck is the minimum, over radial cell paths, of the highest cell pressure on that path.

| `criterion_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `criterion_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_parameterized_engineering_correlation_arithmetic`: Independently evaluate explicit caller-parameterized displacement-stress variants, dimensionally declared 2D/3D cooling correlations, affine moisture/hydrogen estimation and coupling/thread pressure arithmetic. Require full input/coefficient record hashes, licensed Evidence and applicability review. All empirical and standard-dependent coefficients are caller inputs; no proprietary parameter/grade/shape-factor tables, automatic method eligibility, rounding or qualification is bundled. Cooling dimensional structure is cross-checked against Bjork et al. 2023, https://doi.org/10.1007/s40194-023-01483-w; no prose or figures copied.

Preserve the denominator basis and report fraction/percent without bundled forming tolerances, sampling rules or acceptance decisions.

## `fabrication.nonlinear_bolt_gasket_contact`

Single-degree-of-freedom quasi-static joint equilibrium using caller-authorized monotone nonlinear bolt force-extension and gasket force-compression curves, with no extrapolation. Caller may supply a validated equivalent assembly curve; this does not resolve a spatial flange bending field, hysteresis, leakage or acceptance.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `joint_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `gasket_curve_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `gasket_curve_source_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `gasket_compression_curve` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketCompressionPoint"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `bolt_curve_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `bolt_curve_source_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `bolt_force_change_curve` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/BoltForceChangePoint"}, "minItems": 3, "type": "array"}` |
| `initial_compression_m` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `external_separating_force_N` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `bolt_free_length_change_m` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `supplied_curves_and_uniform_contact_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `both_curves_computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `bolt_force_N` | `N` |
| `gasket_force_N` | `N` |
| `compression_m` | `m` |
| `contact_gap_m` | `m` |
| `bolt_extension_change_m` | `m` |
| `force_balance_residual_N` | `N` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "joint_id": "synthetic-nonlinear-joint",
  "gasket_curve_id": "synthetic-gasket-curve-v1",
  "gasket_curve_source_sha256": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
  "gasket_compression_curve": [
    {
      "compression_m": 0.0,
      "force_N": 0.0
    },
    {
      "compression_m": 0.0001,
      "force_N": 500.0
    },
    {
      "compression_m": 0.0003,
      "force_N": 3000.0
    }
  ],
  "bolt_curve_id": "synthetic-bolt-curve-v1",
  "bolt_curve_source_sha256": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
  "bolt_force_change_curve": [
    {
      "extension_change_m": -0.0003,
      "force_change_N": -30000.0
    },
    {
      "extension_change_m": 0.0,
      "force_change_N": 0.0
    },
    {
      "extension_change_m": 0.0003,
      "force_change_N": 30000.0
    }
  ],
  "initial_compression_m": 0.0002,
  "external_separating_force_N": 1000.0,
  "bolt_free_length_change_m": 0.0,
  "supplied_curves_and_uniform_contact_reviewed": true,
  "both_curves_computational_use_authorized": true
}
```

구현 근거:

- `caller_nonlinear_bolt_gasket_equilibrium`: Solve a single-degree-of-freedom quasi-static force balance with caller-supplied monotone piecewise-linear bolt force-change versus signed extension and gasket force versus compression curves. Initialize bolt preload from the gasket force at declared initial compression, apply external separating force and bolt free-length change, and solve only inside both curve supports. Separate closed contact from separation and retain source/configuration digests. The curves may encode an independently justified equivalent assembly compliance, but the API does not infer it, transfer curves, model hysteresis/history, resolve a spatial flange field, predict leakage, or establish acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.regular_tube_layout`

Explicit regular square or triangular tube lattice geometry; no shell/baffle clearance or pressure-drop inference.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `tube_outer_diameter_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `pitch_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `layout` | 예 | `{"enum": ["square", "triangular"], "type": "string"}` |
| `tube_count` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "integer"}` |
| `tube_inner_diameter_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `ligament_m` | `m` |
| `ligament_fraction` | `1` |
| `ideal_lattice_void_fraction` | `1` |
| `tube_side_flow_area_m2` | `m2` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "tube_outer_diameter_m": 0.02,
  "tube_inner_diameter_m": 0.016,
  "pitch_m": 0.027,
  "layout": "triangular",
  "tube_count": 100
}
```

구현 근거:

- `caller_fad_and_assembly_geometry`: Interpolate a caller FAD curve without extrapolation; calculate regular tube lattice void and bore areas, identified tube wall-loss inventory, and linear two-spring joint load partition. Preserve explicit support and closed-contact limitations without embedding code limits or predicting nonlinear gasket response.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.storage_preservation`

Item, material, area, storage location, preservation method, material batch and event identities are exact caller inputs. Ordered exposure, inspection and renewal records retain environmental, preservation, surface and corrosion observations. Campaign outcomes use caller criteria without rate, life, standard-cycle or automatic acceptance inference.

## `fabrication.storage_preservation_history`

Piecewise-constant environment observations remain separate from caller-declared temperature, humidity, preservation-state and inspection-spacing limits. Uncovered or invalid intervals stop a complete-history result and are not replaced, interpolated or classified as acceptable exposure. Timeline rows partition the declared horizon; uncovered spans remain explicit and are not imputed.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `record_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `clock_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `environment_intervals` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/PreservationEnvironmentInterval"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `inspections` | 아니오 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/PreservationInspection"}, "type": "array"}` |
| `minimum_allowed_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_allowed_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `minimum_allowed_relative_humidity_fraction` | 예 | `{"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_allowed_relative_humidity_fraction` | 예 | `{"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `allowed_preservation_state_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `maximum_inspection_interval_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

| `environment_units_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

| `declared_limits_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

Use a single forward sweep over sorted interval boundaries. Do not bridge missing intervals or supply preservation requirements, damage rates, remaining life or acceptance decisions.

## `fabrication.surface_cleanliness_assessment`

Area coverage is summed only after the caller reviews areas as mutually exclusive. Observation values and expanded uncertainties share the exact caller-declared unit token. Every comparison is against a caller-owned requirement with separately preserved authority evidence.

구현 근거:

- `authored_partitioned_thermal_spray_thickness_uncertainty`: Apply caller-supplied additive instrument bias corrections to repeated SI coating-thickness measurements and combine reviewed repeatability, measurement and calibration standard-uncertainty components. Preserve physical specimen, source, independence and spatial partitions plus holdout reference lineage; do not perform segmentation or infer bond strength, acceptance, service life or probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.thickness_budget`

Caller-declared manufacturing, forming, future corrosion and structural requirements with a separate measured path.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `nominal_thickness_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `manufacturing_minus_tolerance_m` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `forming_loss_fraction` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMaximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `corrosion_allowance_m` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `required_structural_thickness_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `measured_postfabrication_thickness_m` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `minimum_supplied_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `minimum_formed_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `nominal_budget_structural_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `nominal_budget_margin_m` | `m` |
| `measured_structural_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `measured_margin_m` | `m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "nominal_thickness_m": 0.01,
  "manufacturing_minus_tolerance_m": 0.0005,
  "forming_loss_fraction": 0.1,
  "corrosion_allowance_m": 0.001,
  "required_structural_thickness_m": 0.006,
  "measured_postfabrication_thickness_m": 0.0088
}
```

구현 근거:

- `dimensional_budget`: Subtract manufacturing dimensional allowance, then apply a declared fractional forming loss, then reserve future corrosion thickness; measured postfabrication dimensions take a separate path.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fabrication.transport_erection`

Ordered item, lift, transport, storage, support and erection evidence is caller supplied. No structural solver, allowable load table, automatic damage decision, or qualification is produced.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `clock_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `events` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/OrderedHandlingEvent"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

## `fabrication.transport_erection_history`

Ordered handling, transport and erection activity intervals remain separate from metric observations, inspections and caller-owned limits. Missing coverage, invalid records, unmatched metrics, unit conflicts and absent caller-required inspection stages prevent a complete-history result.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `record_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `clock_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `horizon_start_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `horizon_end_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `activity_intervals` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/HandlingActivityInterval"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `metric_observations` | 아니오 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/TransportMetricObservation"}, "type": "array"}` |
| `metric_limits` | 아니오 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/TransportMetricLimit"}, "type": "array"}` |
| `inspections` | 아니오 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/HandlingInspection"}, "type": "array"}` |
| `required_inspection_stage_ids` | 아니오 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "type": "array"}` |

| `inspection_stage_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `disposition_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

출력 단위:

## `fabrication.tube_bend_preform_thickness`

Inputs, coefficients, unit conventions, applicability and use rights are caller-reviewed and digest-pinned. No standard parameter table, grade factor, automatic rule choice, rounding or procedure approval is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `basis` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CorrelationBasis"}` |
| `tube_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `minimum_straight_wall_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `tube_outer_diameter_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `mean_bend_radius_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `curvature_allowance_coefficient` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `tube_id` | `1` |
| `preform_wall_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `curvature_allowance_multiplier` | `1` |
| `added_wall_allowance_m` | `m` |
| `record_sha256` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_parameterized_engineering_correlation_arithmetic`: Independently evaluate explicit caller-parameterized displacement-stress variants, dimensionally declared 2D/3D cooling correlations, affine moisture/hydrogen estimation and coupling/thread pressure arithmetic. Require full input/coefficient record hashes, licensed Evidence and applicability review. All empirical and standard-dependent coefficients are caller inputs; no proprietary parameter/grade/shape-factor tables, automatic method eligibility, rounding or qualification is bundled. Cooling dimensional structure is cross-checked against Bjork et al. 2023, https://doi.org/10.1007/s40194-023-01483-w; no prose or figures copied.

## `fabrication.unilateral_nonlinear_gasket_prony_joint_history`

Caller-authorized nonlinear generalized-Maxwell gasket curves and a nonlinear bolt curve are solved with compression-only contact at each declared time knot. Open/reclose transitions are knotwise; branch state is frozen at zero compression while open. No between-knot event time, flange field, leakage or acceptance is inferred.

- `caller_nonlinear_gasket_prony_joint_history`: Represent the gasket equilibrium response and each generalized-Maxwell branch with caller-authorized monotone piecewise-linear stress-strain backbones. Split a linear strain interval at every crossed backbone knot and exactly integrate each first-order branch state over each constant-slope segment; at each declared time knot solve closed-contact equilibrium against a caller-supplied nonlinear bolt force-extension curve and external separating load. Preserve initial branch state, calibration/provider/source digests and force residual. Do not extrapolate, fit or transfer curves, model unilateral contact opening, spatial flange flexibility, leakage or acceptance.

## `fabrication.winterization_inventory`

Each interval uses constant ambient temperature, conductance, trace power and effective isobaric heat capacity. The inventory is spatially uniform and well mixed at constant absolute pressure with no phase change, flow or reaction. The minimum allowable temperature is caller-reviewed; this model does not infer a freezing point or code acceptance.

```json
  "conductance_history_reviewed": true,
  "heat_tracing_history_reviewed": true,
  "property_states_reviewed": true,
  "minimum_temperature_reviewed": true
}
```

구현 근거:

- `lumped_heat_balance`: Solve a first-order solid heat-capacity balance against a constant convection boundary and report Biot applicability.
- [CoolProp high-level thermodynamic property API](https://coolprop.org/coolprop/HighLevelAPI.html) (`coolprop_high_level`)

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.area_uniform_fibonacci_plane_grid`

Unoriented plane normals use midpoint-stratified positive-z coordinates with equal nominal solid-angle weights and a deterministic golden-angle azimuth sequence. The points are not asserted to be an exact equal-area Voronoi tessellation, a nested grid, a covering-radius guarantee or a continuous orientation optimum. Candidate count and azimuth phase are caller-controlled diagnostics; downstream factors still require a qualified local tensor history and independent material calibration.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `grid_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `candidate_count` | 예 | `{"minimum": 4, "type": "integer"}` |
| `azimuth_phase_rad` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.0, "exclusiveMaximum": 6.283185307179586, "minimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `candidate_count` | `1` |
| `azimuth_phase_rad` | `rad` |
| `golden_angle_rad` | `rad` |
| `nominal_solid_angle_weight_sr` | `sr` |
| `nominal_weight_sum_sr` | `sr` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "grid_id": "example-area-uniform-grid",
  "candidate_count": 64,
  "azimuth_phase_rad": 0.0
}
```

구현 근거:

- `area_uniform_fibonacci_plane_grid_derivation`: Represent each unoriented plane once with a normal strictly inside the positive-z hemisphere. Partition the hemisphere into equal increments of z, place one normal at each stratum midpoint, and advance its azimuth by the golden angle with a caller-controlled phase. Assign the hemisphere area divided by point count only as a nominal quadrature weight. This deterministic area-stratified sequence is not an exact equal-area Voronoi tessellation, a nested refinement, a covering-radius bound or a continuous orientation optimum.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.basquin`

Stress-range convention, constant amplitude, calibrated user coefficients; no endurance plateau.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `stress_range_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_range_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_cycles` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `exponent` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `cycles_to_failure` | `cycle` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "stress_range_Pa": 200000000.0,
  "reference_range_Pa": 100000000.0,
  "reference_cycles": 1000000.0,
  "exponent": 3.0
}
```

구현 근거:

- `basquin_relation`: A declared constant-amplitude stress-range power law with reference stress and life.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.carpinteri_spagnoli_finite_limit_screen`

Uses the quadratic combination of maximum plane-normal stress and weighted shear-vector amplitude on caller-supplied finite planes. The shear coefficient is derived from matched fully reversed axial and torsional endurance limits for the caller-reviewed hard-metal HCF scope. Finite plane selection and sampled vector amplitude do not reproduce or qualify a continuous original Carpinteri-Spagnoli procedure.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `analysis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `history_source_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `history_source_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `history_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `axial_limit_source_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `axial_limit_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `axial_limit_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `fully_reversed_axial_limit_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `torsion_limit_source_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `torsion_limit_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `torsion_limit_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `fully_reversed_torsion_limit_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `sample_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 3, "type": "array"}` |
| `stress_tensor_components_Pa` | 예 | `{"items": {"items": {"type": "number"}, "type": "array"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 3, "type": "array"}` |
| `candidate_planes` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CarpinteriSpagnoliPlane"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `maximum_plane_pair_evaluations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 2000000, "maximum": 20000000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |
| `matched_material_endurance_data_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|

| `plane_results[].maximum_normal_stress_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `plane_results[].finite_sample_shear_vector_half_diameter_Pa` | `Pa` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.carpinteri_spagnoli_life_dependent_curve`

Uses finite caller planes and same-condition axial/torsion S-N curves; curve strengths define the life-dependent shear weighting. The scalar utilization root is restricted to the shared curve life interval and uses bounded logarithmic bisection. No continuous plane orientation, variable-amplitude accumulation or material qualification is implied.

## `fatigue.closed_tensor_work_life`

Caller-provided closed 3D stress-strain tensor cycles and material-matched work-life calibration with bounded log-log interpolation and explicit Miner accumulation. Path-work response is caller-calibrated and is not a universal nonproportional fatigue law or code acceptance result.

구현 근거:

- [Fatemi and Socie, critical-plane fatigue approach including out-of-phase loading](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1460-2695.1988.tb01169.x) (`fatemi_socie_1988`)
- [Smith, Watson and Topper, stress-strain fatigue function with mean-stress effect](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/309476268_A_stress-strain_function_for_the_fatigue_of_metals_stress-strain_function_for_metal_fatigue_including_mean_stress_effect) (`smith_watson_topper_1970`)
- `critical_plane_tensor_projection`: For every caller-declared orthonormal normal n and in-plane direction m, independently project a symmetric local stress or small-strain tensor as n dot T dot n and m dot T dot n. Convert tensor shear strain to engineering shear strain by a factor of two, form half ranges over one reviewed closed representative cycle, and evaluate only the declared finite candidate set. Endpoint Frobenius errors qualify cycle closure. No continuous orientation optimization, rainflow extraction, notch solution, calibration, fatigue life or acceptance rule is inferred.

## `fatigue.critical_plane_findley_calibrated_life`

Uses the independent finite-sample Findley parameter evaluator and an explicitly supplied, digest-bound monotone parameter-life curve. Life interpolation is piecewise linear in log(parameter) and log(cycles), within the supplied support only. No fatigue life, calibration, transfer rule or acceptance criterion is inferred from missing inputs.

- `caller_findley_parameter_life_curve`: Evaluate the existing finite-sample critical-plane Findley parameter for the caller-supplied stress history and interpolate cycles to failure only within a caller-provided, digest-bound, strictly monotone parameter/life curve. The method is piecewise linear in logarithmic parameter and logarithmic life, rejects extrapolation, and records material-condition, load-basis, curve-support, rights and authorization reviews. It does not infer a curve, transfer calibration, fatigue acceptance, probability, unsampled orientations or material qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.critical_plane_findley_parameter`

Uses the Findley critical-plane stress parameter with caller-supplied coefficient and reference strength; no coefficient, strength curve or cycle life is inferred. The sampled shear amplitude is one half of the maximum pairwise chord in the two-component in-plane shear-traction path and is evaluated only on caller-supplied planes. A computed value is a deterministic model output, not a code acceptance decision, life prediction, failure probability or material qualification.

## `fatigue.critical_plane_grid_family_comparison`

The caller supplies one reviewed closed local tensor cycle, at least two uniquely identified latitude-azimuth and/or area-stratified Fibonacci grids, an explicit finite reference grid and diagnostic tolerances. All grids use the same sampled maximum-pairwise shear-vector chord; candidate family, count and Fibonacci phase are compared without changing the tensor history. Agreement with the declared finite reference does not prove an orientation-error bound, continuous-plane/time convergence, fatigue-life calibration, acceptance or experimental validity.

구현 근거:

- `hemisphere_plane_grid_derivation`: Represent each unoriented material plane once by a unit normal on the closed upper hemisphere. Sample polar latitude uniformly from the pole through the equator and azimuth uniformly around intermediate latitudes; retain one pole and half the equatorial azimuths to remove exact n versus minus-n duplicates. Construct a deterministic in-plane unit direction from the least-aligned Cartesian axis. This finite latitude-azimuth grid is not equal-area and its nominal angular increments are not a coverage-error bound, convergence proof or continuous optimum.
- `area_uniform_fibonacci_plane_grid_derivation`: Represent each unoriented plane once with a normal strictly inside the positive-z hemisphere. Partition the hemisphere into equal increments of z, place one normal at each stratum midpoint, and advance its azimuth by the golden angle with a caller-controlled phase. Assign the hemisphere area divided by point count only as a nominal quadrature weight. This deterministic area-stratified sequence is not an exact equal-area Voronoi tessellation, a nested refinement, a covering-radius bound or a continuous orientation optimum.
- `critical_plane_vector_chord_projection`: For each caller-declared orthonormal plane frame, independently project the symmetric tensor path onto two in-plane shear directions. Form the exact maximum pairwise Euclidean chord of the sampled engineering-shear vectors and use half that named chord as a discrete amplitude. The Euclidean result is invariant to rotation or reversal of the supplied in-plane basis. Preserve chord endpoint sample identities and distinguish this O(n squared) sampled-path definition from continuous-time extrema, a minimum enclosing circle, rainflow extraction, continuous plane optimization, fatigue-life calibration and acceptance.
- `critical_plane_grid_family_comparison_diagnostic`: Evaluate one reviewed sampled tensor cycle with at least two uniquely identified finite latitude-azimuth and/or area-stratified Fibonacci candidate sets. Preserve each generator definition, sampled FS/SWT maxima and selected normals. Relative to one caller-named finite reference grid, report normalized factor differences and acute angles between unoriented selected normals. Cross-grid agreement is not an orientation-error bound, continuous optimum, temporal convergence, fatigue-life calibration or experimental validation.

## `fatigue.critical_plane_grid_refinement`

The caller supplies one reviewed closed local tensor cycle, at least two explicitly ordered hemisphere grids and diagnostic factor-change and plane-rotation tolerances. Each level uses the sampled maximum-pairwise shear-vector chord and reports both FS and SWT maxima; only successive finite grids are compared. Meeting a declared diagnostic tolerance does not prove continuous orientation or time convergence, fatigue-life calibration, acceptance or independent experimental validity.

The Euclidean result is invariant to rotation or reversal of the supplied in-plane basis. ## `fatigue.critical_plane_minimum_enclosing_circle_factors`

The caller supplies a reviewed closed local tensor cycle, tensor-shear components, finite orthonormal plane frames and qualified FS parameters. For each plane, the sampled two-component engineering-shear path amplitude is the radius of its deterministic minimum enclosing circle; up to three support-sample identities and the half-maximum-chord comparison remain explicit. This finite point-set range ignores path order after closure review and does not qualify an unsampled continuous path, cycle counting, a continuous orientation optimum, fatigue life, acceptance or experiment agreement.

## `fatigue.critical_plane_piecewise_linear_time_history`

The caller supplies one timed, reviewed closed tensor cycle and explicitly declares piecewise-linear interpolation of the tensor components. For the selected finite plane set and chord or enclosing-circle definitions, extrema of the reconstructed path are exactly represented by the sample vertices; this is conditional on the declared interpolation. The model does not infer physical behavior between measurements, continuous-plane optima, multiaxial cycle pairing, damage accumulation, fatigue life or experimental validity.

- `critical_plane_piecewise_linear_time_extrema`: Reconstruct symmetric stress and infinitesimal-strain tensor components linearly between caller-timed samples of one reviewed closed cycle. For the declared finite planes, normal scalar extrema occur at segment vertices; each in-plane shear-vector segment lies inside the convex hull of its endpoints, so vertex-based maximum chord and minimum-enclosing-circle radii are exact for this reconstructed path. This establishes interpolation-conditional FS/SWT factor extrema, not fidelity to unknown physical behavior, continuous-plane search, multiaxial rainflow pairing, variable-amplitude damage, life or material validation.

## `fatigue.critical_plane_projected_rainflow`

The caller supplies ordered multiaxial stress/strain tensors, finite plane frames, explicit scalar projection choices, path boundary, tensor basis and interpretation reviews. Rainflow is applied independently to each declared scalar projection; residual excursions remain half cycles and cycle endpoints retain caller sample identities. No cross-projection pairing, multiaxial damage parameter, life, closure correction, continuous-plane search, acceptance or probability is inferred.

## `fatigue.critical_plane_time_refinement`

The caller supplies one reviewed cycle at two or more strictly increasing nested time samplings, a fixed finite plane set and explicit time-match and diagnostic tolerances. Every level uses the sampled maximum-pairwise shear-vector chord. Factor and selected-plane changes isolate temporal sampling only within the fixed candidate set. Meeting a declared diagnostic tolerance does not bound extrema between samples or prove continuous-time/orientation convergence, fatigue-life calibration, acceptance or experimental validity.

구현 근거:

- `critical_plane_vector_chord_projection`: For each caller-declared orthonormal plane frame, independently project the symmetric tensor path onto two in-plane shear directions. Form the exact maximum pairwise Euclidean chord of the sampled engineering-shear vectors and use half that named chord as a discrete amplitude. The Euclidean result is invariant to rotation or reversal of the supplied in-plane basis. Preserve chord endpoint sample identities and distinguish this O(n squared) sampled-path definition from continuous-time extrema, a minimum enclosing circle, rainflow extraction, continuous plane optimization, fatigue-life calibration and acceptance.
- `critical_plane_time_refinement_diagnostic`: Hold one finite plane set fixed while evaluating explicitly ordered, strictly increasing and time-nested samplings of the same reviewed tensor cycle. Record each sampling interval, discrete FS/SWT maxima, selected unoriented normals and successive relative-factor and acute-plane-angle changes. Nested sampled histories and satisfied caller tolerances do not bound extrema between samples, prove temporal or orientation convergence, qualify fatigue life or establish experimental validity.

## `fatigue.critical_plane_vector_path_factors`

The caller supplies a reviewed closed representative local cycle as aligned symmetric Cauchy-stress and small-strain tensors, using tensor rather than engineering shear components. Each caller-supplied orthonormal plane frame defines a two-dimensional in-plane shear-vector path; amplitude is half its maximum sampled pairwise Euclidean chord. The finite sampled path and finite plane set do not qualify continuous-time extrema, a minimum-enclosing-circle method, continuous orientation optimization or fatigue-life calibration.

- [Fatemi and Socie, critical-plane fatigue approach including out-of-phase loading](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1460-2695.1988.tb01169.x) (`fatemi_socie_1988`)
- [Smith, Watson and Topper, stress-strain fatigue function with mean-stress effect](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/309476268_A_stress-strain_function_for_the_fatigue_of_metals_stress-strain_function_for_metal_fatigue_including_mean_stress_effect) (`smith_watson_topper_1970`)
- `critical_plane_vector_chord_projection`: For each caller-declared orthonormal plane frame, independently project the symmetric tensor path onto two in-plane shear directions. Form the exact maximum pairwise Euclidean chord of the sampled engineering-shear vectors and use half that named chord as a discrete amplitude. The Euclidean result is invariant to rotation or reversal of the supplied in-plane basis. Preserve chord endpoint sample identities and distinguish this O(n squared) sampled-path definition from continuous-time extrema, a minimum enclosing circle, rainflow extraction, continuous plane optimization, fatigue-life calibration and acceptance.

## `fatigue.crossland_proportional_miner_campaign`

Each block is evaluated by the finite proportional Crossland screen and bounded same-condition caller life curve. Block damage is cycle_count divided by mapped life; complete campaign damage is a linear Miner sum. No cycle extraction, extrapolation, sequence correction, probability, acceptance, or qualification is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `analysis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_definition_id` | 예 | `{"const": "crossland_1956_sqrtj2amplitude_plus_alpha_peak_hydrostatic.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `life_curve_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `curve_source_id` | 예 | `{"const": "caller_crossland_parameter_constant_amplitude_life_curve", "type": "string"}` |
| `curve_source_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `curve_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `curve_license_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `condition_descriptor_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `curve_hydrostatic_coefficient_alpha` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `parameter_points_Pa` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `cycles_to_failure` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `blocks` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CrosslandProportionalBlock"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `miner_damage_threshold` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `material_test_and_condition_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `curve_rights_and_use_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `cycle_decomposition_and_linear_miner_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `block_damage_ledger[].crossland_parameter_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `block_damage_ledger[].cycles_to_failure` | `cycle` |
| `block_damage_ledger[].miner_damage` | `1` |
| `total_miner_damage` | `1` |
| `repeat_units_to_damage_threshold` | `campaign_repeat` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crossland_finite_proportional_limit_calibration`: Evaluate the caller-provided Crossland beta and alpha against the maximum sampled hydrostatic stress and proportional deviatoric stress-path amplitude only after a finite tensor path passes the declared proportionality tolerance. Require same-material calibration Evidence and support; do not infer calibration parameters, unsampled extrema, fatigue life or qualification.
- `caller_crossland_parameter_constant_amplitude_life_curve`: Map finite proportional Crossland parameters to caller-supplied same-condition cycle-life data using bounded log-log interpolation, then sum explicitly caller-counted blocks with the linear Miner rule. Do not count cycles, extrapolate, infer sequence effects, probability, or qualified service life.
- [Crossland, B. Effect of large hydrostatic pressures on the torsional fatigue strength of an alloy steel (1956); bibliographic citation verified in a peer-reviewed multiaxial fatigue validation article.](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7795696/) (`crossland_1956_hydrostatic_pressure_torsional_fatigue_criterion`)

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.cyclic_response_relative_error`

Caller-supplied observed/predicted mean and amplitude arrays share strict cycle alignment, explicit positive normalization and a predeclared experiment set. The default 0.6/0.4 balance is configurable and experiment-level averaging prevents unequal trace lengths from changing experiment weights.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `series` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CyclicResponseSeries"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `mean_weight` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.6, "maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `amplitude_weight` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.4, "maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `experiment_count` | `1` |
| `mean_weight` | `1` |
| `amplitude_weight` | `1` |
| `aggregate_weighted_relative_error` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "series": [
    {
      "experiment_id": "synthetic-lcf-1",
      "cycle": [
        1,
        10
      ],
      "observed_mean": [
        10000000.0,
        9000000.0
      ],
      "predicted_mean": [
        11000000.0,
        8500000.0
      ],
      "observed_amplitude": [
        200000000.0,
        180000000.0
      ],
      "predicted_amplitude": [
        190000000.0,
        170000000.0
      ],
      "mean_normalizer": 10000000.0,
      "amplitude_normalizer": 200000000.0
    }
  ],
  "mean_weight": 0.6,
  "amplitude_weight": 0.4
}
```

구현 근거:

- [FABEST in LCF official rules and task description](https://faber-cost.eu/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Assignment_FABEST_LCF_FINAL.pdf) (`fabest_lcf_rules_2026`)
- `normalized_absolute_error`: For each predeclared experiment, divide aligned absolute mean and amplitude residuals by separate caller-supplied positive scales, combine them with nonnegative weights summing to one, average over that experiment's supplied cycles and then average experiments equally. Never infer a possibly zero normalizer, resample cycle histories or treat the score as model validity.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_dang_van_finite_parameter_life_curve`: Interpolate a caller-owned same-condition finite Dang Van parameter versus cycles-to-failure curve in log-log coordinates only inside strictly monotone observed support. No universal life equation, extrapolation, cycle counting or variable-amplitude damage is asserted.
- `caller_finite_shear_hydrostatic_dang_van_limit_screen`: Apply a caller-calibrated Dang Van-style high-cycle limit screen on an explicit finite set of oriented material shear systems and time samples. Center each resolved shear history by its caller-clock trapezoidal mean, combine its maximum absolute centered value with instantaneous hydrostatic stress through the caller coefficient, and compare with the same-condition caller limit. Preserve sample timing, system population, Evidence and calibration digest; do not infer continuous plane/time extrema, fatigue life, probability, acceptance or qualification.

## `fatigue.dang_van_finite_sample_limit_screen`

Uses the published Dang Van high-cycle form combining centered shear stress history and instantaneous hydrostatic stress, restricted to caller-declared finite shear systems and time samples. Shear mean is a trapezoidal time average on the caller clock; material coefficient and limit, plane population and applicability are caller supplied with matching Evidence. The deterministic finite-set comparison is not a continuous plane search, fatigue-life estimate, probability, code acceptance or qualification.

## `fatigue.dynamic_modulus_drop_endpoint`

Caller supplies a strictly ordered compressive-branch dynamic-modulus history, explicit reference modulus, loss threshold and closed/open observation-window state. The default reports the first observed crossing; between-sample interpolation requires an explicit policy and a descending bracket.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `test_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `cycle` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `compressive_dynamic_modulus_Pa` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `reference_dynamic_modulus_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `drop_fraction_threshold` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMaximum": 1.0, "exclusiveMinimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `crossing_policy` | 아니오 | `{"default": "first_observed_sample", "enum": ["first_observed_sample", "linear_between_samples"], "type": "string"}` |
| `observation_window_closed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `reference_dynamic_modulus_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `threshold_dynamic_modulus_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `drop_fraction_threshold` | `1` |
| `endpoint_cycle` | `cycle` |
| `last_observed_cycle` | `cycle` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "test_id": "synthetic-modulus-loss",
  "cycle": [
    1.0,
    100.0,
    500.0
  ],
  "compressive_dynamic_modulus_Pa": [
    210000000000.0,
    200000000000.0,
    185000000000.0
  ],
  "reference_dynamic_modulus_Pa": 210000000000.0,
  "drop_fraction_threshold": 0.1,
  "crossing_policy": "linear_between_samples",
  "observation_window_closed": true
}
```

구현 근거:

- [FABEST in LCF official rules and task description](https://faber-cost.eu/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Assignment_FABEST_LCF_FINAL.pdf) (`fabest_lcf_rules_2026`)
- `dynamic_modulus_endpoint`: Compare a strictly cycle-ordered compressive-branch dynamic-modulus history with a caller-declared positive reference times one minus a caller-declared loss fraction. Report the first observed threshold crossing or, only under an explicit policy, a linear interpolation inside its first descending bracket. A closed no-crossing history remains right-censored; an open window remains incomplete.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.hemisphere_plane_grid`

Unoriented planes are sampled on a deterministic upper-hemisphere latitude-azimuth grid; exact pole and equatorial sign duplicates are removed. The grid is finite and non-equal-area. Its angular increments are metadata, not a coverage-error bound or proof of convergence.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `grid_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `polar_divisions` | 예 | `{"minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |
| `azimuthal_divisions` | 예 | `{"minimum": 4, "type": "integer"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `candidate_count` | `1` |
| `polar_divisions` | `1` |
| `azimuthal_divisions` | `1` |
| `polar_step_rad` | `rad` |
| `azimuthal_step_rad` | `rad` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "grid_id": "example-hemisphere-grid",
  "polar_divisions": 4,
  "azimuthal_divisions": 12
}
```

구현 근거:

- `hemisphere_plane_grid_derivation`: Represent each unoriented material plane once by a unit normal on the closed upper hemisphere. Sample polar latitude uniformly from the pole through the equator and azimuth uniformly around intermediate latitudes; retain one pole and half the equatorial azimuths to remove exact n versus minus-n duplicates. Construct a deterministic in-plane unit direction from the least-aligned Cartesian axis. This finite latitude-azimuth grid is not equal-area and its nominal angular increments are not a coverage-error bound, convergence proof or continuous optimum.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_itoh_nonproportional_miner_block_decomposition`: Use caller-declared ordered finite cycle blocks and nonnegative integer repetition counts. Recompute each block's Itoh parameter and bounded same-condition strain-life mapping, then accumulate only through the existing linear Miner rule after every block maps successfully. Require identical material condition, strain definition, shear convention, alpha calibration and licensed curve digests across blocks. No cycle extraction, sequence interaction, probability, acceptance or remaining-life qualification is inferred.
- `caller_itoh_nonproportional_strain_life_curve`: Map a digest-bound Itoh adjusted strain parameter to cycle life using a caller-supplied same-condition, licensed, monotonically decreasing strain-life curve. Preserve exact material/strain-definition and curve Evidence; interpolate log-log only within support and fail closed outside it. No cycle counting, damage accumulation, material transfer or qualification is inferred.
- `caller_itoh_nonproportional_hardening_calibration`: Combine a caller-supplied principal-strain range and same-condition nonproportional hardening coefficient with a finite sampled strain-path factor for one reviewed closed cycle. Retain sample order, clock, tensor convention, calibration Evidence and digest. This parameter does not count cycles, map life, accumulate damage or qualify material response.
- [T. Itoh et al., Nonproportional Low Cycle Fatigue Criterion for Type 304 Stainless Steel (1995)](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.2804541) (`itoh_1995_nonproportional_low_cycle_fatigue_criterion`)

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.itoh_nonproportional_strain_life`

A finite sampled Itoh non-proportional strain parameter is recomputed from the nested pinned history. Life calibration must match the exact material condition and strain-definition identifier and is interpolated only inside its supplied support. No extrapolation, cycle counting, variable-amplitude damage accumulation, uncertainty or material qualification is performed.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `analysis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_request` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/ItohNonproportionalStrainRequest"}` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_itoh_nonproportional_strain_life_curve`: Map a digest-bound Itoh adjusted strain parameter to cycle life using a caller-supplied same-condition, licensed, monotonically decreasing strain-life curve. Preserve exact material/strain-definition and curve Evidence; interpolate log-log only within support and fail closed outside it. No cycle counting, damage accumulation, material transfer or qualification is inferred.
- `caller_itoh_nonproportional_hardening_calibration`: Combine a caller-supplied principal-strain range and same-condition nonproportional hardening coefficient with a finite sampled strain-path factor for one reviewed closed cycle. Retain sample order, clock, tensor convention, calibration Evidence and digest. This parameter does not count cycles, map life, accumulate damage or qualify material response.
- [T. Itoh et al., Nonproportional Low Cycle Fatigue Criterion for Type 304 Stainless Steel (1995)](https://doi.org/10.1115/1.2804541) (`itoh_1995_nonproportional_low_cycle_fatigue_criterion`)

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.itoh_nonproportional_strain_parameter`

The evaluated factor is a trapezoidal approximation over the caller-provided samples and clocks for one exactly closed cycle. The maximum-principal-strain range and non-proportional hardening coefficient are caller-supplied, evidence-pinned and specific to the declared material condition. A non-unique principal axis requires an explicit review; equal tensile/compressive magnitudes use the positive extreme only as a declared computational tie convention. The result is a strain parameter only; no cycle counting, strain-life mapping, damage accumulation or qualification is inferred.

| `history_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `strain_tensor_components` | 예 | `{"items": {"items": {"type": "number"}, "type": "array"}, "maxItems": 10001, "minItems": 4, "type": "array"}` |
| `sample_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 10001, "minItems": 4, "type": "array"}` |

| `period_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `strain_shear_convention` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^(tensor|engineering)$", "type": "string"}` |
| `tensor_component_order` | 아니오 | `{"default": ["xx", "yy", "zz", "xy", "yz", "zx"], "items": {"type": "string"}, "type": "array"}` |

## `fatigue.j2_armstrong_frederick_strain_history`

Uses a small-strain associative J2 yield surface and one backward-Euler Armstrong-Frederick backstress update per caller strain interval. Cyclic parameters, initial state, tensor basis and small-strain quasistatic applicability are caller supplied and reviewed. No rate effects, automatic substepping, multiple backstress components, fatigue damage, life or qualification is provided.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `analysis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `base_path` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/J2PragerStrainHistory"}` |
| `kinematic_modulus_Pa` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `dynamic_recovery_per_unit_equivalent_plastic_strain` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `parameter_source_id` | 아니오 | `{"default": "caller_single_backstress_armstrong_frederick_parameters", "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_record_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_evidence_source_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `parameter_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `parameters_and_model_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `response_history[].stress_tensor_components_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `response_history[].plastic_strain_tensor_components` | `1` |
| `response_history[].backstress_tensor_components_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `response_history[].equivalent_plastic_strain` | `1` |
| `response_history[].yield_function_residual_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `final_equivalent_plastic_strain` | `1` |
| `signed_trapezoidal_stress_strain_work_density_J_m3` | `J/m^3` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_single_backstress_armstrong_frederick_parameters`: Require caller-provided, evidence- and digest-bound single-backstress Armstrong-Frederick C and gamma parameters for a declared material condition. The parameter record is not a multi-backstress calibration or independent constitutive validation.
- `backward_euler_j2_armstrong_frederick_radial_return`: Integrate small-strain J2 elastoplastic response with one nonlinear Armstrong-Frederick backstress using backward-Euler radial return and a bracketed scalar consistency solve per supplied strain interval. It is not a general multi-backstress model and does not infer fatigue life or qualify a material.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.j2_prager_strain_history`

Six-component tensors use [xx, yy, zz, xy, yz, zx] order with tensor shear strain coordinates. Material parameters and the state at the first sample are caller supplied and require matching material applicability review. The constitutive response is not a fatigue damage, life, acceptance or qualification model.

## `fatigue.life_rmsle`

Caller supplies one positive observed and predicted life for every unique predeclared case; censoring is outside this metric.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `case_id` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `observed_cycles` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `predicted_cycles` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `logarithm_base` | 아니오 | `{"default": 10, "enum": [10, "e"]}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `case_count` | `1` |
| `root_mean_square_log_error` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "case_id": [
    "synthetic-life-1",
    "synthetic-life-2"
  ],
  "observed_cycles": [
    1000.0,
    5000.0
  ],
  "predicted_cycles": [
    1200.0,
    4500.0
  ],
  "logarithm_base": 10
}
```

구현 근거:

- [FABEST in LCF official rules and task description](https://faber-cost.eu/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Assignment_FABEST_LCF_FINAL.pdf) (`fabest_lcf_rules_2026`)
- `root_mean_square_log_error`: For a complete predeclared set of unique cases with positive observed and predicted lives, form one signed logarithmic residual per case and return the square root of their mean squared value. Preserve every residual and reject censored or missing outcomes rather than substituting a number.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

구현 근거:

- `mcdiarmid_shear_stress_critical_plane_1994`: Independently coded finite-sample screening implementation based on McDiarmid's 1994 critical-plane strength relation; no article data or prose is bundled.
- `caller_mcdiarmid_index_life_curve`: Caller-supplied same-condition monotone McDiarmid-index to life curve; interpolation is bounded to its tabulated support.
- `caller_ordered_multiaxial_cycle_block_counts`: Caller-supplied ordered load-block cycle counts and complete upstream screen results.
- `linear_miner_damage_rule_for_mcdiarmid_campaign`: Explicit linear cumulative damage assumption applied to caller-indexed life; sequence effects are not modeled.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.miner`

Linear accumulation omits load sequence and damage interaction; limit is explicitly declared.

| `cycles_to_failure` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

| 필드 | 단위 |

```json

  "cycle_counts": [
    100.0,
```

## `fatigue.morrow_strain_life`

Caller-calibrated uniaxial Morrow mean-stress correction to the elastic Basquin term of a strain-life relation. Tension-positive mean stress, material applicability and cycle-support reviews are explicit caller inputs. No variable-amplitude counting, multiaxial correction, notch solution, environment correction or code acceptance is inferred.

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |

| `strain_amplitude` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `mean_stress_Pa` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `elastic_modulus_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `fatigue_strength_coefficient_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `fatigue_strength_exponent` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMaximum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `fatigue_ductility_coefficient` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `fatigue_ductility_exponent` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMaximum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

## `fatigue.multiaxial_crossland_proportional_limit_screen`

Uses the maximum sampled hydrostatic stress and half-range of the collinear deviatoric path coordinate. Requires a finite closed proportional stress cycle within the caller-declared absolute residual tolerance. Uses caller-supplied same-condition Crossland coefficients and limit; no life, probability, acceptance, or qualification is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `analysis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `stress_history` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/SampledStressInvariantHistory"}` |
| `stress_history_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `calibration_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `calibration_source_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `calibration_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `calibration_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `calibration_material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `hydrostatic_coefficient_alpha` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `caller_limit_beta_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `proportionality_tolerance_Pa` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `coefficients_and_limit_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `calibration_material_and_scope_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `proportional_path_assumption_and_tolerance_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `maximum_pair_evaluations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 2000000, "maximum": 20000000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `sqrt_J2_stress_amplitude_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `maximum_hydrostatic_stress_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `crossland_parameter_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `caller_limit_beta_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `margin_to_caller_limit_Pa` | `Pa` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crossland_finite_proportional_limit_calibration`: Evaluate the caller-provided Crossland beta and alpha against the maximum sampled hydrostatic stress and proportional deviatoric stress-path amplitude only after a finite tensor path passes the declared proportionality tolerance. Require same-material calibration Evidence and support; do not infer calibration parameters, unsampled extrema, fatigue life or qualification.
- [Crossland, B. Effect of large hydrostatic pressures on the torsional fatigue strength of an alloy steel (1956); bibliographic citation verified in a peer-reviewed multiaxial fatigue validation article.](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7795696/) (`crossland_1956_hydrostatic_pressure_torsional_fatigue_criterion`)

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.multiaxial_deviatoric_stress_path_variation`

Finite path variation is the sum of adjacent-sample increments; deviatoric increments use sqrt(J2) distance. The exact caller sample order and closed cycle are preserved; no interpolation, cycle counting, or damage conversion is inferred. The output is a path descriptor and not a fatigue criterion, life, probability, acceptance decision, or qualification.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `analysis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `stress_history` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/SampledStressInvariantHistory"}` |
| `stress_history_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `maximum_increment_evaluations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 10000, "maximum": 100000, "minimum": 2, "type": "integer"}` |
| `closed_path_and_basis_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `path_sampling_scope_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `deviatoric_path_variation_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `hydrostatic_path_variation_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `maximum_single_segment_deviatoric_increment_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `maximum_single_segment_hydrostatic_increment_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `deviatoric_segment_increments_Pa[]` | `Pa` |
| `hydrostatic_segment_increments_Pa[]` | `Pa` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_finite_tensor_stress_path_variation`: Sum Euclidean increments in deviatoric five-dimensional stress space using sqrt(J2) distance, and separately sum absolute hydrostatic-stress increments over an ordered closed finite tensor record. Preserve each segment descriptor; do not infer interpolated extrema, cycles, damage or life.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.multiaxial_invariant_limit_screen`

Requires caller-reviewed coefficients, reference limit, calibration lineage and exact material-condition match; it does not estimate calibration parameters. Uses only the nested finite-sample maximum hydrostatic stress and half maximum pairwise deviatoric sqrt(J2) distance; no interpolation or unsampled-path correction is applied. The outcome is a deterministic comparison to a caller limit, not fatigue life, probability, code acceptance or material qualification.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_finite_sample_multiaxial_invariant_limit_screen`: Evaluate a caller-calibrated linear combination of finite-sample maximum hydrostatic stress and half maximum pairwise deviatoric sqrt(J2) distance, then compare it with a caller-supplied same-condition limit. Preserve calibration Evidence/digest and require explicit coefficient, material-scope and use review. This deterministic descriptor-to-limit screen does not interpolate unsampled paths or establish fatigue life, probability, code acceptance or qualification.

구현 근거:

- `multiaxial_cycle_life_composition`: Compose the declared closed local tensor cycle, finite supplied plane factors and caller material-matched FS or SWT strain-life coefficients. Keep directional, pairwise-chord and enclosing-circle shear ranges explicit and retain exactly tied sampled planes. Root finding is restricted to calibrated cycle support; no continuous optimum, rainflow, nonproportional qualification or acceptance is inferred.
- `caller_shear_normal_strain_curve_life`: For each caller-supplied finite plane, combine nonnegative shear-strain amplitude with caller-weighted normal-strain amplitude. Select the largest declared parameter, retain exact sampled ties, and interpolate log(cycles) against log(parameter) only between ordered, same-condition caller calibration points. Bind ordered curve and full calibration digests and point-level source records. This is a generic independently authored user-curve mapping, not a claim to reproduce a named criterion; do not extrapolate or infer calibration rights, continuous-plane extrema, path-sensitive law, qualification or acceptance.
- `kandil_brown_miller_curve_life`: For each supplied finite plane, obtain sampled shear-strain range from the maximum pairwise chord of the in-plane engineering-shear vector path. Restrict the KBM parameter to planes tied for the largest sampled shear range, then combine shear-strain amplitude with a caller-calibrated coefficient times the full normal-strain range on that plane. Map only by bounded log-log interpolation on an ordered, same-condition caller life curve and bind curve/calibration digests plus point-level Evidence. This is a sampled, caller-calibrated implementation of the KBM parameter form; it does not imply a continuous-plane optimum, universal coefficient, cycle counting, data rights, material qualification or acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

The envelope consumes only digest-pinned computed results from the registered multiaxial critical-plane life campaign. All scenarios share a calibration/material/support/context basis and remain complete joint cases; results are finite-set extrema, not probabilities or continuous bounds.

## `fatigue.multiaxial_mcdiarmid_finite_plane_limit_screen`

Every plane is evaluated from the caller finite stress sample set, with its sampled shear-traction path and maximum normal stress. The caller selects McDiarmid crack case A or B and supplies matching reversed torsion fatigue strength and tensile strength. No plane-grid convergence, interpolation between stress samples, fatigue life or qualification is inferred.

## `fatigue.multiaxial_power_law_life_transfer`

A positive weighted log-linear relation between paired target and reference lives is fit at the exact fatigue parameter knots in a digest-pinned calibration audit. The reference curve is mapped only over the exact parameter support represented by the paired observations and must match their reference lives within a caller tolerance. The empirical transfer is specific to the declared material conditions and test contexts; it does not establish a material law or qualification.

## `fatigue.multiaxial_principal_stress_axis_rotation`

The six supplied components form symmetric stress tensors in [xx, yy, zz, xy, yz, zx] order. The largest algebraic principal axis is tracked as an unoriented line and requires a caller-selected eigenvalue-gap threshold. Only ordered finite samples are summarized; no interpolation or fatigue-damage/life model is implied.

| `minimum_relative_principal_gap` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1, "type": "number"}` |
| `tensor_basis_and_component_order_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `closed_cycle_and_sample_order_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|

| `total_axis_rotation_deg` | `degree` |
| `maximum_adjacent_rotation_rad` | `rad` |

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_finite_sample_principal_stress_axis_rotation_descriptor_nonproportional_loading`: Compute adjacent-sample angular travel of the largest algebraic principal-stress axis for symmetric tensors in the declared component order, treating eigenvector sign as equivalent. Require exact cycle closure and a caller threshold separating the largest eigenvalue from the second. The finite sampled kinematic descriptor does not reconstruct paths or predict fatigue damage, life, acceptance or qualification.

## `fatigue.multiaxial_sines_life_fit`

Fits a single log-log power relation by unweighted ordinary least squares to caller-declared uncensored failures. Each observation uses the same caller Sines coefficients and exact material condition with a distinct reviewed physical specimen. R-squared and residuals describe calibration only; independent validation, runout censoring and prediction intervals are not provided.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `campaign_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `tests` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/SinesLifeCalibrationTest"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 3, "type": "array"}` |
| `fit_source_id` | 아니오 | `{"default": "finite_sines_parameter_loglog_ordinary_least_squares", "type": "string"}` |
| `independent_specimen_identity_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `failure_endpoint_and_observation_rights_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `loglog_power_law_form_and_fit_domain_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `fitted_log_cycles_intercept_at_reference_parameter` | `1` |
| `fitted_loglog_exponent` | `1` |
| `reference_parameter_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `parameter_support_Pa[]` | `Pa` |
| `fit_r_squared_log_life` | `1` |
| `observations[].screening_parameter_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `observations[].observed_cycles_to_failure` | `cycle` |
| `observations[].fitted_cycles_to_failure` | `cycle` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_finite_sample_sines_mean_hydrostatic_limit_screen`: Evaluate a finite-sample invariant fatigue-limit descriptor from caller-reviewed closed tensor stress samples: combine the existing maximum-pairwise deviatoric sqrt(J2) half-distance with a trapezoidal time average of hydrostatic stress using explicit caller coefficients, then compare with a same-condition caller limit. Preserve calibration Evidence and scope review. This discretized screen does not establish a continuous-path criterion, life, probability, acceptance or qualification.
- `caller_multiaxial_sines_life_calibration_tests`: Use caller-reviewed, uncensored, same-condition specimen-level Sines parameter and cycles-to-failure records with explicit source group, Evidence, rights and independence review. These data do not themselves provide independent validation or runout treatment.
- `finite_sines_parameter_loglog_ordinary_least_squares`: Fit an ordinary least-squares line to log cycles versus log Sines parameter using a finite caller dataset after validating distinct specimens and common material/calibration conditions. Reject non-decreasing life fits; report fitted-data limitations and do not extrapolate or infer probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.multiaxial_sines_mean_limit_screen`

Uses caller-specified coefficients, limit and same-material calibration Evidence; no constants are inferred. Mean hydrostatic stress is the trapezoidal time average on supplied sample times; deviatoric amplitude is the finite sampled half pairwise sqrt(J2) diameter. This finite-sample comparison is not a continuous-path amplitude, life prediction, failure probability, acceptance decision or material qualification.

| `calibration_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `calibration_source_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `calibration_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `calibration_evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `calibration_material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
