## `fatigue.multiaxial_sines_parameter_life`

Uses a caller Sines-style finite-sample parameter screen and a same-material-condition caller life curve. Life is mapped by piecewise log-log interpolation strictly inside the observed parameter support. The nested parameter convention uses finite sampled deviatoric half-diameter and piecewise-linear time-average hydrostatic stress. No cycle counting, variable-amplitude damage, sequence effect, probability, acceptance or qualification is inferred.

| `life_curve_material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `life_curve_rights_and_condition_match_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|

| `cycles_to_failure` | `cycle` |
| `curve_parameter_support_Pa[]` | `Pa` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_finite_sample_sines_mean_hydrostatic_limit_screen`: Evaluate a finite-sample invariant fatigue-limit descriptor from caller-reviewed closed tensor stress samples: combine the existing maximum-pairwise deviatoric sqrt(J2) half-distance with a trapezoidal time average of hydrostatic stress using explicit caller coefficients, then compare with a same-condition caller limit. Preserve calibration Evidence and scope review. This discretized screen does not establish a continuous-path criterion, life, probability, acceptance or qualification.
- `caller_sines_parameter_constant_amplitude_life_curve`: Map a caller-calibrated finite Sines-style mean-stress fatigue parameter to same-condition constant-amplitude life data with evidence and digest binding, using log-log interpolation only within observed support. Do not extrapolate or infer cycle counting, damage accumulation or qualification.
- `finite_sines_parameter_loglog_life_interpolation`: Apply bounded two-point log-log interpolation on a strictly monotone finite Sines-parameter cycle-life curve; reject requests outside support and preserve the computed parameter and source lineage.

Optionally calculate caller-reviewed left-continuous weighted inverse-ECDF quantiles, exact lower-tail weighted means using fractional boundary-scenario mass, and weighted scenario mass at or below explicit cycle-life thresholds, with the number of matched scenarios; scenario identities remain available in the shared digest-pinned life table. Sort once and use cumulative weights plus binary search for bounded query cost. Bind the ordered weight vector to provider/revision/Evidence/rights, require sum-to-one without normalization, and retain life-result witnesses. Quantiles and threshold masses describe only the declared finite scenario set; threshold mass is not failure probability. Do not infer event probability, confidence, distribution tails, or a continuous life bound.

## `fatigue.neuber_notch_strain_amplitude`

Caller-reviewed scalar uniaxial nominal stress amplitude, elastic concentration factor, modulus and stabilized cyclic Ramberg–Osgood parameters are required. The bounded bisection solution estimates local strain amplitude only; multiaxiality, residual stress, cyclic transients, notch gradients, fatigue life and acceptance are outside scope.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `nominal_stress_amplitude_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `elastic_stress_concentration_factor` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "minimum": 1.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `elastic_modulus_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `cyclic_strength_coefficient_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `cyclic_strain_hardening_exponent` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `all_inputs_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `max_iterations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 100, "maximum": 200, "minimum": 10, "type": "integer"}` |
| `relative_tolerance` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-12, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1e-06, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `local_stress_amplitude_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `local_strain_amplitude` | `1` |
| `elastic_strain_amplitude` | `1` |
| `plastic_strain_amplitude` | `1` |
| `neuber_target_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `neuber_product_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `relative_neuber_residual` | `1` |
| `iterations` | `1` |
| `converged` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "nominal_stress_amplitude_Pa": 100000000.0,
  "elastic_stress_concentration_factor": 2.0,
  "elastic_modulus_Pa": 200000000000.0,
  "cyclic_strength_coefficient_Pa": 1000000000.0,
  "cyclic_strain_hardening_exponent": 0.2,
  "all_inputs_reviewed": true
}
```

구현 근거:

- `neuber_local_strain_compatibility`: For a caller-reviewed scalar elastic stress concentration factor Kt and nominal stress amplitude S, solve sigma times epsilon = Kt squared times S squared divided by E. The local stabilized cyclic strain is sigma/E plus (sigma/K-prime) raised to 1/n-prime. The implementation brackets the positive root and applies deterministic bisection; it does not infer Kt, material calibration or fatigue life.
- `ramberg_osgood_cyclic_relation`: Use the caller-supplied stabilized cyclic strength coefficient K-prime, exponent n-prime and elastic modulus to partition local strain amplitude into elastic and plastic components. This relation alone does not establish material applicability, transient history, multiaxial response or life.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `fatigue.papadopoulos_p1_calibration`

Uses caller-supplied fully reversed axial and torsional endurance limits from a matched material condition and smooth-specimen basis. Derives only the P1 hydrostatic coefficient; it does not assess multiaxial history or fatigue life. Negative derived coefficients are outside the paired nonnegative P1 finite-screen contract and are reported out of scope.

The result is a finite-sample high-cycle limit screen, not a finite-life prediction or material qualification.

## `fatigue.papadopoulos_p2_finite_sample_limit_screen`

The Papadopoulos P2 structure combines a critical-plane generalized shear amplitude with maximum hydrostatic stress; the implementation uses only caller-supplied finite planes and finite direction quadrature. Material coefficient, limit, plane population, angular weights and application scope are caller supplied and reviewed; no material data or continuous search is inferred. The finite sample/plane/direction result is a deterministic screen, not life, probability, code acceptance or qualification.

구현 근거:

- `caller_finite_quadrature_papadopoulos_p2_limit_screen`: Evaluate a finite-quadrature Papadopoulos P2-style deterministic fatigue-limit screen from caller-provided orthonormal material planes and normalized in-plane shear directions. At each requested direction compute the signed resolved-shear half-range and a weighted quadratic generalized amplitude, combine its governing plane value with the maximum sampled hydrostatic stress using a caller coefficient, then compare with a same-condition caller limit. Preserve the finite quadrature and calibration lineage; do not claim continuous angular optimization, fatigue life, probability or qualification.

## `fatigue.periodic_fourier_tensor_work`

Net work is not identified as plastic dissipation or mapped to fatigue damage or life.

## `fatigue.periodic_tensor_fourier_reconstruction`

Uses full-bandwidth trigonometric interpolation on a uniformly sampled, exactly closed periodic tensor cycle. All harmonic coefficients are derived from the caller's finite samples without filtering or extrapolating beyond the period. Interpolation is a path reconstruction option only and does not by itself establish stress-strain damage, life or qualification.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|

| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `source_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `source_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}` |
| `sample_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 4097, "minItems": 4, "type": "array"}` |
| `stress_tensor_components_Pa` | 예 | `{"items": {"items": {"type": "number"}, "type": "array"}, "maxItems": 4097, "minItems": 4, "type": "array"}` |
| `strain_tensor_components` | 예 | `{"items": {"items": {"type": "number"}, "type": "array"}, "maxItems": 4097, "minItems": 4, "type": "array"}` |
| `evaluation_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 100000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `evaluation_phase_rad` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 100000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `input_strain_shear_convention` | 예 | `{"enum": ["tensor", "engineering"], "type": "string"}` |
| `maximum_trigonometric_term_work` | 아니오 | `{"default": 2000000, "maximum": 20000000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |
| `tensor_basis_and_order_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `uniform_periodic_sampling_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `closed_cycle_and_path_order_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `fourier_reconstruction_and_aliasing_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `evaluation_points[].stress_tensor_components_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `evaluation_points[].strain_tensor_components` | `1` |
| `evaluation_points[].phase_rad` | `rad` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_uniform_periodic_real_trigonometric_tensor_interpolation`: Construct the full-bandwidth real trigonometric interpolant of uniformly sampled, exactly closed caller tensor cycles, including the even-grid Nyquist term, and evaluate requested phases. Preserve tensor components and phase lineage. Uniform periodic sampling and suitability are caller-reviewed; no filtering, anti-aliasing, interpolation error bound or fatigue law is inferred.
- [Trefethen, Spectral Methods in MATLAB (Fourier interpolation and trigonometric polynomials)](https://doi.org/10.1137/1.9780898719598) (`trefethen_spectral_methods_fourier_interpolation`)

## `fatigue.pressurized_annulus_load_state`

Long homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic annulus with static pressure, nominal axial force and Saint-Venant torsion; end, notch, fixture, residual-stress and inelastic effects are excluded. The caller declares the reference section, load case, pressure evaluation radius, end condition and axial-torsion phase; no fatigue-life or strength relationship is inferred.

| `torque_amplitude_N_m` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `axial_torsion_phase_rad` | 예 | `{"maximum": 6.283185307179586, "minimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `internal_pressure_Pa` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `external_pressure_Pa` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.0, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `closed_ends` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |

| `polar_second_moment_m4` | `m^4` |
| `external_axial_mean_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `external_axial_amplitude_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `external_axial_minimum_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `external_axial_maximum_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `torsional_shear_mean_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `torsional_shear_amplitude_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `torsional_shear_minimum_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `torsional_shear_maximum_Pa` | `Pa` |

```json

  "reference_section_id": "synthetic-net-annulus",

구현 근거:

- `annular_section_equilibrium`: Nominal axial stress is force divided by annular area and Saint-Venant torsional shear is torque times radius divided by the annular polar second moment; geometry and loads are supplied by the caller.

## `fatigue.propose_critical_plane_interval_overlap_pairing`

Deterministic continuous-capacity bipartite min-cost max-flow proposal over overlapping sample-index intervals; maximize paired cycle count, then allocated-count-weighted interval IoU. The proposed map is not a physical pairing law; caller review and explicit unallocated-cycle treatment are required before a calibrated damage calculation.

| `plane_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `method_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `configuration_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `same_ordered_sample_clock_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `maximum_cycle_pair_work` | 아니오 | `{"default": 2000000, "maximum": 20000000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |
| `maximum_flow_augmentations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 100000, "maximum": 1000000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |

| `normal_unallocated_cycle_count` | `cycle` |

Return unallocated counts and exact lineage. ## `fatigue.sampled_tensor_stress_strain_work_cycle`

| `strain_history_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `sample_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 50000, "minItems": 3, "type": "array"}` |

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_wang_brown_parameter_constant_amplitude_life_data`: Fit a log-log power law by ordinary least squares from at least three distinct caller constant-amplitude tests of the same finite Wang-Brown-style parameter and material condition. Restrict predictions to observed parameter support; no variable-amplitude accumulation or universal life law is inferred.
- `wang_brown_1993_path_independent_multiaxial_strain_parameter`: For caller-selected finite shear-direction planes and one reviewed closed-cycle reversal arc, combine engineering-shear half-range with a caller-calibrated normal-strain excursion parameter and report the largest sampled candidate. This does not detect/count cycles, interpolate unsampled extrema, search a continuous plane, map to life, transfer calibration, or qualify a material.

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_parameterized_engineering_correlation_arithmetic`: Independently evaluate explicit caller-parameterized displacement-stress variants, dimensionally declared 2D/3D cooling correlations, affine moisture/hydrogen estimation and coupling/thread pressure arithmetic. Require full input/coefficient record hashes, licensed Evidence and applicability review. All empirical and standard-dependent coefficients are caller inputs; no proprietary parameter/grade/shape-factor tables, automatic method eligibility, rounding or qualification is bundled. Cooling dimensional structure is cross-checked against Bjork et al. 2023, https://doi.org/10.1007/s40194-023-01483-w; no prose or figures copied.

- [ASTM E647-24 fatigue crack growth rate test-method scope](https://store.astm.org/standards/e647) (`astm_e647_scope`)
- `tabulated_growth_interpolation_derivation`: Preserve a caller-authorized positive da/dN-versus-delta-K table, material condition, environment, stress ratio, frequency, source digest and applicability review. Interpolate linearly only between adjacent points in log(delta K)-log(da/dN) coordinates. For a reviewed nondecreasing geometry-factor table and ordered tensile blocks, integrate dN=da/(da/dN) within the curve support, split at geometry and curve knots, and invert the monotone cycle integral for depth. Keep curve support, maximum-K toughness and declared depth terminations distinct; do not infer a threshold, extrapolate, fit a design curve, model closure or retardation, or create acceptance or failure probability.

For a reviewed nondecreasing geometry-factor table and ordered tensile blocks, integrate dN=da/(da/dN) within the curve support, split at geometry and curve knots, and invert the monotone cycle integral for depth. Keep curve support, maximum-K toughness and declared depth terminations distinct; do not infer a threshold, extrapolate, fit a design curve, model closure or retardation, or create acceptance or failure probability.
- `complete_crack_growth_scenario_ensemble`: Accept two or more caller-reviewed normalized weighted scenarios, each containing a complete deterministic single-curve or curve-family crack-growth input and its own joint source identity and digest. Require a common physical scope while allowing joint changes to individual curve points, curve-family composition, geometry knots, ordered load blocks, toughness and numerical controls. Preserve the canonical digest and result of every complete input. Form weighted moments, discrete inverse-CDF quantiles and declared-depth exceedance mass only when every scenario computes. Never generate, fit, normalize, interpolate between, discard or assign probabilities to scenarios, and never relabel their push-forward mass as a period first-failure probability, FTA basic-event probability, model-form validation, confidence bound or code acceptance result.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

- `joint_crack_growth_uncertainty_propagation`: Accept caller-reviewed normalized joint rows containing global multipliers for crack-growth rate, geometry factor, tensile stress and fracture toughness. Preserve sample identity, row weight, distribution and design identities, source digest and the declared dependence represented by each row. Evaluate every row through the unchanged deterministic model, then form weighted moments, discrete inverse-CDF quantiles and a declared-depth exceedance mass only when every row remains in scope. Never generate or refit samples, normalize weights, discard failures, or relabel the push-forward input-uncertainty probability as a period first-failure probability, observed frequency, FTA basic-event probability, confidence bound or model-form uncertainty.
- `crack_growth_uncertainty_convergence_diagnostic`: Compare two or more ordered caller-reviewed uncertainty sample designs for one distribution and one deterministic crack-growth input. Preserve every level, its source digest and its declared relationship to the prior level. For nested refinement, require strictly more rows and retain every prior sample identity and multiplier tuple while allowing normalized weights to change. Compare weighted mean, standard deviation, discrete quantiles and declared-depth exceedance mass using caller-reviewed tolerances and a positive physical depth scale. Never discard failed rows or levels, and never describe satisfied diagnostics as a convergence proof, error bound, sample-size guarantee, distribution validation, period failure probability or FTA basic-event probability.

- [ASTM E647-24 fatigue crack growth rate test-method scope](https://store.astm.org/standards/e647) (`astm_e647_scope`)
- `tabulated_growth_interpolation_derivation`: Preserve a caller-authorized positive da/dN-versus-delta-K table, material condition, environment, stress ratio, frequency, source digest and applicability review. Interpolate linearly only between adjacent points in log(delta K)-log(da/dN) coordinates. For a reviewed nondecreasing geometry-factor table and ordered tensile blocks, integrate dN=da/(da/dN) within the curve support, split at geometry and curve knots, and invert the monotone cycle integral for depth. Keep curve support, maximum-K toughness and declared depth terminations distinct; do not infer a threshold, extrapolate, fit a design curve, model closure or retardation, or create acceptance or failure probability.
- `tabulated_curve_family_selection_derivation`: Require every curve in a family to share one reviewed material condition and environment while retaining unique curve and source identities. For each ordered tensile block, compare stress ratio by absolute difference and frequency by relative difference against caller-declared tolerances. Select only the unique minimum normalized distance inside both tolerances; stop when no candidate or an equal-distance tie remains. Do not interpolate, average or fit across stress ratio, frequency, environment, material condition or source group.

## `geometry.rectilinear_thickness_map`

Cell edges define a rectilinear map in metres and matrix entries are cell-centred thicknesses in metres. Only observed cells contribute to thickness and signed net-loss summaries; no spatial interpolation is performed. Caller-selected four-neighbour or eight-neighbour threshold connectivity describes map geometry and supplies no acceptance, capacity, life or probability conclusion.

Missing cells are excluded from observations and never interpolated or assumed sound; geometry summaries are not structural acceptance or life predictions.

| `observed_fraction` | `1` |

구현 근거:

- `discrete_geometry`: Equal-area measured cells, missing-area accounting and explicit four-neighbour connectivity; no structural acceptance criteria.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.acoustic_emission_arrival_localization`

구현 근거:

- `weighted_constant_speed_acoustic_emission_localization`: Estimate one acoustic-emission source position and origin time by weighted nonlinear least squares from caller-reviewed multi-sensor arrival picks, fixed homogeneous isotropic wave speed, sensor geometry, clock and uncertainty evidence. Preserve calibration/holdout source partitions, rank and spatial support diagnostics without generating picks or wave speed, classifying mechanisms, grading damage, deciding acceptance, life, POD or probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.acoustic_emission_arrival_pick`

Caller-reviewed monotonic sample clock, waveform unit, immutable waveform digest and fixed windows. Threshold or AIC-family settings and preprocessing are explicit inputs, not inferred from outcomes. The result is one original-sample arrival pick and quality diagnostics, not an event classification.

입력 필드:

|---|---|---|

| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `acquisition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `clock_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `elapsed_time_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 8, "type": "array"}` |
| `signal_values` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 8, "type": "array"}` |
| `signal_unit_token` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `waveform_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `preprocessing` | 예 | `{"enum": ["none", "demean_baseline"], "type": "string"}` |

## `inspection.acoustic_emission_wave_speed_calibration`

Weighted linear calibration of arrival minus known emission time against known source-sensor distance. One homogeneous isotropic constant speed and one clock offset are fitted from calibration picks only. Physical specimens and source groups cannot cross calibration and holdout partitions.

Preserve sensor, channel, clock, specimen, source, calibration/holdout partitions, support and immutable digests; do not generate picks, infer anisotropy or dispersion, localize unknown sources, classify mechanisms, grade damage, decide acceptance, POD or probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.action_expected_loss`

One event, physical scope, horizon, survival conditioning and cost basis; every complete action retains an externally evaluated residual first-failure probability and reviewed additive costs; expectation is probability times conditional consequence plus action cost.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.inspection_action_expected_loss.v1", "default": "matintegrity.inspection_action_expected_loss.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `comparison_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `event_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `event_definition` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `horizon_start_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `horizon_end_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `conditioning` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `event_probability_meaning` | 예 | `{"const": "conditional_first_failure_in_period", "type": "string"}` |
| `probability_basis` | 예 | `{"enum": ["estimate", "upper_bound"], "type": "string"}` |
| `cost_basis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `currency_or_normalized_unit` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `failure_consequence_components` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/RiskCostComponent"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `candidates` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/InspectionActionRiskCandidate"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `cost_tie_absolute_tolerance` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.0, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `action_definitions_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `residual_probabilities_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `costs_and_consequences_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `decision_criterion_user_approved` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

- `inspection_action_expected_loss_definition`: For one reviewed event, physical scope, horizon, survival conditioning and common cost basis, preserve exactly one zero-action-cost baseline and one or more complete intervention alternatives. Every action retains its definition, effect-model identity, revision, input digest, residual conditional first-failure probability estimate and optional upper bound. Add reviewed action-cost components to residual event probability times reviewed conditional consequence components, compare point-estimate or complete upper-bound totals, and withhold arbitrary selection when totals tie within a caller-declared absolute tolerance. Do not infer action effectiveness, event probabilities, dependencies, costs, consequences, risk tolerance, resource feasibility, value of information, regulatory acceptance or validation of the supplied models.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 계산기는 선행 AssessmentResult를 받아 구성하는 모델이어서 독립 JSON 입력 대신 registry 실행을 포함한 합성 Python wiring example `examples/pressure_and_boil_off.py`를 제공한다. 예제 입력은 구조 연결 설명용 합성값이며 물성 검증 자료가 아니다.

구현 근거:

- `saturated_bath_boil_off_energy_balance`: Independent saturated-bath mass and latent-heat balance. Falling liquid level in a rigid vessel corrects escaping mass flow by 1/(1-rho_v/rho_l); constant-level saturated makeup uses no accumulation correction. See P. Lebrun, CERN/AT 2007-1, section 2.2 (https://www.cryogenicsociety.org/assets/docs/lebrun_intro_to_cryogenics.pdf). No numerical property or acceptance tables bundled.

구현 근거:

- `authored_caller_leak_campaign_quality_audit`: Aggregate caller-supplied traceable reference-leak responses, blanks, state identities, repeat groups, sequence, uncertainty or detection-threshold evidence. Compare only derived repeatability, drift, background and uncertainty descriptors with caller-authored criteria. Do not fit a leak calibration, infer detection probability, solve leak physics, apply a published acceptance table or claim physical qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.declared_impact_subsize_requirements`

Inputs, coefficients, unit conventions, applicability and use rights are caller-reviewed and digest-pinned. No standard parameter table, grade factor, automatic rule choice, rounding or procedure approval is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `basis` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CorrelationBasis"}` |

| `specimen_geometry_definition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `reference_required_mean_energy_J` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_required_individual_energy_J` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_test_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

| `linear_width_energy_requirement_scaling_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `temperature_table_interpolation_and_applicability_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_parameterized_engineering_correlation_arithmetic`: Independently evaluate explicit caller-parameterized displacement-stress variants, dimensionally declared 2D/3D cooling correlations, affine moisture/hydrogen estimation and coupling/thread pressure arithmetic. Require full input/coefficient record hashes, licensed Evidence and applicability review. All empirical and standard-dependent coefficients are caller inputs; no proprietary parameter/grade/shape-factor tables, automatic method eligibility, rounding or qualification is bundled. Cooling dimensional structure is cross-checked against Bjork et al. 2023, https://doi.org/10.1007/s40194-023-01483-w; no prose or figures copied.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.disposition_decision_tree`

One reviewed exhaustive mutually exclusive inspection-outcome partition over one event context; each branch supplies its probability, complete disposition, conditional residual first-failure probability and costs; finite expectations only.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.inspection_disposition_tree.v1", "default": "matintegrity.inspection_disposition_tree.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `tree_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `event_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `event_definition` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `horizon_start_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `horizon_end_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `conditioning` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `event_probability_meaning` | 예 | `{"const": "conditional_first_failure_in_period", "type": "string"}` |
| `inspection_action_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `inspection_action_label` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `inspection_action_definition` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `inspection_outcome_model_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `inspection_outcome_model_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `inspection_outcome_configuration_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `inspection_outcome_input_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `risk_model_structure_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `common_cause_group_ids` | 아니오 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "type": "array"}` |
| `cost_basis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `currency_or_normalized_unit` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `inspection_cost_components` | 아니오 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/RiskCostComponent"}, "type": "array"}` |
| `outcome_branches` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/InspectionDispositionOutcomeBranch"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |

| `outcome_partition_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `outcome_probabilities_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `disposition_definitions_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `disposition_effects_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `costs_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

출력 단위:

구현 근거:

- `inspection_disposition_tree_definition`: For one inspection action and one common event, scope, horizon, survival conditioning and cost basis, require a caller-reviewed mutually exclusive exhaustive outcome partition. Preserve every outcome probability, disposition identity and definition, disposition-effect model revision/configuration/input/result digests, conditional residual first-failure probability and additive disposition costs. Form only the finite probability-weighted expected disposition cost and residual event probability, then expose a digest-bound estimate-basis action candidate. Missing review gates withhold arithmetic and probabilities must sum to one within a caller tolerance. Do not infer branch probabilities from POD or false-call data, invent dispositions, produce confidence bounds, optimize a multi-period policy or claim regulatory acceptance.

## `inspection.file_homogeneous_fmc_tfm`

Numeric NPY storage, dtype, complete ordered-pair row manifest and a common sample clock are explicit and digest-bound. The caller confirms the file is immutable; full-file hashes and metadata are checked before and after reading, and each accessed row is checked. Every requested point and view must be inside the selected propagation and observed-clock scope; no partial image is published.

구현 근거:

- `finite_inspection_policy_path_generation_definition`: Expand a caller-reviewed finite policy definition over strictly ordered decision epochs. Require uniquely defined failure and nonfailure states, a complete initial distribution conditional on start survival, state-conditional observation distributions, one deterministic action for every observation, complete action definitions with model and cost identities, and state-action transition distributions. Every probability family must sum to one within a declared tolerance, failure consequence factors occur exactly on transitions into failure, and failure paths stop immediately. Enumerate every positive-probability path as the exact product of supplied table entries and preserve a digest of its full trace; omit only zero-probability branches. Stop with an explicit out-of-scope result before exceeding the caller path-count limit. Do not fit or infer states, observations, transitions, decisions, probabilities, costs or optimality, and do not treat reviewed tables as empirical validation.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

구현 근거:

- `finite_policy_probability_calibration_definition`: Estimate finite state-conditional observation probabilities and action-conditioned state-transition probabilities from caller-reviewed weighted records. Require explicit physical-state truth, inspection labels, action assignments, ordered transition intervals and immutable calibration or holdout membership. Reject any sequence or source group crossing between partitions. Apply only a caller-declared symmetric pseudocount, report unsupported conditioning rows instead of inventing them, and score untouched holdout records with multiclass Brier score and negative log likelihood. Preserve exactly zero holdout probabilities as a diagnostic rather than clipping them. Do not infer record independence, confidence intervals, state definitions, labels, actions, feature matching, physical truth, transition causality or field applicability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.flux_leakage_campaign_quality`

- `authored_electromagnetic_reference_campaign_quality_audit`: Aggregate caller-supplied eddy-current or magnetic-flux-leakage configuration identities, physical reference features, encoded scan digests, channel and extent coverage, staged checks, sensitivity, noise, resolution and drift. Compare only with caller-authored criteria. Do not process waveforms, size or accept flaws, estimate POD, reproduce published limits or claim physical qualification.

## `inspection.fracture_toughness_test_evidence`

Every record preserves material condition, specimen/source identity, geometry/orientation, test conditions, endpoint, unit and caller-supplied validity evidence. Provider revision and state/configuration/input/result digests are immutable lineage fields, not physical qualification. Partitions are caller-declared and no independence beyond enforced specimen and source-group separation is inferred.

## `inspection.gas_expansion_energy`

Ideal reversible adiabatic gas expansion; not a blast model or exclusion-distance determination.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `initial_absolute_pressure_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `final_absolute_pressure_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `initial_volume_m3` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `heat_capacity_ratio` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 1, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `ideal_expansion_work_J` | `J` |
| `final_volume_m3` | `m^3` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "initial_absolute_pressure_Pa": 1000000.0,
  "final_absolute_pressure_Pa": 100000.0,
  "initial_volume_m3": 0.1,
  "heat_capacity_ratio": 1.4
}
```

구현 근거:

- `ideal_gas_first_law`: Reversible adiabatic expansion work with constant heat-capacity ratio.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.gas_pressure_decay`

Known compressibility at both equilibrated endpoints and an explicit reporting reference state.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `rigid_volume_m3` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `initial_absolute_pressure_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `final_absolute_pressure_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `initial_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `final_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `initial_compressibility_factor` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `final_compressibility_factor` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `duration_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_pressure_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_compressibility_factor` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `fluid_id` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `property_provider_id` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `property_provider_version` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `property_state_digest` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `absolute_pressure_temperature_and_phase_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"type": "boolean"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `net_molar_outflow_mol_s` | `mol/s` |
| `reference_volume_outflow_m3_s` | `m^3/s` |
| `fluid_id` | `1` |
| `property_provider_id` | `1` |
| `property_provider_version` | `1` |
| `property_state_digest` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "rigid_volume_m3": 0.1,
  "initial_absolute_pressure_Pa": 1000000.0,
  "final_absolute_pressure_Pa": 990000.0,
  "initial_temperature_K": 300.0,
  "final_temperature_K": 300.0,
  "initial_compressibility_factor": 1.0,
  "final_compressibility_factor": 1.0,
  "duration_s": 3600.0,
  "reference_pressure_Pa": 100000.0,
  "reference_temperature_K": 300.0,
  "reference_compressibility_factor": 1.0
}
```

구현 근거:

- `gas_inventory_balance`: Endpoint molar inventories follow PV=ZnRT; pressure-rise throughput follows an isothermal rigid-volume balance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.guided_wave_pair_features`

One physical specimen, aligned provider distance grids and one declared spatial window; paired descriptors do not separate environmental change from damage.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `specimen_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `baseline_acquisition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `observation_acquisition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `frequency_Hz` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `wave_mode` | 예 | `{"enum": ["torsional", "flexural"], "type": "string"}` |
| `baseline_distance_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `baseline_voltage_V` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `observation_distance_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `observation_voltage_V` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `window_start_m` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `window_end_m` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `distance_match_tolerance_m` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.0, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `duplicate_distance_policy` | 아니오 | `{"default": "preserve_samples", "enum": ["preserve_samples", "mean_aligned_duplicates", "reject"], "type": "string"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `frequency_Hz` | `Hz` |
| `window_start_m` | `m` |
| `window_end_m` | `m` |
| `maximum_distance_grid_mismatch_m` | `m` |
| `baseline_rms_V` | `V` |
| `observation_rms_V` | `V` |
| `residual_rms_V` | `V` |
| `normalized_residual_rms` | `1` |
| `voltage_energy_ratio` | `1` |
| `correlation_coefficient` | `1` |
| `peak_absolute_difference_V` | `V` |
| `signed_mean_difference_V` | `V` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "specimen_id": "example-tube",
  "baseline_acquisition_id": "baseline-1",
  "observation_acquisition_id": "observation-1",
  "frequency_Hz": 14000.0,
  "wave_mode": "torsional",
  "baseline_distance_m": [
    0.0,
    0.5,
    1.0,
    1.5
  ],
  "baseline_voltage_V": [
    0.01,
    0.02,
    -0.01,
    -0.02
  ],
  "observation_distance_m": [
    0.0,
    0.5,
    1.0,
    1.5
  ],
  "observation_voltage_V": [
    0.012,
    0.018,
    -0.015,
    -0.018
  ],
  "window_start_m": 0.0,
  "window_end_m": 1.5,
  "distance_match_tolerance_m": 0.0,
  "duplicate_distance_policy": "preserve_samples"
}
```

구현 근거:

- `guided_wave_pair_feature_definition`: For one physical specimen, one frequency and one propagation-mode voltage channel, require separate baseline and observation acquisition identities and aligned nondecreasing provider distance grids. Select only the caller-declared inclusive spatial window without interpolation or sorting. Preserve or explicitly reject repeated distances, or average only contiguous aligned duplicate pairs under a named policy. Report raw RMS, paired residual RMS, normalized residual, energy ratio, correlation and peak/mean difference while retaining undefined normalized quantities for a zero baseline. These descriptive features do not identify machining steps, remaining thickness, defect geometry, POD, acceptance, life or failure probability, and a single baseline does not separate environmental, coupling and damage effects.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.guided_wave_reference_ensemble`

At least three explicitly selected same-specimen baseline acquisitions, one aligned observation and one spatial window; ensemble descriptors are not detection calibration or acceptance.

입력 필드:

| `baseline_selection_basis` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `wave_mode` | 예 | `{"enum": ["torsional", "flexural"], "type": "string"}` |
| `distance_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `baseline_voltage_V` | 예 | `{"items": {"items": {"type": "number"}, "type": "array"}, "minItems": 3, "type": "array"}` |
| `observation_distance_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `observation_voltage_V` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `window_start_m` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `window_end_m` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `distance_match_tolerance_m` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.0, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `duplicate_distance_policy` | 아니오 | `{"default": "preserve_samples", "enum": ["preserve_samples", "mean_aligned_duplicates", "reject"], "type": "string"}` |

출력 단위:

| `observation_to_leave_one_out_maximum_ratio` | `1` |
| `reference_observation_correlation` | `1` |
| `peak_absolute_difference_V` | `V` |
| `signed_mean_difference_V` | `V` |

구현 근거:

- `guided_wave_reference_ensemble_definition`: For one physical specimen, require at least three uniquely identified caller-selected baseline acquisitions plus a distinct observation, one exact frequency/mode channel, aligned nondecreasing provider distance grids, explicit source groups, selection basis, spatial window and repeated-distance policy. Form a pointwise mean or median reference, quantify baseline spread and leave-one-out residual RMS, then compare the observation with that reference without interpolation, sorting or probability conversion. These ratios describe the selected acquisition ensemble only; they are not an anomaly probability, POD, acceptance threshold, defect dimension, remaining thickness, life or failure probability, and repeated records from one specimen do not establish independent validation or separate coupling/environment effects from damage.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

구현 근거:

- `authored_wave_reference_baseline_campaign_quality_audit`: Aggregate caller-supplied acoustic-emission or guided-wave array, coupling, acquisition, baseline, observation, channel, coverage and reference-check evidence. Compare timing, amplitude, noise, localization and reference consistency only with caller-authored criteria. Do not detect or size damage, estimate POD, apply published acceptance limits or claim physical qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.hardness_reference_block_calibration`

One exact method, scale, indenter, load, dwell and instrument configuration is calibrated. Reference certificate standard uncertainty and caller weight enter the likelihood explicitly. Calibration and holdout block, source and independence groups are disjoint.

입력 필드:

## `inspection.hit_miss_pod`

Increasing logistic POD in log flaw size, independent hit/miss observations and profile-likelihood confidence inference.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `specimen_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 6, "type": "array"}` |
| `flaw_size_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 6, "type": "array"}` |
| `detected` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "boolean"}, "minItems": 6, "type": "array"}` |
| `query_sizes_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 100, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `target_probability` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMaximum": 1, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `confidence_level` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMaximum": 1, "exclusiveMinimum": 0.5, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_threshold_size_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `independent_trials_declared` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `target_size_estimate_m` | `m` |
| `target_size_upper_confidence_m` | `m` |
| `logistic_midpoint_size_m` | `m` |
| `logistic_log_size_scale` | `1` |
| `probability_of_detection` | `1` |
| `pointwise_lower_probability_of_detection` | `1` |
| `confidence_level` | `1` |
| `likelihood_ratio_cutoff` | `1` |

확률의 의미:

| 필드 | 의미 |
|---|---|
| `probability_of_detection` | `detection_given_flaw_and_procedure` |

```json

  "specimen_ids": [
    "pod-1",
    "pod-2",
    "pod-3",
    "pod-4",
    "pod-5",
    "pod-6"
  ],
  "flaw_size_m": [
    0.0005,
    0.0007,
    0.001,
    0.0014,
    0.002,
    0.003
  ],
  "detected": [
    false,
    true,
    false,
    true,
    false,
    true
  ],
  "query_sizes_m": [
    0.0007,
    0.0014,
    0.002
  ],

}

## `inspection.homogeneous_fmc_tfm`

All element and image coordinates share the explicit reviewed frame and material condition. Raw/sample hashes, clock, excitation origin, velocity basis and ordered transmit/receive membership are caller supplied and digest-bound. Every direct-path delay must be inside the common observed time support; reconstruction does not qualify an examination or infer a flaw.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `basis` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CorrelationBasis"}` |
| `acquisition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_specimen_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `source_group_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `probe_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `coordinate_frame_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `sample_clock_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_zero_basis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `velocity_basis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `raw_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `amplitude_unit` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `propagation_model` | 예 | `{"const": "homogeneous_isotropic_direct_longitudinal", "type": "string"}` |
| `aggregation` | 예 | `{"enum": ["coherent_sum", "coherent_mean"], "type": "string"}` |
| `excitation_time_origin_s` | 예 | `{"type": "number"}` |
| `longitudinal_velocity_m_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `time_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 32768, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `elements` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/FmcElement"}, "maxItems": 64, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `traces` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/FmcTimeTrace"}, "maxItems": 4096, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `image_points` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/TfmImagePoint"}, "maxItems": 4096, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `maximum_point_trace_evaluations` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1000000, "maximum": 10000000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|

| `image[].coherent_amplitude` | `caller_declared` |
| `point_trace_evaluations` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_parameterized_engineering_correlation_arithmetic`: Independently evaluate explicit caller-parameterized displacement-stress variants, dimensionally declared 2D/3D cooling correlations, affine moisture/hydrogen estimation and coupling/thread pressure arithmetic. Require full input/coefficient record hashes, licensed Evidence and applicability review. All empirical and standard-dependent coefficients are caller inputs; no proprietary parameter/grade/shape-factor tables, automatic method eligibility, rounding or qualification is bundled. Cooling dimensional structure is cross-checked against Bjork et al. 2023, https://doi.org/10.1007/s40194-023-01483-w; no prose or figures copied.

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_parameterized_engineering_correlation_arithmetic`: Independently evaluate explicit caller-parameterized displacement-stress variants, dimensionally declared 2D/3D cooling correlations, affine moisture/hydrogen estimation and coupling/thread pressure arithmetic. Require full input/coefficient record hashes, licensed Evidence and applicability review. All empirical and standard-dependent coefficients are caller inputs; no proprietary parameter/grade/shape-factor tables, automatic method eligibility, rounding or qualification is bundled. Cooling dimensional structure is cross-checked against Bjork et al. 2023, https://doi.org/10.1007/s40194-023-01483-w; no prose or figures copied.

## `inspection.instrumented_impact_signal_summary`

The supplied signal is calibrated SI force, displacement and time with a reviewed sign convention and valid window. Displacement is monotonic nondecreasing and energy uses adjacent-sample trapezoidal integration without filtering. Signal reduction does not identify crack initiation or establish toughness, transition behavior or acceptance.

## `inspection.known_volume_pressure_rise`

Rigid known volume, absolute pressure, one reviewed clock and independent blank/test source groups. Weighted linear fits use original monotonic trace points inside declared windows. Molar conversion is optional and requires an explicitly reviewed absolute temperature state.

구현 근거:

- `weighted_blank_corrected_known_volume_pressure_rise`: Fit caller-reviewed blank and test absolute-pressure histories on their original clocks with uncertainty weights, subtract their slopes, and multiply by a known volume to obtain signed net gas throughput with propagated uncertainty. Preserve independent run/source identities and optional reviewed reference-temperature conversion without separating outgassing from through-leak, locating a leak, deciding acceptance or creating probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

Do not infer saturation, field uniformity or flaw sensitivity, remove baselines, compensate velocity or lift-off, fuse signals, detect, classify, size, apply acceptance limits, or create POD, remaining-life or failure-probability claims.

- `multi_period_inspection_policy_comparison_definition`: Compare at least two complete externally evaluated multi-period policies only after confirming a common event, physical scope, horizon, start-survival condition, cost basis, currency or normalized unit and discount basis. Preserve every policy and evaluator identity plus configuration/input/result digests, conditional first-failure estimate and optional qualified bound, additive expected-loss components and the exact declared resource set with units and optional bounds. Apply caller-approved hard probability and resource constraints before comparing expected total loss; never relax a constraint when no policy is compliant or break a cost tie arbitrarily. The unique least-loss compliant candidate is only the best member of the supplied reviewed set. Do not generate policies or transitions, infer probabilities, resources, bounds, constraints or costs, claim global optimality, resource scheduling, risk acceptance or regulatory compliance.

## `inspection.no_indication_update`

POD conditional on each prior bin; random independent coverage and no false indication mechanism.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `prior_weights` | 예 | `{"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `probabilities_of_detection` | 예 | `{"items": {"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `coverage_fraction` | 예 | `{"maximum": 1, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `posterior_weights` | `1` |
| `probability_of_no_indication` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
{
  "prior_weights": [
    0.5,
    0.5
  ],
  "probabilities_of_detection": [
    0.1,
    0.9
  ],
  "coverage_fraction": 1.0
}
```

구현 근거:

- `bayes_rule`: Prior bin weights multiplied by no-indication likelihood and renormalized.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.pipe_membrane_test_pressure`

Caller provides the applicable material yield strength, factor and its review basis. Outside-diameter membrane arithmetic only; grade factors, rounding, thread/coupling resistance, standard eligibility and test approval are not inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `outside_diameter_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `wall_thickness_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `yield_strength_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `declared_yield_fraction` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1, "type": "number"}` |
| `factor_basis` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_material_and_factor_applicability_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `membrane_test_pressure_difference_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `declared_membrane_stress_Pa` | `Pa` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 계산기는 선행 AssessmentResult를 받아 구성하는 모델이어서 독립 JSON 입력 대신 registry 실행을 포함한 합성 Python wiring example `examples/engineering_correlations.py`를 제공한다. 예제 입력은 구조 연결 설명용 합성값이며 물성 검증 자료가 아니다.

구현 근거:

- `declared_yield_fraction_pipe_membrane_equilibrium`: Independently evaluate outside-diameter membrane pressure from twice the caller stress fraction times yield strength times wall thickness divided by outside diameter. Require positive bore and caller-reviewed geometry/material/factor applicability. No grade-dependent factors, proprietary standard tables, rounding rules, threaded-connection equations or approval criteria are bundled.

## `inspection.planar_multiview_fmc_tfm`

Elements and image points occupy opposite sides of one explicit planar interface in the reviewed common coordinate frame. Each ray is bracketed with caller fractional-position and normalized Snell residual tolerances; unsupported rays or views withhold the whole output. Optional backwall reflection keeps the selected material mode and uses a parallel infinite plane; amplitudes remain unweighted signed RF.

Require full input/coefficient record hashes, licensed Evidence and applicability review. All empirical and standard-dependent coefficients are caller inputs; no proprietary parameter/grade/shape-factor tables, automatic method eligibility, rounding or qualification is bundled. Cooling dimensional structure is cross-checked against Bjork et al. 2023, https://doi.org/10.1007/s40194-023-01483-w; no prose or figures copied.

구현 근거:

- `pulse_echo_sound_speed_fit_derivation`: With a caller-reviewed fixed time-zero offset and incidence angle, convert each positive round-trip time to one-way path time and fit reference thickness as sound speed times that coordinate through the physical zero. Use only predeclared calibration locations and source groups, then evaluate untouched holdout locations and groups. Ordinary fitting reports residual-conditional uncertainty. The optional iterative effective-variance fit weights each row by the sum of declared independent thickness variance and slope-scaled time variance, reports reduced chi-square and evaluates standardized holdout residuals. Return an explicitly unreviewed calibration fragment with no sample applicability. Neither fit covers shared time-zero, angle, temperature, coupling, probe, material-heterogeneity or model-form uncertainty and neither by itself qualifies field thickness measurements.

| `reference_equivalent_mass_kg` | `kg` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 계산기는 선행 AssessmentResult를 받아 구성하는 모델이어서 독립 JSON 입력 대신 registry 실행을 포함한 합성 Python wiring example `examples/engineering_correlations.py`를 제공한다. 예제 입력은 구조 연결 설명용 합성값이며 물성 검증 자료가 아니다.

구현 근거:

- `energy_divided_by_declared_reference_specific_energy`: Independently normalize caller energy in joules by caller reference specific energy in joules per kilogram. Preserve reference identity and energy basis without bundled reference constants, blast efficiency, pressure prediction or exclusion-distance rules.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.reference_leak_response_calibration`

Only valid detected rows with positive traceable molar leak rate and response enter the fit. Calibration and holdout specimens, reference leaks, source groups and independence groups are disjoint. Holdout leak rates are evaluated only inside calibration support; no unknown-leak inversion is performed.

- `authored_reference_leak_log_response_regression`: Fit detected, clock-aligned instrument response against traceable positive molar reference-leak rate in a fixed weighted log-log regression. Preserve gas, boundary, instrument configuration, uncertainties, provider digests and excluded non-detect/censored/missing rows; evaluate holdout only inside reference-leak support without inverting unknown leaks, estimating detection probability, deciding acceptance or creating FTA probabilities.

## `inspection.replica_feature_density_summary`

## `inspection.signal_response_pod_calibration`

Signal is linear in natural-log flaw size with independent normal residuals and caller weights. A fixed caller-reviewed threshold defines detection; calibration and holdout groups do not overlap. Only uncensored observed signals enter weighted fitting and holdout metrics.

| `physical_scope_id` | `1` |
| `envelope_id` | `1` |
| `residual_standard_deviation` | `signal unit` |
| `fixed_detection_threshold` | `signal unit` |
| `pod_curve` | `mixed` |
| `probability_of_detection` | `1` |
| `target_probability_of_detection` | `1` |
| `target_flaw_size_within_support` | `flaw-size unit` |
| `holdout_weighted_classification_accuracy` | `1` |
| `holdout_weighted_mean_log_score` | `1` |
| `holdout_weighted_brier_score` | `1` |
| `holdout_weighted_mean_squared_standardized_residual` | `1` |

확률의 의미:

| 필드 | 의미 |
|---|---|
| `probability_of_detection` | `detection_given_flaw_and_procedure` |

구현 근거:

- `reviewed_signal_response_pod_qualification_envelope`: Fit a caller-reviewed fixed-threshold normal-residual signal response linear in natural-log flaw size using uncensored calibration observations only, then report supported POD queries and independent holdout classification, log-score, Brier and residual diagnostics. Preserve censored/missing observations without substitution and do not claim code acceptance or field detection probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.surface_profile_roughness`

Caller-reviewed filtered profile and evaluation direction; explicitly piecewise-linear positions/heights with a length-weighted mean removed.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `profile_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_specimen_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `coordinate_frame_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `measurement_direction_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `position_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `height_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `profile_digest` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `processing_basis` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `profile_filter_form_removal_and_direction_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `piecewise_linear_interpretation_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `profile_id` | `1` |
| `physical_specimen_id` | `1` |
| `coordinate_frame_id` | `1` |
| `measurement_direction_id` | `1` |
| `profile_digest` | `1` |
| `evaluation_length_m` | `m` |
| `removed_length_weighted_mean_height_m` | `m` |
| `profile_Ra_m` | `m` |
| `profile_Rq_m` | `m` |
| `evaluation_peak_height_Rp_m` | `m` |
| `evaluation_valley_depth_Rv_m` | `m` |
| `evaluation_total_height_Rt_m` | `m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- [NIST surface roughness and step-height calibration methods and height-parameter definitions; this implementation uses explicit piecewise-linear numerical interpretation, not a calibration claim.](https://www.nist.gov/publications/nist-surface-roughness-and-step-height-calibrations-measurement-conditions-and-sources) (`length_weighted_profile_roughness_integrals`)

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `inspection.tensile_offset_yield_campaign`

Specimen, product, heat, orientation, geometry, machine, load-cell and extensometer identities are exact caller inputs. Temperature, strain rate, raw/result digests, offset definition and reported result uncertainties remain explicit. Campaign outcomes use caller criteria without curve recomputation, automatic offset construction or bundled design rules.

Apply only caller-authored criteria. Do not recalculate curves, automatically derive offset yield, embed official validity rules or claim design acceptance.

## `inspection.tensile_offset_yield_curve`

The supplied curve is a reviewed monotonic engineering-strain loading branch inside a pre-necking analysis window. Elastic fit weights, offset and crossing tolerance are caller-reviewed inputs. A unique adjacent-point crossing is descriptive test reduction, not specification acceptance.

## `inspection.test_water_quality_summary`

Samples retain explicit location, time, method and evidence identities on one reviewed test clock. Coverage and property limits are caller-owned inputs; no regulatory or material limit is embedded. Observed sample properties are not interpolated between sampling events.

| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `test_end_time_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `required_location_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `maximum_sampling_gap_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `samples` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/TestWaterSample"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `envelope` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/TestWaterEnvelope"}` |

## `inspection.thread_connection_pressure`

Inputs, coefficients, unit conventions, applicability and use rights are caller-reviewed and digest-pinned. No standard parameter table, grade factor, automatic rule choice, rounding or procedure approval is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `basis` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CorrelationBasis"}` |
| `outside_diameter_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `seal_pitch_diameter_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `elastic_modulus_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `diametral_taper_m_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `power_turn_count` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `thread_pitch_m_per_turn` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `connection_pressure_resistance_Pa` | `Pa` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 계산기는 선행 AssessmentResult를 받아 구성하는 모델이어서 독립 JSON 입력 대신 registry 실행을 포함한 합성 Python wiring example `examples/engineering_correlations.py`를 제공한다. 예제 입력은 구조 연결 설명용 합성값이며 물성 검증 자료가 아니다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_parameterized_engineering_correlation_arithmetic`: Independently evaluate explicit caller-parameterized displacement-stress variants, dimensionally declared 2D/3D cooling correlations, affine moisture/hydrogen estimation and coupling/thread pressure arithmetic. Require full input/coefficient record hashes, licensed Evidence and applicability review. All empirical and standard-dependent coefficients are caller inputs; no proprietary parameter/grade/shape-factor tables, automatic method eligibility, rounding or qualification is bundled. Cooling dimensional structure is cross-checked against Bjork et al. 2023, https://doi.org/10.1007/s40194-023-01483-w; no prose or figures copied.

## `inspection.threshold_inspection_schedule`

Caller-reviewed cumulative first-crossing probabilities on strictly ordered candidate times; select the latest supplied candidate within notice and deferral limits that satisfies a user-approved probability criterion without interpolation or consequence optimization.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |

| `assessment_time_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `conditioning` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `event_probability_meaning` | 예 | `{"const": "conditional_first_failure_in_period", "type": "string"}` |
| `forecast_model_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `forecast_model_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `probability_basis` | 예 | `{"enum": ["estimate", "upper_bound"], "type": "string"}` |
| `maximum_probability_before_inspection` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMaximum": 1.0, "exclusiveMinimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `minimum_notice_s` | 아니오 | `{"default": 0.0, "minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_deferral_s` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `forecast_identity_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `event_scope_and_conditioning_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

```json
{
  "schedule_id": "synthetic-threshold-schedule",

Coverage or a negative record does not establish flaw absence, probability of detection, code acceptance, severity, repair disposition, remaining life or failure probability.

## `integration.adaptive_cycle_block_damage`

The caller supplies a deterministic provider whose identity, revision and configuration digest match the request. State derivatives and nonnegative damage rate are defined per cycle in the ordered caller state basis. Adaptive RK4 step-doubling controls only local numerical error for the declared ODE and does not establish physical validity or global error bounds. Integer cycle blocks are caller-provided accounting partitions; the solver does not count cycles or infer a material failure law.

Runtime 의존성: `provider` 이름으로 실행 시점에 Python callable/provider를 주입한다. 해당 provider 객체는 JSON 입력에 포함되지 않으며, 입력 계약에 기록한 provider ID·revision·configuration/record digest와 Evidence가 실행계보를 식별한다.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `analysis_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `state_variable_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 128, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

| `maximum_state` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 128, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

| `state_relative_tolerance` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_adaptive_cycle_block_state_damage_ode`: Integrate a caller-defined bounded state derivative and nonnegative damage rate per cycle across ordered integer cycle blocks using RK4 step doubling, componentwise local error controls and a finite function-evaluation/rejection budget. Carry only accepted state, commit completed blocks, and retain an accepted prefix when a state boundary, unresolved event, provider mismatch or numerical limit stops the path. Bind provider/calibration/configuration digests and ordered state units. This is numerical integration of the caller's model, not an inferred fatigue law, cycle counter, life estimate, probability or material qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.aqueous_bdot_speciation_history`

Each exact time knot carries a complete caller-reviewed mass-action system and B-dot parameter record matched to that knot's temperature. Species ordering and reaction/constraint topology remain fixed; constants, solution constraints, activity coefficients and evidence-bound B-dot records may vary only through explicit knot inputs. The adapter does not interpolate, extrapolate, infer kinetics, discover phases or qualify a corrosion rate.

구현 근거:

- `caller_general_aqueous_mass_action_speciation`: Solve a caller-defined square single-phase aqueous network in natural-log dimensionless activities. Use caller-supplied fixed activity coefficients and temperature-matched log10 equilibrium constants; solve caller-provided linear species amount and/or charge constraints after normalization by declared positive scales. A damped Newton method with finite-range checks and line search returns species activities, concentrations, balance closure, reaction residuals and full input/provider digests only within the declared tolerance. At a computed root, solve the converged Jacobian for implicit local derivatives of log activities and concentrations with respect to each log10(K), constraint target and fixed ln(gamma), without finite differencing. If explicitly reviewed, propagate a finite symmetric positive-semidefinite caller parameter covariance through those derivatives using first-order JΣJᵀ; condition and finite checks can make sensitivities unavailable while preserving the equilibrium result. No automatic electroneutrality, ionic-strength iteration, water balance, gas/solid phase, precipitation, kinetics, corrosion, or acceptance is inferred.
- [USGS PHREEQC 3 documentation: LLNL extended Debye-Huckel B-dot activity model](https://water.usgs.gov/water-resources/software/PHREEQC/documentation/phreeqc3-html/phreeqc3-26.htm) (`usgs_phreeqc_llnl_bdot_activity`)
- `molality_to_molarity_activity_standard_state_bridge`: Map a molality-standard-state coefficient to a molarity-standard-state coefficient by equating the same dimensionless activity: gamma_c*c/(1 mol/L) = gamma_m*m/(1 mol/kg-water), with m=c/w and caller-supplied w in kg-water/L-solution, giving gamma_c=gamma_m/w. Require review of the water-mass conversion and standard-state mapping, preserve both coefficients, and fail closed outside finite numeric range. This algebraic basis does not infer solution water content or validate an activity model.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.aqueous_candidate_network_speciation`

Only the exact computed mass-action system assembled by a digest-pinned candidate workflow is passed to the established aqueous speciation solver. Species inventory, reaction direction, equilibrium constants, constraints, temperature and activity standard state remain caller selected and Evidence backed upstream. This composition does not discover reactions or phases, infer kinetics, predict corrosion, or qualify material performance.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `candidate_workflow_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `candidate_workflow_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `temperature_K` | `K` |
| `speciation.species[].dimensionless_activity` | `1` |
| `speciation.species[].concentration_mol_L` | `mol/L` |

Verify workflow AssessmentResult input/context/result digest, assembly and system digests, temperature and activity standard state, then call the existing fixed-gamma aqueous mass-action speciation solver. ## `integration.aqueous_candidate_network_workflow`

A caller-defined closed candidate species inventory and formula/charge set is screened with explicit search budgets. Reaction selections, direction, equilibrium records, temperature match, constraints, activity coefficients and phase scope remain caller supplied and evidence bound. The workflow assembles but does not solve, discover phases, infer kinetics, or qualify wet-CO2 corrosion.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `workflow_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `enumeration` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AqueousReactionCandidateEnumeration"}` |
| `binding` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AqueousCandidateReactionBindingRequest"}` |
| `assembly` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AqueousMassActionSystemAssemblyRequest"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `candidate_reaction_count` | `1` |
| `reaction_count` | `1` |

- `caller_composed_aqueous_candidate_network_workflow`: Compose a bounded candidate stoichiometry enumeration, manual evidence-backed selection/direction/equilibrium-constant binding and strict aqueous mass-action system assembly. Pin every stage digest and require identical species formula/charge, temperature and activity standard state across the workflow. This assembles but does not solve chemistry, discover species or phases, infer feasibility/kinetics, or qualify corrosion.

## `integration.aqueous_external_activity_speciation_history`

Every exact time knot carries a separately reviewed mass-action system and caller-owned composition-dependent activity provider record. Species identities and reaction/constraint topology remain fixed; per-knot constants and provider parameter records may vary explicitly. No interpolation, kinetic interpretation, phase selection or corrosion qualification is performed.

Runtime 의존성: `activity_provider` 이름으로 실행 시점에 Python callable/provider를 주입한다. 해당 provider 객체는 JSON 입력에 포함되지 않으며, 입력 계약에 기록한 provider ID·revision·configuration/record digest와 Evidence가 실행계보를 식별한다.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.external_aqueous_activity_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.external_aqueous_activity_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `history_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_basis` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `elapsed_time_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 5000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `knot_requests` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ExternalAqueousActivityIteration"}, "maxItems": 5000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `exact_time_temperature_parameter_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `stable_species_reaction_topology_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `no_interpolation_or_extrapolation_between_knots_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `elapsed_time_s[]` | `s` |
| `temperature_K[]` | `K` |
| `knot_results[].time_s` | `s` |
| `knot_results[].temperature_K` | `K` |
| `knot_results[].values.ionic_strength_mol_kg` | `mol/kg_water` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

```json
