구현 근거:

- `caller_external_aqueous_activity_speciation_history`: At every explicitly supplied increasing time knot, solve one independently parameterized mass-action system with the same caller-owned composition-dependent activity provider identity, revision, configuration and single-ion convention. Require a fixed species/formula/reaction/constraint topology, exact time-temperature mapping, explicit knot-specific parameter records, complete provider convergence and caller reviews. Retain per-knot request/result digest and only report computed when all knots succeed; otherwise return a failed knot and prior prefix. No interpolation, kinetic model, provider implementation, phase selection or corrosion qualification is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.aqueous_mass_action_cycle_audit`

The existing mass-action species, formulas, charges, reaction direction, log10(K), temperature and standard state are reused without chemical reinterpretation. Each reaction receives exactly one source record binding, and its declared Evidence source ID and file hash must match. Cycle rank and closure are diagnostics only; no reaction/phase discovery, speciation solve, parameter correction or corrosion qualification is performed.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `adapter_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `system` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AqueousMassActionSystem"}` |
| `reaction_evidence_bindings` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/AqueousReactionEvidenceBinding"}, "maxItems": 100, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `stoichiometric_balance_tolerance` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-10, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 0.0001, "type": "number"}` |
| `rank_relative_tolerance` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-12, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 0.001, "type": "number"}` |
| `cycle_closure_tolerance_log10` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-08, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `numerical_rank_and_cycle_tolerance_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `evidence_and_usage_rights_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `temperature_K` | `K` |
| `cycle_audit.reaction_balance[].charge_balance_residual` | `1` |
| `cycle_audit.cycle_closure_residual_l2_log10` | `1` |
| `cycle_audit.reaction_cycle_basis[].log10_equilibrium_cycle_residual` | `1` |

구현 근거:

- `aqueous_mass_action_reaction_cycle_audit_adapter`: Reuse the exact caller-defined aqueous mass-action species, formulas, charges, reaction terms, log10(K), temperature and activity standard state. Require reaction-by-reaction source-record IDs and file hashes that resolve to the system Evidence bundle, then pass the bound network to the independent stoichiometric cycle-consistency audit. Do not transform reaction direction, infer missing formulae or discover phases.
- `aqueous_reaction_cycle_nullspace_consistency`: Construct the caller-declared species-by-reaction stoichiometric matrix after checking elemental and charge balance. An orthonormal right-null-space basis identifies linear reaction cycles; equilibrium constants are algebraically consistent on that declared cycle space when the L2 norm of the basis projection of log10(K) is within a caller-reviewed tolerance. Numerical rank tolerance and the supplied species, reactions and conditions remain caller responsibilities. No reaction or phase discovery, speciation solve, or parameter qualification is performed.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.aqueous_mass_action_to_crevice_nernst_history`

Only dimensionless activities and exact time/temperature knots from a computed digest-pinned crevice mass-action or B-dot speciation history are consumed. The caller supplies the redox equation, reference identity, electron number and standard-potential history, which must align with the solved aqueous species and time basis. The upstream activity-history digest supplies source lineage when no raw composition-history digest exists; B-dot parameter-record hashes remain in the upstream result. This composes sequential calculations; it does not perform simultaneous speciation/electrode coupling, activity inference, kinetics or corrosion qualification.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.aqueous_mass_action_to_nernst_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.aqueous_mass_action_to_nernst_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `mass_action_history_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `mass_action_history_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `clock_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `reaction_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `standard_potential_reference_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `reaction_quotient_stoichiometry` | 예 | `{"additionalProperties": {"type": "number"}, "minProperties": 1, "type": "object"}` |
| `electron_number` | 예 | `{"maximum": 32, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |
| `standard_potential_V` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 5000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `standard_potential_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `standard_potential_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `standard_potential_configuration_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |

구현 근거:

- `aqueous_mass_action_activities_to_crevice_nernst_potential_history`: Consume only a computed digest-pinned knotwise aqueous mass-action result and bind its strictly positive dimensionless species activities to an explicitly caller-defined redox quotient, electron count, standard-potential reference and exact-knot standard-potential history. Preserve the upstream composition and solver-result digests, source inventory identity and exact clock/temperature knots. Require all quotient species, activity standard-state mapping, potential provider Evidence and reaction-direction reviews. This sequential adapter does not solve the redox reaction, infer E0 or activities, close current back into the same chemistry trajectory, add multiphase/transport kinetics, or infer corrosion/wall loss.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.aqueous_mass_action_vant_hoff_history`

Integrate the van't Hoff relation with caller-supplied reference reaction enthalpy, then solve the existing single-phase aqueous mass-action system independently at aligned temperature knots. A reviewed caller-supplied reaction thermochemistry model is required. Optional constant or linearly temperature-dependent reaction heat-capacity models require separate review gates. Activity coefficients are supplied per knot or retained as fixed only after review. No temperature extrapolation, phase discovery, precipitation, kinetics, gas-liquid equilibrium or corrosion validity is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `history_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `reference_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reaction_enthalpy_standard_state` | 예 | `{"const": "same_as_mass_action_equilibrium_standard_state", "type": "string"}` |
| `times_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 1000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `temperatures_K` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 1000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `mass_action_system_at_reference` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AqueousMassActionSystem"}` |
| `reaction_enthalpies` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ReactionEnthalpyReference"}, "maxItems": 100, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `activity_coefficients_by_knot` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ActivityCoefficientKnot"}, "maxItems": 1000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `maximum_absolute_log10_equilibrium_constant` | 아니오 | `{"default": 300.0, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1000, "type": "number"}` |
| `reaction_thermochemistry_temperature_model_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `constant_reaction_heat_capacity_change_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `temperature_dependent_reaction_heat_capacity_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `fixed_activity_coefficients_temperature_applicability_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `activity_coefficient_temperature_history_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `temperature_support_and_time_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `times_s` | `s` |
| `temperatures_K` | `K` |
| `equilibrium_history[].reaction_log10_equilibrium_constants[].temperature_log10_K` | `1` |
| `equilibrium_history[].calculation.values.species[].concentration_mol_L` | `mol/L` |
| `activity_coefficients_by_knot[].activity_coefficients[]` | `1` |
| `reaction_enthalpy_source_records[].delta_h_reference_J_mol` | `J/mol` |
| `reaction_enthalpy_source_records[].delta_cp_reference_J_mol_K` | `J/(mol K)` |
| `reaction_enthalpy_source_records[].delta_cp_slope_J_mol_K2` | `J/(mol K^2)` |

Transfers one caller-selected solid saturation-ratio history from exact digest-pinned aqueous equilibrium knots to an explicit single-phase scale-thickness law and optionally an area-average coverage law. Thickness and coverage laws remain independent and share only the selected saturation trajectory. Kinetic coefficients, phase identity, scale molar volume and applicability remain caller supplied and reviewed; no phase discovery, chemistry-derived rate law, feedback coupling or corrosion qualification is inferred.

구현 근거:

- `caller_aqueous_saturation_to_surface_scale_kinetics`: Consume a computed, digest-pinned aqueous van't Hoff saturation-history AssessmentResult and transfer one caller-selected candidate solid log10 saturation ratio at every exact time knot into the adjacent intervals of an explicit caller surface-scale thickness kinetics request. Recompute and verify registry input/result digests, the embedded computed van't Hoff history result and input digest, exact equilibrium source-knot result digests, knot clocks and temperatures, each nested saturation-screen upstream result and solubility-record digest, a unique matching solid at every knot, exact interval endpoint equality and finite log-ratio transfer range. Varying temperatures require the declared kinetic temperature to match the first history knot, explicit knot-to-interval review and caller Arrhenius parameters within their declared support; each kinetic interval holds the corresponding left-knot temperature constant while saturation uses its reviewed endpoint path. Preserve source history and per-knot screen digests, then delegate thickness and optional coverage evolution to existing caller-calibrated single-phase models. Require matching phase/specimen/condition identities; coverage accepts varying knot temperatures only with explicit knot mapping, per-interval constant temperature interpretation and supported caller Arrhenius parameters. The two laws are not coupled through evolving thickness, transport or corrosion. Do not infer candidate phase selection, precipitation/dissolution coefficients, chemistry-derived kinetics, morphology, corrosion protection or qualification.

| `activity_log10_absolute_bounds_by_knot` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"items": {"additionalProperties": {"type": "number"}, "type": "object"}, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |

| `compatible_standard_states_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `equilibrium_constants_temperature_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `activity_interval_bounds_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `solubility_product_interval_bounds_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `times_s` | `s` |
| `temperatures_K` | `K` |
| `saturation_history[].screen.values.candidate_results.log10_saturation_ratio` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 계산기는 선행 AssessmentResult를 받아 구성하는 모델이어서 독립 JSON 입력 대신 registry 실행을 포함한 합성 Python wiring example `examples/aqueous_vant_hoff_saturation_history.py`를 제공한다. 예제 입력은 구조 연결 설명용 합성값이며 물성 검증 자료가 아니다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_aqueous_candidate_saturation_screen`: For each explicitly declared candidate solid, calculate the logarithmic ion-activity product from caller-supplied dimensionless aqueous activities and positive exponents, then subtract the caller-supplied temperature-applicable log10 solubility product. Require a row-level solubility record ID and a matching Evidence source ID per candidate, and carry citation, license and checksum into each result. A Python composition adapter accepts computed fixed-gamma, Davies, B-dot, or tabulated-activity aqueous Calculation results or registered AssessmentResults, checks supported model identity for the latter, carries the complete upstream digest plus activity provider/record lineage, and rejects noncomputed or untraceable states. It also accepts a digest-pinned candidate-network speciation AssessmentResult by verifying wrapper input digest, embedded workflow result and input digests, assembled mass-action system digest, and nested speciation result digest before forwarding its activity state and retaining workflow/system/speciation lineage. It accepts a registered exact-knot B-dot history only with an explicit knot index, verifies full assessment/input/history/knot/request/result and parameter-record digests, and preserves selected time, temperature and parameter lineage in the saturation result. Callers may add absolute log10 activity bounds keyed by the exact upstream species ID set; partial or extra mappings return needs_data rather than silently dropping bounds. Propagate caller-supplied absolute log10 bounds for species activities and each solubility product by conservative interval arithmetic, reporting lower/upper saturation-index bounds and whether the interval lies wholly below, wholly above, or overlaps saturation. Nonzero activity and solubility bounds require separate caller review flags; otherwise the calculation returns needs_data without an interval classification. These deterministic intervals are not probabilities or confidence bounds. Return ordered candidate results with activity-state and solubility-data digests. The time-history adapter additionally requires an exact computed van't Hoff history digest, aligned Ksp records at every knot, matching candidate definitions and explicit per-record temperature support; it does not interpolate between knots. Do not choose stable phases, solve competing-solid mass balance, infer precipitation amount or kinetics, or predict corrosion.

## `integration.co2_henry_temperature_to_fixed_fugacity_carbonate`

A completed Henry-temperature AssessmentResult is reconstructed and verified against its exact request, input digest, unit, solvent, temperature and output digest before handoff. A derived Henry record uses the corrected coefficient in mol/L/Pa, the same solvent-composition digest and target temperature, and lineage to both source Evidence and the derived result digest. The downstream solver computes carbonate-only aqueous species and alkalinity closure; complete solution composition and arbitrary aqueous reaction-network speciation are not computed. No Henry data, thermochemistry, gas fugacity, alkalinity, equilibrium constants or activity parameters are inferred or bundled.

## `integration.crevice_activity_gradient_nernst_planck_flux_1d`

One-dimensional local face law with caller-resolved electroneutral states, linear concentration gradient and log-activity-coefficient gradient. A local dimensionless electric-potential gradient is chosen to make the summed ionic current zero; advection is upwinded from the caller face direction. Caller reviews the single-ion activity convention, thermodynamic consistency, diffusivities and face-state mapping.

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |

## `integration.crevice_activity_transport_spatial_phase_aperture_handoff`

The activity-corrected reactive transport calculation is completed on a fixed, uniform initial slit geometry and exact caller clock. The solid kinetic campaign supplies explicit cellwise extent rates for each exact interval; rates are held constant over that interval. Aqueous species are adjusted by balanced solid reaction extents after each transport segment and checked against finite cell inventories. Phase volume is converted to per-cell equivalent gap using caller molar volumes, face count and coverage; no morphology is solved. The aperture output is for a subsequent segment and does not feed back into the source transport result.

Inserted states use piecewise-linear interpolation only and do not represent recomputed corrosion, transport or moving-boundary physics. The caller sets relative-change, segment and bisection limits and explicitly reviews interpolation applicability.

## `integration.crevice_aqueous_component_ledger`

Every declared mass-action constraint has exactly one explicit role; the charge-neutrality row exactly matches species charge coefficients and has a zero target. Each conserved component map exactly matches its declared linear constraint and is conserved by every caller-declared aqueous reaction. Face transfers are signed left-to-right extensive amounts; cell source transfers are positive into the aqueous inventory. The evaluator projects extensive species ledgers algebraically and performs no chemistry solve, transport integration, phase transfer, or qualification.

| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_aqueous_component_ledger.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_aqueous_component_ledger.v1", "type": "string"}` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_explicit_aqueous_constraint_role_partition`: Require every aqueous mass-action linear constraint to have exactly one caller-declared role: conserved analytical component, fixed target, or charge neutrality. Validate a single zero-target charge row against the exact species charge map; role labels are explicit caller semantics and are not inferred from constraint names.
- `caller_species_to_conserved_component_stoichiometric_map`: Bind each conserved aqueous component to the exact coefficient row of its declared mass-action constraint and require the mapping to remain invariant under all declared aqueous reaction stoichiometries.
- `finite_volume_aqueous_component_inventory_flux_source_projection`: Project caller species inventories, signed left-to-right face transfers, and incoming-positive source transfers onto conserved component ledgers; compute per-cell and global inventory closure with caller absolute/relative tolerances and a bounded operation ceiling. This is ledger projection only, not a chemical equilibrium or transport solve.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_bdf_nucleation_operator_split`

Each original interval is operator split: aqueous-only fixed-volume component BDF first, cellwise seed/growth ledger second. Post-kinetic dissolved species are projected through explicit BDF conserved-component maps; solid phase amounts remain separately carried between intervals. Absolute caller saturation record digests are retained while the existing zero-origin batch ledger uses an exact relative-time translation per interval. No transport occurs during kinetic substeps and no geometry feedback is applied.

입력 필드:

구현 근거:

- `caller_component_bdf_then_cellwise_seed_kinetic_operator_split`: For each exact interval, integrate fixed-volume aqueous conserved-component BDF transport, apply independent digest-bound cell seed/growth ledgers, verify species-to-component and aqueous-plus-solid closure, and carry post-kinetic aqueous and solid inventories to the next interval. This sequential operator split rejects source, hydraulic, Faradaic, prescribed-current and moving-geometry modes.
- `exact_translation_of_absolute_saturation_interval_to_local_ledger_clock`: Translate each absolute caller saturation interval to the zero-origin local clock required by the closed-batch kinetic ledger, pin the derived interval digest, preserve the original source digest and record the exact affine map for absolute event times.
- `finite_volume_conserved_component_inventory_bdf_state`: Integrate per-cell conserved aqueous component moles as the BDF state on a fixed-volume mesh with closed external boundaries; species concentrations are equilibrium reconstructions and reaction-invariant component maps provide the transported inventory basis.
- `caller_fixed_volume_cellwise_seed_threshold_kinetic_ledgers`: Apply digest-bound, exact seed-threshold nucleation/growth ledgers independently to ordered fixed-volume cells, convert concentration histories to cell moles and aggregate after every cell commits. The operator-split adapter has no inter-cell transport or geometry feedback.

## `integration.crevice_calibrated_wall_flux_callback`

A calibrated effective wall-transfer velocity and a caller-supplied equilibrium surface concentration define inward flux J=k_w(C_surface-C_bulk). Rate, surface concentration and geometry histories share exact ordered knots and cell identity; interpolation is linear only between the supplied knots and no time extrapolation is allowed. The callback supports one species and returns one inward molar flux per cell; the transport solver applies its wall-area-per-volume geometry exactly once. The caller's equilibrium surface concentration and application condition must be physically reviewed; no surface chemistry is solved here. The callback is intended for the existing restricted-transport/crevice campaign wall boundary and does not run or alter a transport calculation.

## `integration.crevice_calibrated_wall_sink_rate_history`

The calibration request/result pair is digest-bound and the computed fit's IDs, parameters and temperature support must match the supplied source request. Caller reviews that material, wall surface, fluid chemistry and geometry condition represented by the calibration are applicable to the requested history. Only exact supplied temperature knots are evaluated; every temperature must remain within calibration observation support. The existing first-order irreversible Arrhenius wall-sink evaluator is used; no calibration parameter is refit or modified by this bridge. The result is an effective transfer-velocity history, not a corrosion rate, penetration history, probability, acceptance or qualification claim.

## `integration.crevice_cellwise_nucleation_kinetic_history`

Cell rows are independent closed-batch kinetic ledgers with identical ordered species/phase laws and exact common output times. Concentrations and solid inventories are converted to amounts using Evidence-pinned, fixed cell solution volumes. Each underlying batch history performs its own analytic seed-threshold split and conservative ledger verification. No inter-cell transport or geometry change occurs inside this adapter; callers must explicitly operator-split it with a separate transport calculation.

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_fixed_volume_cellwise_seed_threshold_kinetic_ledgers`: Apply digest-bound, exact seed-threshold nucleation/growth ledgers independently to ordered fixed-volume cells, convert concentration histories to cell moles and aggregate after every cell commits. The operator-split adapter has no inter-cell transport or geometry feedback.
- `digest_bound_saturation_nucleation_and_growth_kinetic_history`: Apply Evidence-pinned caller saturation intervals and bounded phase-specific molar nucleation/growth/dissolution laws to a closed aqueous batch. Before a caller inventory threshold is met, evaluate the declared supersaturation-dependent nucleation source; thereafter use the caller seeded growth/dissolution law. Delegate each interval to the conservative aqueous/solid kinetic ledger and record phase inventory, element/charge balance and law digests. No automatic thermodynamic phase discovery, particle population balance or qualification is inferred.
- `caller_rate_competitive_solid_mass_balance_ledger`: Apply explicitly supplied signed molar extent rates for a caller-declared set of neutral solid phases over contiguous time intervals. Limit dissolution by available phase inventory, then limit simultaneous precipitation with one common aqueous-reactant factor that preserves the supplied phase-rate ratios. Verify each declared reaction's charge and elemental stoichiometry and report time-resolved dissolved and solid inventories with balance residuals. This is conservative bookkeeping for user-supplied rate outputs; it does not estimate kinetic laws, phase selection, saturation, scale morphology or corrosion protection.

## `integration.crevice_component_state_bdf`

BDF state variables are component moles, and each aqueous reaction conserves every transported component map. Each trial state is projected to local caller-evidenced single-liquid Davies/mass-action equilibrium before the RHS is formed; volume is fixed by default, while the opt-in solid-occupancy geometry mode iterates equilibrium at the derived trial volume. Interior species Nernst-Planck diffusion uses caller-supplied face diffusivity/geometry; a per-face algebraic migration field enforces the requested ionic current. Optional fixed-geometry hydraulic advection uses digest-bound transient slit flow and electroneutral reservoir compositions with upwind stage concentrations. Optional moving-geometry hydraulic transport uses an explicit signed pressure and electroneutral boundary-composition schedule, trial solid-equilibrium aperture, directional finite-difference liquid-volume rate, slit momentum, upwind component flux and integrated reservoir ledgers in a damped fixed point. It has not been physically verified; Faradaic area coupling is rejected. The default aqueous-only mode excludes solid transfer; the opt-in total-component solid-equilibrium mode is separate. Caller source schedules and reviewed spatial Ohmic/Butler-Volmer stage coupling remain mutually exclusive. The stage electrochemical path rejects conflicting caller extent/current schedules, enforces a caller branch-rate bound and a total stage-work budget, and records branch/evidence digests and knot lineage. Schema v7 optionally appends per-cell integrated double-layer charge to the BDF state. At every trial, the caller Cdl curve is inverted without extrapolation, trial chemistry refreshes Nernst equilibrium potentials and conductivity, spatial Ohmic face current is reconstructed, and branch Faradaic current plus charge continuity provide same-stage chemical source and charge derivatives. This mode requires fixed geometry and insulated ionic boundaries; moving hydraulic coupling and external circuit forcing are not represented. Opt-in dynamic geometry is restricted to aqueous plus instantaneous-solid equilibrium. At each BDF RHS and exact output knot, a damped fixed-point iteration maps caller-mapped gap-occupying solid moles through caller-reviewed molar volumes to aperture and solution volume, repeats equilibrium at that volume, and uses the resulting interpolated cell cross-section for NP face conductance. This is a bounded operator-split stage solve, not a monolithic coupled geometry/chemistry Newton solve; deposition mechanics, porosity, particle packing, fracture, and unlisted phases are outside scope. Dynamic geometry fails closed when the aperture reaches its caller minimum, the relative volume fixed-point residual exceeds tolerance, or the per-cell-stage or aggregate geometry iteration budget is exhausted. Fixed-volume v1-v3 behavior and the default mode are retained. Opt-in solid equilibrium mode treats the BDF conserved-component state as liquid-plus-candidate-solid total inventory and invokes a digest-bound, cell-specific instantaneous phase partition at every trial before NP/Faradaic flux evaluation; aqueous-only mode remains the default. Opt-in kinetic phase mode evolves total component inventory together with explicit per-phase solid moles. Every trial is equilibrated against the derived dissolved inventory, evaluates dimensionless ion activities and saturation ratios, then applies caller-pinned nucleation/growth laws in the same BDF stage; seed and depletion crossings restart at accepted event boundaries. Kinetic moving geometry maps explicit solid moles to gap occupancy. This user model is not independently verified or qualified. Solid mode requires the component basis to reconstruct every declared element, closes cellwise total-component and element balances plus external reservoir and current/charge ledgers, and aggregates partition, active-set, bisection and nested-equilibrium work across RHS and knot snapshots. Solid phase candidate identities and thermochemical records are stationary across the exact request clock/horizon and caller reviewed. Candidate amounts may change through instantaneous equilibrium and, in the opt-in geometry mode, change aperture and liquid volume. Phase kinetics, nucleation, global Gibbs minimization, discovery of unlisted phases and qualification are not calculated. Optional fixed-geometry hydraulic advection applies the exact interval inertance flow with signed upwind stage species concentrations and explicit neutral left/right reservoir states; its boundary component/element/charge amounts are separately integrated into the ODE ledger. Optional capacitive current is supplied as an exact-knot per-cell schedule, enters charge continuity with the declared sign convention, and is linearly interpolated with the matching ionic face-current schedule. It is forcing-only and cannot be interpreted as a solved potential/charge state or a Cdl constitutive relation. Capacitive-current schedules are forcing-only; schema-v7 same-stage dynamic double-layer owns its capacitive charge and ionic current and rejects caller capacitive/ionic schedules.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `finite_volume_conserved_component_inventory_bdf_state`: Integrate per-cell conserved aqueous component moles as the BDF state on a fixed-volume mesh with closed external boundaries; species concentrations are equilibrium reconstructions and reaction-invariant component maps provide the transported inventory basis.
- `caller_evidenced_cellwise_davies_mass_action_at_bdf_stages`: At every BDF trial stage, derive cellwise analytical component targets from the trial conserved inventories and solve the caller-evidenced Davies mass-action equilibrium; enforce explicit single-liquid, fixed-volume and bounded nested-work assumptions.
- `electroneutral_nernst_planck_species_flux_projected_to_components`: Calculate species diffusion and activity-gradient fluxes on interior faces using caller diffusivities, solve an algebraic migration field for zero ionic current, and project species fluxes through reaction-conserved component maps into the finite-volume BDF state.
- `caller_evidenced_component_source_extent_schedule`: Apply caller-supplied, digest-bound per-cell reaction-extent-rate schedules at exact knots with piecewise-linear interpolation, project aqueous stoichiometry into conserved-component BDF states, and separately account for external reservoir component, element and charge changes. Charged extent schedules require the paired prescribed-current schedule and knotwise continuity; source rates are not derived from Butler-Volmer or mixed-potential kinetics.
- `caller_evidenced_ionic_face_current_schedule`: Use review-gated caller-supplied exact-knot ionic currents on all faces, zero external boundary currents, and matching source-schedule times. Check each cell charge balance against Faraday-scaled reaction extents, solve the Nernst-Planck migration gradient to reproduce the requested interior current, and report ampere residuals and integrated charge; currents are not inferred from mixed-potential or Butler-Volmer kinetics.
- `caller_evidenced_double_layer_capacitive_current_schedule`: Apply a caller-provided exact-knot, per-cell capacitive-current history to the component-state BDF charge-continuity ledger. Bind the complete schedule digest and licensed Evidence, require exact clock and cell ordering plus review, interpolate within intervals, and integrate signed charge on the same BDF state. This is prescribed-current forcing; it does not solve electrode potential, derive capacitance, or couple to the stage mixed-potential kernel.
- `component_state_bdf_stage_spatial_ohmic_butler_volmer_faradaic_coupling`: At each conserved-component BDF trial, reconstruct caller-evidenced aqueous Davies/mass-action equilibrium, re-solve the existing spatial quasi-steady ohmic/Butler-Volmer mixed-potential branches from that trial chemistry, and project the branch extents plus matching electrolyte face current into the same RHS. Require exact chemistry/species/cell/clock alignment, fixed cell and face areas, consistent cell volumes/face areas/center distances, a reviewed branch map and caller extent-rate and solver-work bounds. This bounded mode has no moving-boundary dynamics, double-layer storage, automatic chemistry/phase discovery or material qualification.
- `component_state_bdf_stage_total_component_solid_equilibrium_partition`: Opt-in conserved-component BDF mode treats each cell state as total aqueous-plus-solid component inventory and invokes the bounded solid-partition solver at every trial stage; Nernst-Planck and Faradaic terms use reconstructed aqueous species while knot outputs retain liquid/solid inventories and component/element/charge ledgers. Exact caller phase sets and solver-work budgets are required. This mode excludes kinetic nucleation/precipitation, automatic phase discovery, moving-boundary dynamics, a global Gibbs-minimum claim and qualification.
- `caller_evidenced_solid_molar_volume_gap_occupancy_fixed_point_geometry`: Map caller-evidenced solid inventories to occupied gap volume with phase molar volumes, then update cell aperture, liquid volume and transport face area through a bounded damped stage fixed point. Geometry and occupancy are caller inputs; no mechanics, packing, porosity or kinetic phase evolution is inferred.
- `bound_crevice_current_carrying_result_to_component_state_schedules`: Bind a fully committed, digest-matched exact-knot CREVICE current-carrying result into a conserved-component BDF request. Preserve cell order, match initial component inventories, convert caller branch current densities to signed per-cell extent-rate schedules using the declared electron number and reactive area, carry ionic face currents, and require review of the sequential reconstruction. Reject stage-re-solved mixed-potential results because endpoint knots cannot reproduce their within-stage current history.
- `caller_general_aqueous_mass_action_speciation`: Solve a caller-defined square single-phase aqueous network in natural-log dimensionless activities. Use caller-supplied fixed activity coefficients and temperature-matched log10 equilibrium constants; solve caller-provided linear species amount and/or charge constraints after normalization by declared positive scales. A damped Newton method with finite-range checks and line search returns species activities, concentrations, balance closure, reaction residuals and full input/provider digests only within the declared tolerance. At a computed root, solve the converged Jacobian for implicit local derivatives of log activities and concentrations with respect to each log10(K), constraint target and fixed ln(gamma), without finite differencing. If explicitly reviewed, propagate a finite symmetric positive-semidefinite caller parameter covariance through those derivatives using first-order JΣJᵀ; condition and finite checks can make sensitivities unavailable while preserving the equilibrium result. No automatic electroneutrality, ionic-strength iteration, water balance, gas/solid phase, precipitation, kinetics, corrosion, or acceptance is inferred.
- `nist_codata_faraday_constant_2022`: CODATA Faraday constant used as an exact conversion constant; no source data table or prose is reproduced.
- `caller_lumped_slit_inertance_resistance`: Evaluate the caller-reviewed reduced planar-slit momentum law with the declared resistance and inertance correction factors; factors default to unity and non-unity values require exact fit-result Evidence and an applicability review.
- `caller_digest_bound_planar_slit_inertance_upwind_component_advection`: Bind a committed exact-clock planar-slit inertance history and Evidence-pinned electroneutral inlet/outlet compositions to a fixed-volume component-state BDF mesh. At every BDF RHS state, evaluate signed inertance flow, select upwind aqueous stage concentrations, project species advection to conserved components, and integrate separate left/right component, elemental and charge reservoir exchanges. Requires fixed aperture and caller-reviewed geometry; it does not solve moving boundaries or general momentum flow.
- `caller_reviewed_dynamic_slit_pressure_and_boundary_composition_schedule`: Bind a reviewed, digest-fixed pressure-drop and electroneutral reservoir-composition history to a moving-volume slit-transport calculation. The reduced Newtonian laminar slit model uses caller-declared fluid properties, correction factors and support limits; directional volume-rate estimation and physical validation remain explicit limitations.
- `caller_evidenced_dynamic_double_layer_and_faradaic_polarization_curves`: Integrate independent lumped electrode-cell potentials from an exact-knot total-current history, caller-supplied signed polarization tables and a differential-capacitance curve using I_total = I_F + dQ/dt. Interpolate only within declared supports, preserve Evidence digests and fail closed on solver/support/work limits. This does not solve electrolyte ohmic coupling, ionic transport, active-area evolution, or procedure qualification.
- `caller_evidenced_initial_crevice_double_layer_interfacial_state`: Pin the ordered cell identities, initial and reference interfacial potentials, and the exact differential-capacitance curve digest used to derive initial stored charge. The record is caller-supplied state evidence; it is not inferred from an independently solved voltage history.
- `same_stage_component_bdf_dynamic_double_layer_spatial_ohmic_faradaic_feedback`: Append one integrated double-layer charge state per fixed-geometry cell to the component BDF. At each trial, invert the caller differential-capacitance charge relation, refresh Nernst potentials and electrolyte conductivity from trial chemistry, reconstruct spatial ohmic face current, evaluate local Butler-Volmer branches, and project Faradaic extents plus charge continuity into the same RHS. The present scope has insulated ionic ends and excludes moving hydraulic boundaries and external circuit-current forcing.
- `same_stage_activity_based_competing_solid_kinetics_with_seed_depletion_events`: At each spatial component-BDF trial, reconstruct dissolved components from total component inventory and explicit per-phase solid moles, solve local activity-corrected aqueous chemistry, derive phase saturation and evaluate caller-pinned nucleation/growth laws. Integrate solid moles alongside transport/source/hydraulic ledgers and restart at located seed/depletion events. Kinetic parameter values, phase-set completeness, numerical verification and physical qualification remain caller/research responsibilities.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_component_state_faradaic_schedule_binding`

Producer and component-state time knots, species order/charge, cell order and initial conserved inventories must match. Exact-knot current density is converted to extent rate using the producer's declared per-cell reactive area and electron number. The resulting current and extent schedules are linearly reconstructed between exact knots; no stage mixed-potential feedback is implied. Caller source, reservoir, current, cell mapping and computational-use reviews are mandatory.

- `bound_crevice_current_carrying_result_to_component_state_schedules`: Bind a fully committed, digest-matched exact-knot CREVICE current-carrying result into a conserved-component BDF request. Preserve cell order, match initial component inventories, convert caller branch current densities to signed per-cell extent-rate schedules using the declared electron number and reactive area, carry ionic face currents, and require review of the sequential reconstruction. Reject stage-re-solved mixed-potential results because endpoint knots cannot reproduce their within-stage current history.
- `caller_evidenced_ionic_face_current_schedule`: Use review-gated caller-supplied exact-knot ionic currents on all faces, zero external boundary currents, and matching source-schedule times. Check each cell charge balance against Faraday-scaled reaction extents, solve the Nernst-Planck migration gradient to reproduce the requested interior current, and report ampere residuals and integrated charge; currents are not inferred from mixed-potential or Butler-Volmer kinetics.
- `nist_codata_faraday_constant_2022`: CODATA Faraday constant used as an exact conversion constant; no source data table or prose is reproduced.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_component_state_segment_handoff`

The source BDF request and exact Calculation result are digest-pinned and the source is committed with closed total-component ledgers. Caller phase molar volumes and gap-occupancy mappings are fixed over this exact boundary and bound to Evidence. Solid coverage is represented by a caller-reviewed uniform within-cell volume that reduces the open aperture; total component moles are preserved as the next segment initial state. This is a segment-boundary handoff only; it does not update geometry inside the BDF RHS or solve moving-boundary dynamics.

구현 근거:

- `caller_mapped_component_state_bdf_fixed_segment_handoff`: Verify an exact, result-digest-pinned committed component-state BDF Calculation with closed total-component ledgers, then preserve its final per-cell total component moles as candidate next-segment initial inventory. Caller-reviewed cell geometry, phase molar volumes and gap-occupancy mapping convert final candidate-solid moles to a positive next fixed-segment aperture, volume and interpolated face-area basis. No BDF request mutation, within-stage moving-boundary feedback, reaction, phase discovery or qualification is inferred.
- `finite_volume_conserved_component_inventory_bdf_state`: Integrate per-cell conserved aqueous component moles as the BDF state on a fixed-volume mesh with closed external boundaries; species concentrations are equilibrium reconstructions and reaction-invariant component maps provide the transported inventory basis.

## `integration.crevice_component_state_segment_transition`

Source BDF result is full-digest-bound, committed and component-ledger closed. Caller supplies digest/Evidence-bound next geometry and retains cell identity/order. Final conserved component moles transfer cellwise as the next segment initial state without concentration remapping. This is an operator-split segment transition, not an intrastep moving-boundary or monolithic solver.

구현 근거:

- `caller_mapped_committed_component_bdf_segment_transition`: Bind a committed, full-digest-pinned component-state BDF result and an Evidence-pinned caller-supplied target segment geometry. Preserve each conserved component mole inventory cellwise at the exact segment boundary, validate component/species identity and aperture-derived solution-volume closure, and construct a typed next-segment BDF request. This is an operator-split boundary transition; it does not derive geometry from deposits, remap across changing cell topology, or feed geometry back within a BDF RHS.
- `finite_volume_conserved_component_inventory_bdf_state`: Integrate per-cell conserved aqueous component moles as the BDF state on a fixed-volume mesh with closed external boundaries; species concentrations are equilibrium reconstructions and reaction-invariant component maps provide the transported inventory basis.

## `integration.crevice_composition_to_aqueous_mass_action_history`

Every composition knot binds to a caller-supplied aqueous reaction/constraint network and exact-temperature parameter set. The transfer composition is in mol/m3 and is converted to mol/L; fixed activity coefficients map concentrations to positive dimensionless initial activity guesses under a 1 mol/L standard state. Only explicitly caller-selected linear constraint IDs are rebuilt from the current composition; unselected targets such as a reviewed zero-charge condition are preserved. The network is solved as a single aqueous phase without phase-change or wall-loss inference.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_composition_to_mass_action_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_composition_to_mass_action_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `composition_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `composition_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `mass_action_systems_by_knot` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/AqueousMassActionSystem"}, "maxItems": 5000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `composition_derived_constraint_ids` | 아니오 | `{"default": [], "items": {"type": "string"}, "type": "array"}` |
| `zero_concentration_initial_activity_guess` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `composition_mapping_and_constraint_basis_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `composition_derived_constraint_semantics_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `zero_concentration_seed_is_numerical_only_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `each_temperature_specific_parameter_set_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `no_automatic_phase_change_or_kinetic_interpretation_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

구현 근거:

- `crevice_composition_to_caller_aqueous_mass_action_knot_history`: Bind a computed digest-pinned caller-volume crevice composition history to one caller-supplied strict aqueous mass-action network per exact knot. Convert mol/m3 to mol/L for the declared 1 mol/L activity standard state, apply caller fixed activity coefficients for the positive initial activity guess (or an explicitly reviewed numerical seed for zero inventory), rebuild only explicitly selected constraint targets from the current composition while preserving all unselected caller targets, and solve the supplied network without changing its reaction or constraint topology. Require exact temperatures, evidence lineage and model review. Do not infer equilibrium constants, activity coefficients, reactions, multiphase chemistry, kinetics, transport or wall loss.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_current_carrying_aperture_feedback`

Caller-specified solid molar volumes map endpoint aqueous/solid states to trial aperture histories. Caller-specified face-velocity sensitivity maps aperture departures from the initial history to hydraulic histories. Each fixed-point iteration reruns the complete current-carrying Nernst-Planck, mixed-potential, Faradaic and exact-knot chemistry path. Only a bounded converged geometry/hydraulic trial is returned; nonconvergence preserves iteration digest lineage and fails closed. Sensitivity updates are explicit caller linear maps, not general deposition morphology or hydraulic constitutive laws.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_current_carrying_aperture_feedback.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_current_carrying_aperture_feedback.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `current_carrying_request` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CreviceCurrentCarryingNernstPlanckRequest"}` |
| `transverse_width_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `face_area_weight_by_face_and_cell` | 예 | `{"items": {"items": {"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "type": "array"}, "maxItems": 301, "minItems": 3, "type": "array"}` |

구현 근거:

- `bounded_picard_feedback_of_current_carrying_crevice_transport_geometry`: Repeat the complete current-carrying Nernst–Planck/Faradaic and exact-knot chemistry trajectory using caller-provided solid-volume/aperture and aperture/face-velocity sensitivity mappings. Rebuild digest-pinned area histories on every trial and commit only after both geometry and hydraulic residuals satisfy caller tolerances. This knotwise outer iteration is not a continuous within-step geometry integration and has no general uniqueness or physical-qualification guarantee.
- `bounded_geometry_hydraulic_chemistry_picard_iteration`: Bounded outer iteration over registered spatial crevice chemistry-transport, caller solid-volume/aperture mapping and caller aperture/velocity sensitivity, requiring both residual classes and inherited mass-balance gates before commit.
- `caller_solid_volume_to_aperture_response`: Caller-evidenced mapping from finite solid inventory to a spatial aperture change; this parameterized mapping does not infer deposits, porosity or roughness.
- `caller_aperture_to_hydraulic_velocity_response`: Caller-provided aperture-to-face-velocity sensitivity with pinned units, geometry, evidence and record digest; not a hydraulic constitutive law.

## `integration.crevice_current_carrying_extent_to_metal_loss`

Consumes a computed, complete, digest-pinned current-carrying Faradaic AssessmentResult and its exact request. Converts already-integrated per-branch/per-cell molar extents directly; it does not integrate current or apply Faraday's law a second time. Every upstream branch is either mapped as caller-reviewed net metal dissolution or explicitly excluded with digest-pinned disposition evidence. Only nonnegative net extents are accepted for mapped dissolution branches; reversals within a source interval are not identifiable from interval totals. Caller provides reaction-to-metal stoichiometry, molar mass, density and cell reactive areas; recession is a uniform cell-area average.

## `integration.crevice_current_carrying_np_faradaic`

Cell 0 is the potential gauge at each exact knot; mouth and blind tip have zero ionic current. The caller mixed-potential face current is coupled to Nernst-Planck migration and must match the constitutive ionic flux. The legacy mode uses endpoint trapezoid splitting; opt-in bdf_stage_linear_current uses endpoint-linear branch-current interpolation and integrates cellwise sources/extents inside BDF stages. Signed charge stoichiometry must satisfy sum(z nu)=+n. Potential and equilibrium chemistry are solved at exact knots in legacy and linear-current modes. The opt-in spatial mixed-potential stage mode re-solves the quasi-steady ohmic/Butler-Volmer balance within each BDF RHS evaluation using fixed caller reaction topology and trial concentrations; that algebraic solve is not part of the BDF Newton Jacobian, and double-layer storage and phase discovery are not modeled. Optional B-dot stage activity refresh is caller-evidence-bound and coefficient-only; it is evaluated once per BDF RHS from mouth-plus-cell trial concentrations and feeds NP activity gradients, homogeneous activity-based kinetic rates, and stage Nernst/BV. It does not solve speciation or phase equilibrium; exact-knot/end-point chemistry remains on its existing activity model path. The caller provides all chemistry, kinetics, conductivity, geometry, reservoir and applicability inputs; no automatic discovery or qualification is included.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `finite_volume_current_carrying_activity_nernst_planck_with_faradaic_wall_balance`: Integrate variable-volume species inventories with activity-gradient, advection, diffusion and migration fluxes. Interior migration uses the caller mixed-potential voltage gradient; boundary electrical currents are insulated. Faradaic wall reaction is a distinct endpoint-trapezoid species source. Iteration commits only when face-current, potential, branch-current, chemistry, charge and element ledgers close within declared tolerances; this does not include double-layer storage or within-step equilibrium.
- `mixed_potential_face_current_to_ionic_nernst_planck_flux_closure`: Compare the ionic current reconstructed from signed species face fluxes and caller face areas against the spatial mixed-potential current at each internal face. Reject constitutively incompatible conductivity and mobility mappings instead of adjusting transport fluxes to force agreement.
- `scipy_integrate_bdf`: Integrate the declared stiff initial-value transport system with SciPy's variable-order backward differentiation formula implementation using caller-selected tolerances and ordered output times; numerical solver choice does not establish physical validation.
- `endpoint_trapezoid_faradaic_inventory_split`: Apply caller-mapped Faradaic species sources and branch extents after each transport interval using endpoint trapezoidal integration; preserve this legacy operator-split method as the default and do not infer intra-interval kinetics.
- `endpoint_linear_branch_current_bdf_stage_inventory_source`: Interpolate caller-computed Faradaic branch-current densities linearly between exact-knot mixed-potential solutions, then integrate branch extents and mapped aqueous species sources inside the transport BDF stages. The mixed-potential/equilibrium solves remain endpoint-coupled; this method is not a fully coupled electrochemical DAE or a qualified corrosion law.
- `bdf_stage_spatial_ohmic_mixed_potential_and_faradaic_source`: At each BDF right-hand-side evaluation, solve the existing caller-parameterized spatial quasi-steady ohmic/Butler-Volmer mixed-potential problem from trial aqueous concentrations and stage geometry/conductivity records, then integrate its Faradaic branch sources and extents with transport. No double-layer storage, chemistry-phase discovery, or qualified corrosion kinetics are inferred.
- `caller_evidence_bound_bdot_activity_refresh_at_bdf_stages`: At every BDF RHS evaluation in the reviewed spatial mixed-potential mode, recompute caller-parameterized B-dot activity coefficients from the trial aqueous state and use the same coefficients in Nernst-Planck activity gradients, homogeneous activity-based kinetics and stage Nernst/Butler-Volmer calculations. Bind interval parameter request digests and bound total callback evaluations. This does not solve mass-action speciation, solid equilibrium or activity parameter qualification.
- `finite_volume_current_carrying_activity_nernst_planck_with_faradaic_wall_balance`: Integrate variable-volume species inventories with activity-gradient, advection, diffusion and migration fluxes. Interior migration uses the caller mixed-potential voltage gradient; boundary electrical currents are insulated. Faradaic wall reaction is a distinct endpoint-trapezoid species source. Iteration commits only when face-current, potential, branch-current, chemistry, charge and element ledgers close within declared tolerances; this does not include double-layer storage or within-step equilibrium.
- `mixed_potential_face_current_to_ionic_nernst_planck_flux_closure`: Compare the ionic current reconstructed from signed species face fluxes and caller face areas against the spatial mixed-potential current at each internal face. Reject constitutively incompatible conductivity and mobility mappings instead of adjusting transport fluxes to force agreement.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_deposition_aperture_history`

Each exact-knot solid-volume result is per the declared reference area and matches the physical scope, time and cell ordering. Solid volume is distributed equally across the declared one or two deposition faces and uniformly over the caller-declared coverage within each cell. Equivalent mean gap loss is solid volume divided by the cell planform area; covered-patch local closure additionally depends on the reviewed coverage fraction and face count. Negative remaining aperture and positive deposition volume with zero coverage fail closed; no clipping or extrapolation occurs. The mapping is a geometric adapter only and does not resolve morphology, porosity, adhesion, kinetics or transport feedback.

- `caller_crevice_deposition_aperture_geometry_mapping`: Map caller-reviewed solid-volume snapshots to mean-equivalent and covered-patch gap measures using explicit cell geometry, reference area, deposition faces, and coverage. Preserve exact result digests and physical/time/cell alignment. Equal face partition and uniform within-cell coverage are declared assumptions; this geometry mapping does not resolve deposit morphology, porosity, adhesion, transport feedback, corrosion or acceptance.

## `integration.crevice_deposition_transport_geometry`

Only the upstream volume-conserving equivalent mean aperture is forwarded; it is treated as uniform within each transport cell after explicit caller review. The transport reference cross section and reactive broad-face count are caller declarations and must match the downstream transport request. Cell and face areas use slit cross section = mean aperture times transverse width; interior face areas use linear interpolation between cell centers and end faces use nearest-cell constant extrapolation. Each state is prepared for a subsequent fixed-geometry operator-split transport campaign; the bridge does not iterate deposition and transport together. Coverage heterogeneity, deposit morphology, porosity, adhesion, transient momentum and chemistry/geometry feedback within a time segment are not resolved.

## `integration.crevice_double_layer_charge_history`

## `integration.crevice_double_layer_to_component_bdf_binding`

The double-layer history uses caller-pinned potential, reference potential, active area and differential capacitance; its stored charge is positive into the electrode. The component-state BDF capacitive source is positive into aqueous solution and must integrate to the negative electrode charge change on every exact interval and cell. Caller current knots are reconstructed linearly between exact knots; only interval charge closure is established, not instantaneous current constitutive fidelity. The adapter produces a typed BDF request and does not solve electrode potential or infer Faradaic kinetics.

## `integration.crevice_dynamic_double_layer_faradaic_history`

Caller-provided polarization and differential-capacitance curves are used only within their declared supports. Active area, imposed total current and branch equilibrium potentials are interpolated linearly between exact caller knots. The ODE applies I_total = I_F + dQ/dt with Q from the exact integral of the piecewise-linear differential-capacitance curve. This is independent-cell lumped dynamics; no electrolyte network, moving boundary, kinetic parameter calibration or qualification is inferred.

| `initial_inventory` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CreviceInitialSpeciesInventory"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `liquid_volume_history` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CreviceElectrolyteVolumeKnot"}, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `complete_species_inventory_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `all_other_sources_and_sinks_included_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `well_mixed_single_volume_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `fixed_basis_and_interval_transfer_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `composition_history[].time_s` | `s` |
| `composition_history[].temperature_K` | `K` |
| `composition_history[].liquid_volume_m3` | `m3` |
| `composition_history[].species[].amount_mol` | `mol` |
| `composition_history[].species[].concentration_mol_m3` | `mol/m3` |
| `composition_history[].interval_signed_transfer_mol_by_species.*` | `mol` |

구현 근거:

- `crevice_electrochemical_transfer_to_well_mixed_composition_history`: Consume a computed digest-verified area-scaled transfer ledger and caller initial mole inventory for every affected species plus liquid volumes at exactly aligned output knots. Apply cumulative signed species transfer to those amounts and divide by the caller volumes; require complete species/source-sink inventory, well-mixed compartment, mapping and use reviews. Do not solve chemistry, transport, precipitation, losses, or corrosion/material acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_electrochemical_inventory_transfer`

Only a computed digest-pinned crevice mixed-potential result is accepted, and the exact upstream reference-area basis is reused. Between adjacent declared knots, each species flux is reconstructed as a straight line and integrated exactly; this policy requires explicit caller review and does not establish the true within-interval kinetics. The output is an area-scaled species transfer ledger and is not bulk concentration, metal loss, corrosion rate, protection, risk or acceptance.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_electrochemical_inventory_integration.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_electrochemical_inventory_integration.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `mixed_potential_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `mixed_potential_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `reference_area_m2` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `piecewise_linear_flux_between_knots_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `constant_reference_area_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `stoichiometric_inward_sign_convention_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `reference_area_m2` | `m2` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].start_time_s` | `s` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].end_time_s` | `s` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].start_temperature_K` | `K` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].end_temperature_K` | `K` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].reaction_species_transfer[].species_transfer[].signed_net_transfer_mol` | `mol` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].reaction_species_transfer[].species_transfer[].inward_transfer_mol` | `mol` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].reaction_species_transfer[].species_transfer[].outward_transfer_mol` | `mol` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].reaction_species_transfer[].species_transfer[].cumulative_signed_net_transfer_mol` | `mol` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].reaction_species_transfer[].species_transfer[].cumulative_inward_transfer_mol` | `mol` |
| `interval_inventory_transfer[].reaction_species_transfer[].species_transfer[].cumulative_outward_transfer_mol` | `mol` |
| `cumulative_inventory_transfer_by_reaction.*.*.signed_mol` | `mol` |
| `cumulative_inventory_transfer_by_reaction.*.*.inward_mol` | `mol` |
| `cumulative_inventory_transfer_by_reaction.*.*.outward_mol` | `mol` |

## `integration.crevice_external_activity_local_solid_saturation`

The computed external-activity projection result must match its typed input, transport binding, exact knot and all cell context digests. Cell dimensionless activities are formed as gamma at the molarity 1 mol/L standard state times concentration in mol/L. The caller supplies a complete candidate-solid list, Ksp records, compatible temperature/standard state, Evidence and all review decisions. The existing aqueous saturation calculation is evaluated independently per cell; saturation is not phase selection, precipitation amount, kinetics, wall deposition, corrosion rate or qualification.

구현 근거:

- `caller_external_activity_crevice_cell_saturation_handoff`: Bind one exact knot from a computed external-activity crevice projection to caller-selected candidate-solid saturation screens. Recompute and verify each cell context digest, require the exact provider/configuration/parameter lineage, and form dimensionless molarity-standard-state activities from the projected gamma coefficient and concentration before invoking the existing saturation calculation. Require caller Evidence and temperature/standard-state/candidate reviews. Preserve successful cell prefix and upstream result digests. Do not select phases, predict precipitation, mix spatial cells, infer kinetics, corrosion, or qualification.
- `caller_crevice_cell_local_candidate_saturation_screen`: Screen caller-specified candidate-solid saturation independently for each local cell in one exact transport knot, preserving the composition ledger, local mass-action result, cell transport context and solubility-source digests. A common candidate solubility set requires common temperature and standard state. This does not select phases, calculate precipitation amount or kinetics, mix cells, update geometry or qualify corrosion behavior.
- `caller_external_aqueous_activity_provider`: Accept caller-computed composition-dependent molality-standard-state activity coefficients from an external Python callback and couple them to the existing molarity-standard-state mass-action solver with bounded damped fixed-point iteration. Bind each provider request to the exact temperature, ordered species/charges, molality vector, ionic strength and water-mass basis; require provider identity/revision, configuration and parameter digests, exact species coverage/order, echoed request digest, declared single-ion convention, ionic-strength agreement, evidence and explicit applicability reviews. Convert gamma_m to gamma_c=gamma_m/w for the 1 mol/L mass-action basis. The same provider boundary can supply molality gamma values to a restricted-transport callback at each mouth/cell state using the caller-declared fixed solvent-mass basis. The project imports and bundles no thermodynamic provider, parameter table or license-restricted implementation; the adapter does not qualify provider equations, parameter coverage, local equilibrium or solution chemistry.

## `integration.crevice_faradaic_spatial_chemistry_coupling`

Caller declares all branch kinetics, standard potentials, activity quotient coefficients, conductivity mappings, reaction stoichiometry and external element reservoirs. Transport is advanced first, Faradaic branch extents are applied by endpoint trapezoid, and the local caller chemistry is then re-solved at exact knots. The reused variable-area transport kernel requires zero ionic current at every face; any endpoint mixed-potential result with nonzero electrolyte face current is rejected. No double-layer current, intrastage chemistry/electrochemistry, automatic mechanism discovery or material qualification is included.

- `scipy_integrate_bdf`: Integrate the declared stiff initial-value transport system with SciPy's variable-order backward differentiation formula implementation using caller-selected tolerances and ordered output times; numerical solver choice does not establish physical validation.

## `integration.crevice_kinetic_solid_volume_history`

Upstream solid_inventory_mol_m3_by_phase values are per solution volume and their exact species/phase order is bound to the typed kinetic campaign. Only fixed geometry is accepted; per-reference-area cell liquid volume is the fixed cell area/reference area ratio times cell length. Caller-provided solid molar volumes apply to each phase and snapshot; the existing solid-volume inventory evaluator performs the volume conversion. Only a computed upstream campaign with its aqueous inventory closure inside declared tolerance is consumed. No shape, porosity, adhesion, wall coverage, aperture closure, moving geometry, transport feedback or qualification is inferred.

## `integration.crevice_local_external_activity_projection`

Transported cell compositions set only the explicitly selected mass-action constraint targets; each exact cell then solves an independent caller-reviewed activity fixed point. The activity provider is injected as an explicit runtime dependency and must match the provider identity, revision, configuration digest, parameter digest, species ordering and molality standard state in the request. Reaction topology, equilibrium constants, cell temperature, water-mass conversion, activity convention and one-liquid scope are caller declared; no phase transition, inter-knot kinetic evolution or transport feedback is computed. Only complete exact transport knots are committed, and the mass-action ledger retains both the converged inner-system input digest and external-provider transcript.

Runtime 의존성: `activity_provider` 이름으로 실행 시점에 Python callable/provider를 주입한다. 해당 provider 객체는 JSON 입력에 포함되지 않으며, 입력 계약에 기록한 provider ID·revision·configuration/record digest와 Evidence가 실행계보를 식별한다.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_local_mass_action_projection.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_local_mass_action_projection.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `transport_binding` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/CreviceTransportCompositionBridge"}` |
| `transport_binding_result` | 예 | `{"additionalProperties": true, "type": "object"}` |
| `transport_binding_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `knots` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CreviceMassActionProjectionKnot"}, "maxItems": 500, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `composition_derived_constraint_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 100, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `zero_concentration_initial_activity_guess` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `cell_composition_to_constraint_basis_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `complete_component_inventory_and_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `fixed_activity_and_equilibrium_parameter_support_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `cell_specific_temperature_and_solution_identity_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `single_liquid_no_solid_transition_scope_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `no_interknot_kinetics_or_transport_feedback_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `zero_concentration_seed_is_numerical_only_reviewed` | 아니오 | `{"default": false, "type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `activity_iteration_template` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/ExternalAqueousActivityIteration"}` |

| `knots[].cells[].species_inventory_mol.*` | `mol` |
| `knots[].cells[].activity_coefficient_molarity_standard_state_by_species.*` | `1` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_component_constraint_basis_for_crevice_local_speciation`: For each cell and exact knot of a digest-pinned crevice transport-composition campaign, replace only the caller-selected linear mass-action constraint targets with the corresponding caller-declared component sums of that cell concentration converted from mol/m3 to mol/L, preserve every unselected target, and execute the supplied fixed-activity single-liquid mass-action solver. Keep the activity coefficients, reaction network, equilibrium constants, temperature and phase scope caller supplied. Preserve complete-knot prefixes and cell/result lineage. This is an independent local operator-split equilibrium projection; it does not feed results back to transport, interpolate time, discover phases, or infer corrosion or qualification.
- `caller_crevice_local_speciation_volume_ledger`: Bind separately computed, digest-pinned aqueous mass-action results to every cell at exact knots of one digest-pinned crevice transport-composition campaign. Require explicit review of state-to-constraint mapping, species/result lineage, spatial separation, volume basis and no bulk/phase inference. Convert declared mol/L species concentrations to conditional per-cell inventories from the supplied m3 volumes; report charge and available elemental totals as diagnostics and retain only complete exact-knot prefixes. Do not solve equilibrium, mix compartments, infer charge closure, kinetics, corrosion or acceptance.
- `caller_external_aqueous_activity_provider`: Accept caller-computed composition-dependent molality-standard-state activity coefficients from an external Python callback and couple them to the existing molarity-standard-state mass-action solver with bounded damped fixed-point iteration. Bind each provider request to the exact temperature, ordered species/charges, molality vector, ionic strength and water-mass basis; require provider identity/revision, configuration and parameter digests, exact species coverage/order, echoed request digest, declared single-ion convention, ionic-strength agreement, evidence and explicit applicability reviews. Convert gamma_m to gamma_c=gamma_m/w for the 1 mol/L mass-action basis. The same provider boundary can supply molality gamma values to a restricted-transport callback at each mouth/cell state using the caller-declared fixed solvent-mass basis. The project imports and bundles no thermodynamic provider, parameter table or license-restricted implementation; the adapter does not qualify provider equations, parameter coverage, local equilibrium or solution chemistry.
- `caller_crevice_local_external_activity_projection`: For each exact digest-bound transport cell, derive only the explicitly selected mass-action constraint targets from the caller-declared component basis, then solve that cell's liquid mass-action state with a caller-injected, evidence-bound molality activity provider using the existing damped activity fixed-point solver. Bind provider identity, revision, configuration and parameter digests; preserve the exact converged inner mass-action input digest, provider transcript and complete-knot prefix. Reaction topology, equilibrium constants, temperature support, solvent conversion and single-ion convention remain caller declared. The independent cell solves do not create phase transitions, inter-knot kinetics, transport feedback, a qualified aqueous activity model or corrosion rate.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_local_mass_action_projection`

For every exact transport cell knot, the caller supplies a reviewed single-liquid mass-action system whose species order matches the transported composition. Each linear-constraint target is set to the corresponding caller-declared linear combination of transported cell concentrations converted from mol/m3 to mol/L. Fixed activity coefficients, reactions, equilibrium constants, temperature, phase scope, and initial activity guesses remain caller-supplied and reviewed. Local solves are independent and operator-split after transport; they are not fed back into inter-knot transport and do not evolve solids, wall loss, corrosion rate, or qualification.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_component_constraint_basis_for_crevice_local_speciation`: For each cell and exact knot of a digest-pinned crevice transport-composition campaign, replace only the caller-selected linear mass-action constraint targets with the corresponding caller-declared component sums of that cell concentration converted from mol/m3 to mol/L, preserve every unselected target, and execute the supplied fixed-activity single-liquid mass-action solver. Keep the activity coefficients, reaction network, equilibrium constants, temperature and phase scope caller supplied. Preserve complete-knot prefixes and cell/result lineage. This is an independent local operator-split equilibrium projection; it does not feed results back to transport, interpolate time, discover phases, or infer corrosion or qualification.
- `caller_crevice_local_speciation_volume_ledger`: Bind separately computed, digest-pinned aqueous mass-action results to every cell at exact knots of one digest-pinned crevice transport-composition campaign. Require explicit review of state-to-constraint mapping, species/result lineage, spatial separation, volume basis and no bulk/phase inference. Convert declared mol/L species concentrations to conditional per-cell inventories from the supplied m3 volumes; report charge and available elemental totals as diagnostics and retain only complete exact-knot prefixes. Do not solve equilibrium, mix compartments, infer charge closure, kinetics, corrosion or acceptance.
- `caller_general_aqueous_mass_action_speciation`: Solve a caller-defined square single-phase aqueous network in natural-log dimensionless activities. Use caller-supplied fixed activity coefficients and temperature-matched log10 equilibrium constants; solve caller-provided linear species amount and/or charge constraints after normalization by declared positive scales. A damped Newton method with finite-range checks and line search returns species activities, concentrations, balance closure, reaction residuals and full input/provider digests only within the declared tolerance. At a computed root, solve the converged Jacobian for implicit local derivatives of log activities and concentrations with respect to each log10(K), constraint target and fixed ln(gamma), without finite differencing. If explicitly reviewed, propagate a finite symmetric positive-semidefinite caller parameter covariance through those derivatives using first-order JΣJᵀ; condition and finite checks can make sensitivities unavailable while preserving the equilibrium result. No automatic electroneutrality, ionic-strength iteration, water balance, gas/solid phase, precipitation, kinetics, corrosion, or acceptance is inferred.
