## `integration.crevice_local_solid_saturation`

The selected local-speciation ledger result and each exact transport cell context must match their supplied canonical digests. Every local mass-action result must be computed from the exact typed request and retain the same species order as the supplied candidate saturation definitions. One candidate-solubility record set is reused across the selected knot, so all cells must share the exact temperature and activity standard state declared by their local mass-action requests. Existing aqueous saturation screening uses caller-supplied dimensionless activities, candidate stoichiometric activity products, solubility constants, evidence and review gates; the adapter does not infer or qualify them. Each cell is screened independently; no phase selection, phase amount, spatial mixing, precipitation kinetics or corrosion rate is calculated.

## `integration.crevice_local_speciation_volume_ledger`

Only complete exact geometry-side knots are committed. Charge and elemental totals are diagnostics and do not imply electroneutrality or phase balance unless separately declared by the local request. ## `integration.crevice_moving_volume_liquid_continuity`

Linear aperture change between exact knots implies constant interval-mean volume rate. Positive face flow is left-to-right and each cell obeys dV/dt = Q_left - Q_right. This operator supplies a conservative kinematic schedule only; it does not solve pressure-driven momentum or reactive transport.

## `integration.crevice_multispecies_wall_flux_callback`

Each transported species has one digest-pinned calibrated wall-transfer history and an explicit equilibrium surface-concentration profile on the same geometry knots. Each species obeys an independent linear wall law; this callback does not represent stoichiometrically coupled surface reactions or competition for shared sites. Species order exactly matches the transport request, and each wall rate/profile is linearly interpolated only between common exact knots without extrapolation. The transport solver applies its geometry wall-area density once after receiving the surface flux matrix. The caller reviews surface-state concentration meaning, calibration applicability and each independent wall-law assumption.

## `integration.crevice_neutral_reactive_transport_1d`

Caller-defined neutral chemical species undergo reversible local mass-action reactions while diffusing through a fixed one-dimensional finite-volume geometry. The caller supplies rate constant values at each output knot; both boundary concentrations and rate constants are linearly interpolated between knots. The mouth is Dirichlet and the blind tip is no-flux; advection, electromigration and wall reaction are excluded.

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crevice_neutral_reaction_diffusion_network`: Require a caller-defined finite neutral-species reaction network with atom-balanced reversible mass-action terms, species diffusivities, fixed geometry and explicit kinetic parameter lineage. No ionic activity, wall reaction, phase equilibrium or corrosion mechanism is implied.
- `caller_crevice_reactive_transport_mouth_history`: Apply caller-provided ordered mouth concentration and reaction-rate schedules at explicit time knots to a fixed-geometry, blind-tip crevice transport calculation. Input interpolation and boundary meaning remain caller reviewed.
- `finite_volume_diffusion_with_local_reversible_mass_action`: Co-integrate one-dimensional fixed-geometry Fick diffusion and caller-defined local reversible mass-action kinetics using finite volumes and a stiff initial-value solver. Track boundary transfer, reaction transfer and species inventory residuals; no convection, electromigration, wall kinetics or corrosion is inferred.
- [SciPy scipy.integrate.solve_ivp API](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.integrate.solve_ivp.html) (`scipy_integrate_solve_ivp`)
- `scipy_integrate_bdf`: Integrate the declared stiff initial-value transport system with SciPy's variable-order backward differentiation formula implementation using caller-selected tolerances and ordered output times; numerical solver choice does not establish physical validation.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_saturation_exposure_history`

Every upstream exact-knot saturation result is computed, digest-pinned, and belongs to the declared physical scope and exact time. Candidate solid ordering and cell ordering remain identical at every knot; cells are not mixed or remapped. Log10 saturation ratio is reconstructed as piecewise linear in time only because the caller explicitly reviews that path. The API analytically integrates max(0, log10(Q/K)) and the time for which the reconstructed value is positive; these diagnostics do not define a kinetic law or precipitation amount. Ksp/activity standard-state comparability across supplied knots is caller reviewed and is not automatically validated from underlying source records.

| `exact_knot_lineage_and_spatial_cell_identity_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `same_candidate_solubility_basis_across_knots_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `exposure_metric_is_not_a_rate_law_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|

| `positive_log10_saturation_exposure_s_by_solid_and_cell.*` | `s` |

| `maximum_sampled_log10_saturation_ratio_by_solid_and_cell.*` | `1` |

The finite-sample diagnostic is an exposure descriptor, not precipitation amount, phase selection, nucleation, kinetics, corrosion rate or acceptance.

## `integration.crevice_saturation_interval_average_rates`

Exact local saturation results cover every transport cell and candidate solid at each exact transport clock knot. Saturation ratio is reconstructed piecewise linearly within each transport interval; the caller explicitly reviews this approximation. Existing caller-calibrated precipitation/dissolution constants and exponents are applied at their declared fixed campaign temperature/support. An even subdivision at S=1 is integrated with caller-selected finite-order Gauss-Legendre quadrature; no error estimate or exactness claim is provided. The resulting average rates feed only the existing solid inventory-limited, element/charge-balanced kinetic ledger; no within-interval saturation feedback or phase selection is inferred.

| `uniform_kinetic_temperature_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `average_rate_applied_over_each_interval_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `no_within_interval_saturation_feedback_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

| `intervals[].phase_extent_rate_mol_m3_s_by_cell.*` | `mol/(m3 s)` |

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crevice_saturation_path_average_rate`: Integrate the existing caller precipitation/dissolution power law over each caller-reviewed piecewise-linear saturation path, split the interval at saturation ratio one, and provide finite quadrature interval-average rates to the existing inventory-limited kinetic ledger. Preserve exact local cell/phase/time lineage. Saturation is not updated inside an interval; finite quadrature has no claimed error bound and no simultaneous chemistry/geometry solution is implied.

## `integration.crevice_solid_inventory_geometry_boundary_remap`

The source kinetic result is computed, digest-bound, closed within its declared tolerance, and uses the typed fixed-geometry campaign. At the exact boundary, each solid phase remains in the same axial cell with no creation, loss or cross-cell redistribution. Source and target transport use the same cell grid and reference cross section; target solid concentration is inventory per reference area divided by target liquid volume per reference area. The target geometry is supplied as a computed geometry-history state with complete positive cell cross sections. This remap is sequential and does not perform a coupled kinetic/geometry/transport solve.

- `caller_evidenced_crevice_phase_molar_volume_gap_occupancy_map`: Consume a caller-evidenced ordered cell/phase map of solid molar volumes and explicit gap-occupancy flags. This map supplies geometric conversion factors only; phase identity, thermodynamic stability and property qualification remain caller responsibilities.
- `caller_evidenced_crevice_cell_phase_molar_rate_stage`: Consume signed caller-evidenced solid molar rates at one exact physical-scope clock stage, preserving ordered cell and phase identities. Positive values denote formation and negative values dissolution; the adapter does not calibrate or qualify a kinetic law.
- `composed_crevice_stage_geometry_and_phase_volume_rate`: Bind a caller-authorized composite license record to the exact digest of a hydraulic stage geometry and phase-derived liquid-volume rates. The record authorizes only the declared composition and makes no claim that source licenses transfer automatically.
- `caller_evidenced_planar_slit_instantaneous_hydraulic_rhs`: Evaluate a caller-evidenced instantaneous planar-slit resistance/inertance state and signed dQ/dt from current flow, pressure drop, geometry and fluid properties. This is a reusable stage RHS only; it does not integrate time or couple to reactive transport or moving-volume continuity.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.crevice_solid_volume_inventory`

Each phase inventory is nonnegative amount per caller-reviewed reference area for the same exact snapshot and spatial cell mapping. Each supplied molar volume applies to the stated solid phase and snapshot; product inventory times molar volume gives its compact-solid volume equivalent. Summation preserves cell identity; the output is volume per reference area and is not assigned to a wall or converted to aperture closure. Evidence is caller supplied and is not automatically qualified or independently validated by this adapter.

## `integration.crevice_spatial_chemistry_aperture_fixed_point`

Each outer trial reruns the registered spatial chemistry-transport operator-split calculation on its exact knot history. Aperture response is derived only from caller-mapped finite solid volume and a caller-reviewed solid-volume-to-gap coefficient. Hydraulic feedback is a bounded caller-supplied aperture sensitivity tensor; no pressure-flow law is inferred. Both aperture and face-velocity residuals must satisfy caller tolerances before committing a result; failure retains the accepted trial prefix. Aqueous activity/speciation is held over each transport interval and recalculated at the endpoint knot; no monolithic chemistry-transport integration is claimed.

## `integration.crevice_spatial_mass_action_workflow`

A complete caller-provided aqueous mass-action system is solved independently at each exact transport knot and cell; only the existing solver is used. Cell chemistry mapping, species basis, volume interpretation and phase scope remain caller-owned; no concentrations or constraints are inferred from transport fields. The existing local speciation ledger is assembled only after all cell systems compute, preserving exact geometry-side and cell context lineage.

## `integration.crevice_spatial_ohmic_mixed_potential`

One continuous metal conductor has a common potential and caller-defined reaction branches act at finite slit cells. One-dimensional electrolyte ohmic resistance couples adjacent local mixed-potential reactions; both axial ends are electrically insulated. Each exact time knot is solved as a separate quasi-steady state with local Butler-Volmer kinetics and caller equilibrium potentials.

구현 근거:

Report cell potentials, branch and face currents and closure residuals; exclude speciation, concentration polarization, charging and metal resistance.

## `integration.crevice_spatial_ohmic_partial_current_metal_loss`

A computed spatial ohmic mixed-potential history is the sole current source and is pinned by its complete AssessmentResult digest. Only explicitly selected anodic-positive dissolution branches are integrated; the caller owns branch chemistry and Faraday mapping. Per-cell reactive areas are fixed and caller reviewed; local recession is uniform over each mapped cell area.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `upstream_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `upstream_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `mappings` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CreviceSpatialDissolutionBranchMapping"}, "maxItems": 64, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `piecewise_linear_current_between_knots_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `state_history[].time_s` | `s` |
| `state_history[].branches[].signed_current_density_A_m2_by_cell[]` | `A/m^2` |
| `interval_ledger[].mapped_reaction_branches[].cells[].gross_anodic_charge_C` | `C` |
| `branch_totals[].total_metal_dissolved_mol` | `mol` |
| `interval_ledger[].mapped_reaction_branches[].cells[].mass_loss_kg` | `kg` |
| `branch_totals[].cumulative_uniform_cell_area_recession_m_by_cell[]` | `m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crevice_spatial_dissolution_branch_mapping`: Map explicitly identified anodic spatial mixed-potential branches to dissolved metal using caller electron count, stoichiometry, current efficiency, molar mass, density and reactive cell area with evidence/digest lineage. No cathodic redeposition or localized geometry correction is inferred.
- `piecewise_linear_positive_spatial_current_faraday_recession`: Integrate only the positive anodic portion of a digest-verified finite spatial branch-current history using piecewise-linear exact-knot segments, then apply Faraday stoichiometry and fixed cell area to obtain gross equivalent uniform recession. It is not a pitting model, full corrosion model or probability/qualification result.
- `electrochemical_partial_current_to_metal_loss`: Require a computed digest-pinned mixed-potential history and caller-reviewed metal-dissolution mapping for each selected reaction. Integrate each upstream reference-area current-density branch with the exact trapezoid integral under a declared piecewise-linear between-knot reconstruction. Divide charge by the upstream reaction electron number and Faraday constant, apply the caller metal-atom stoichiometric factor and evidence-linked molar mass, then divide signed mass change by caller density and actual mapped branch area for a uniform area-average recession. Report anodic and cathodic equivalents separately from signed net transfer. This implements Faraday charge-to-reaction accounting only; it does not validate current kinetics, alloy selectivity, completeness of selected dissolution reactions, local attack, evolving geometry or corrosion qualification.

## `integration.crevice_transport_to_local_mass_action`

Caller-reviewed one-to-one mappings set one existing aqueous mass-action linear constraint from a transported concentration per exact cell and knot. Each cell and knot uses an independently supplied full mass-action system; temperature, activity, constants, formulae and phase scope remain caller controlled. The chemistry solve is one-way; no concentration feedback, transport update or automatic phase selection is performed.

구현 근거:

- `caller_crevice_transport_to_mass_action_constraint_mapping`: Declare an explicit one-to-one mapping from caller-named transport species and exact output knots/cells to caller-supplied aqueous mass-action linear constraints. The mapping fixes concentration scaling and preserves input Evidence/digest; it does not infer chemistry.
- `caller_crevice_transport_cell_volume_mapping`: Supply evidence- and digest-bound finite cell volumes to convert caller-aligned transported concentrations to cell species inventories. No geometry or cell volume is inferred from the transport field.
- `exact_cell_transport_field_mass_action_constraint_binding`: At each exact cell and time knot, convert mapped transport concentration from mol/m3 to the caller-declared mol/L constraint target, solve the caller's existing aqueous mass-action template independently, and compute cell inventory with explicit volume mapping. Preserve first-failure prefixes; do not infer reaction networks, feedback, phase selection or corrosion.
- `caller_crevice_spatial_mass_action_workflow`: For each exact transport-knot cell, require a complete caller-authored mass-action system with unique request identity, empty result slots, explicit local-solver authorization and cell-chemistry mapping review. Reuse the existing aqueous mass-action solver independently per cell, stop at the first failure, and assemble the existing volume ledger only when every required cell result is computed. Do not generate chemistry, constraints, phases, kinetics, corrosion, transport feedback or bulk mixing.

## `integration.crevice_wall_flux_inventory_history`

The callback rate, wall surface concentration, bulk concentration, wall-area density and slit cross section are reconstructed linearly within each exact shared time interval. Cell wall area is computed as wall area per liquid volume times cross-sectional liquid area times axial cell width. Three-point Gauss-Legendre integrates the resulting polynomial transfer rate exactly under the declared linear inputs; no such exactness applies to nonlinear paths. Positive integrated amount denotes transfer into the crevice liquid according to the callback's inward-positive convention. The amount is a species boundary transfer ledger only; it does not imply stoichiometric reaction, metal loss or phase formation.

| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.crevice_wall_flux_inventory_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.crevice_wall_flux_inventory_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |

| `bulk_concentration_mol_m3_by_knot_species_cell` | 예 | `{"items": {"items": {"items": {"type": "number"}, "type": "array"}, "type": "array"}, "maxItems": 5000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `bulk_concentration_history_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `exact_clock_species_cell_order_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `piecewise_linear_bulk_concentration_path_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `wall_area_from_geometry_density_and_liquid_volume_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `callback_flux_sign_convention_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `transfer_amount_is_not_reaction_extent_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `elapsed_time_s[]` | `s` |
| `bulk_concentration_mol_m3_by_knot_species_cell` | `mol/m3` |
| `net_wall_transfer_mol_by_species_cell.*` | `mol` |
| `net_wall_transfer_mol_by_species.*` | `mol` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

For the declared linear paths, use the fixed three-point Gauss-Legendre rule and preserve signed boundary flux, order, clock and source digests. This records boundary transfer only; it does not infer reaction extent, metal loss or solid formation.

구현 근거:

- `electrochemical_chemistry_state_boundary_audit`: Audit a caller-ordered chain of computed chemistry, speciation or transport results by exact result/input/context digests and caller-selected JSON result paths. Require exact asset/location/clock, time knots, temperature, material condition, solvent and activity standard-state agreement. Require a unique explicit Evidence-backed disposition for every source species at every adjacent stage boundary and verify that downstream-consumed IDs are covered by mapped targets. Preserve resolved state digests and source references. This is a provenance/state-boundary check; it does not discover species, convert standard states/units, balance reactions, solve chemistry or validate physics.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.electrochemical_metal_loss_to_crevice_geometry`

Only a computed digest-pinned electrochemical metal-loss result with every selected reaction explicitly allocated is accepted. Legacy metal-loss results require caller-supplied per-reaction volume fractions at every exact knot; the current-carrying extent bridge instead uses its digest-pinned per-cell volume ledger directly. The first supplied source time is mapped to elapsed geometry time zero; a nonzero origin requires explicit caller review and is retained in result lineage. Reaction-to-face, allocation, combined-area, cell-center mapping, geometry and computational-use reviews are mandatory; two-face use also requires equal-face recession review. The existing planar-slit remap computes sequential geometry only inside caller aperture support. This is not local current prediction or a fully coupled moving-boundary solver.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.electrochemical_crevice_geometry_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.electrochemical_crevice_geometry_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `geometry_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_source_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_cell_ids` | 아니오 | `{"default": [], "items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 2000, "type": "array"}` |
| `cell_widths_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 2000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `initial_cell_aperture_m` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 2000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `transverse_width_m` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `reference_cross_section_m2` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |

구현 근거:

- `electrochemical_metal_loss_to_crevice_geometry`: Require the computed digest-pinned metal-loss AssessmentResult and caller-declared slit geometry. Convert each reaction cumulative signed mass ledger to signed transferred volume using its evidence-linked caller density, distribute that volume over cells using caller-supplied cumulative per-reaction fractions at every exact time knot, and enforce unit fraction sums plus total signed-volume closure. Map the first supplied source time to elapsed geometry time zero; a nonzero source origin requires explicit review and the source-to-elapsed mapping is retained. Divide cell volume by the caller-declared combined reactive wall area and pass the resulting cellwise recession history to the existing sequential aperture remap. Require explicit reaction-to-face, cell allocation, volume conservation, area basis, cell mapping, geometry basis, equal-face (for two-face geometry) and computational-use reviews. No local current distribution, wall-reaction allocation, moving-boundary transport or physical validation is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.electrochemical_metal_loss_wall_thickness_history`

Requires a computed digest-pinned electrochemical metal-loss result and an Evidence-linked measured wall-thickness baseline at the first interval start. Every selected reaction must be represented in every interval, and each upstream exposed area must match the caller-reviewed common assessed wall area within an explicit tolerance. Gross anodic mass only is converted with the caller's Evidence-linked effective density; cathodic equivalents and signed net mass do not offset wall loss. The result reports deterministic supplied-horizon thickness margins and interval crossing brackets only; no rate extrapolation, life prediction, acceptance or probability is produced.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.electrochemical_wall_thickness_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.electrochemical_wall_thickness_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `metal_loss_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `metal_loss_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `baseline` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/ErosionCorrosionWallThicknessBaseline"}` |
| `assessed_wall_area_m2` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `effective_density_kg_m3` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `wall_area_relative_tolerance` | 예 | `{"maximum": 0.1, "minimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}` |
| `density_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

| `material_to_effective_density_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `complete_reaction_set_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `electrochemical_metal_loss_to_wall_thickness_history`: Require the computed digest-pinned electrochemical metal-loss AssessmentResult and a digest-linked measured wall-thickness baseline at the first interval start, matching asset, location, physical scope and material condition. Require complete reaction-set review and every selected branch area to agree with the caller's common assessed wall area within an explicit tolerance. Sum gross anodic mass across the selected reactions, divide by evidence-linked caller effective density and reviewed wall area, and subtract each interval increment from the baseline thickness. Cathodic equivalents and signed net mass do not offset wall loss. Report deterministic thickness margins over supplied intervals and a first-crossing interval bracket only; do not interpolate within-interval time, extrapolate corrosion, predict life, decide acceptance or assign probability.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.electrochemical_partial_current_metal_loss`

A digest-pinned computed mixed-potential history is required; branch electron number and exposed area are read from that exact upstream request. Partial current is integrated using an exact trapezoidal integral under an explicit piecewise-linear between-knot review. Metal mapping, anodic dissolution direction, alloy basis and uniform area-average recession are caller-reviewed inputs; cathodic-equivalent and signed net quantities remain separately visible.

구현 근거:

- `electrochemical_partial_current_to_metal_loss`: Require a computed digest-pinned mixed-potential history and caller-reviewed metal-dissolution mapping for each selected reaction. Integrate each upstream reference-area current-density branch with the exact trapezoid integral under a declared piecewise-linear between-knot reconstruction. Divide charge by the upstream reaction electron number and Faraday constant, apply the caller metal-atom stoichiometric factor and evidence-linked molar mass, then divide signed mass change by caller density and actual mapped branch area for a uniform area-average recession. Report anodic and cathodic equivalents separately from signed net transfer. This implements Faraday charge-to-reaction accounting only; it does not validate current kinetics, alloy selectivity, completeness of selected dissolution reactions, local attack, evolving geometry or corrosion qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.electrochemical_wall_flux_schedule`

The upstream metal-loss ledger is digest-pinned and only anodic metal removal is mapped. Uniform distribution over transport cells is a caller-reviewed approximation; changing surface geometry need not preserve the original total ledger.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.electrochemical_wall_flux_schedule.v1", "default": "matintegrity.electrochemical_wall_flux_schedule.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `metal_loss_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |

| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `local_only_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `interval_support_s` | `s` |
| `wall_flux` | `mol/m2/s` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_electrochemical_metal_loss_wall_flux_schedule`: Translate a complete digest-pinned electrochemical metal-loss assessment into contiguous interval anodic-metal flux densities using the common reviewed exposure area, elapsed-time origin and caller-reviewed uniform cell mapping. Preserve reaction/species identity and exact support. The upstream global ledger need not be conserved under moving geometry; no electrochemical feedback, local distribution or wall-loss law is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.electrochemical_wall_thickness_scenario_envelope`

Consumes only complete digest-pinned computed wall-thickness history AssessmentResults on one common physical/material scope and measured baseline. Every scenario must share the exact ordered time knots and required-thickness history; scenario dependence is preserved by evaluating complete rows. Knotwise extrema over the finite supplied set are deterministic pointwise bounds only. No scenario probability, weighting, temporal interpolation or continuous parameter bound is inferred.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.electrochemical_wall_thickness_scenario_envelope.v1", "default": "matintegrity.electrochemical_wall_thickness_scenario_envelope.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `asset_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `location_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `time_basis` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `material_condition_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `baseline_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `baseline_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `scenario_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `scenario_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `scenarios_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `scenarios` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/ElectrochemicalWallThicknessScenario"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `scenario_evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `usage_rights_evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `usage_license_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `complete_scenario_set_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `joint_scenario_dependence_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `baseline_and_scope_match_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `usage_rights_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `knotwise_extrema[].time_s` | `s` |
| `knotwise_extrema[].minimum_remaining_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `knotwise_extrema[].maximum_remaining_thickness_m` | `m` |
| `knotwise_extrema[].minimum_margin_m` | `m` |
| `knotwise_extrema[].maximum_margin_m` | `m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 계산기는 선행 AssessmentResult를 받아 구성하는 모델이어서 독립 JSON 입력 대신 registry 실행을 포함한 합성 Python wiring example `examples/electrochemical_wall_thickness_scenario_envelope.py`를 제공한다. 예제 입력은 구조 연결 설명용 합성값이며 물성 검증 자료가 아니다.

구현 근거:

- `electrochemical_metal_loss_wall_thickness_finite_scenario_envelope`: Require a finite ordered manifest of computed digest-pinned electrochemical wall-thickness AssessmentResults. Enforce matching asset/location/time basis, physical and material scope, measured baseline identity/digest, required-thickness history and exact ordered time knots. Report per-knot minima/maxima of remaining thickness and limit-state margin with separate scenario witnesses, retaining every scenario result/input/projection digest. The extrema apply only to the complete caller-supplied finite scenario set; no scenario weights, probabilities, interpolation, continuous bound, first-passage event, remaining-life forecast or acceptance decision is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.external_crevice_solver_receipt`

An external solver receipt must match the pinned aperture history, cell mesh, face ordering, SI units, axial sign and exact time knots. Only caller-reviewed piecewise-linear interpolation inside the receipt clock is exposed; no extrapolation or solver validation is performed.

Bind every pressure/velocity knot to a digest-pinned aperture-history state and reject extrapolation, mismatched mesh dimensions or unreviewed face orientation. Expose reviewed piecewise-linear interpolation of face velocity as a callable for the existing restricted-transport consumer and preserve the provider/configuration digest. This is an exchange adapter, not a CFD solver or validation of its numerical method or accuracy.

## `integration.external_flange_compliance_history`

Every caller-declared knot is paired with a digest-verified external FE stiffness receipt using a stable provider revision, asset scope and ordered translational contact mapping. The adapter reduces each supplied matrix independently; it does not infer receipt timestamps, interpolate matrices, solve FE, model nonlinear contact or qualify sealing.

| `history_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `times_s` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "number"}, "maxItems": 1000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |

| `symmetry_relative_tolerance` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-10, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "maximum": 1e-05, "type": "number"}` |
| `minimum_positive_stiffness_eigenvalue_N_m` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1e-12, "exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_free_operator_condition_number` | 아니오 | `{"default": 1000000000000.0, "maximum": 100000000000000.0, "minimum": 1, "type": "number"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `times_s` | `s` |
| `operator_history[].values.flange_relative_compliance_matrix_m_N` | `m/N` |

## `integration.external_flange_compliance_receipt`

A digest-pinned finite-element receipt must identify the selected load case, mesh, coordinate frame, stiffness result field, explicit translational DOF map and contact-normal signs before reduction. This interface consumes an already reduced incremental stiffness matrix; it does not assemble/solve FE, transform mixed rotational DOFs, model nonlinear gasket response or qualify sealing.

## `integration.external_flange_diagnostic_screen`

Criteria and uncertainty comparisons are caller-owned and evidence-backed. A passing diagnostic screen is not FE solver qualification, physical acceptance or seal qualification.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `receipt` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/StructuralProviderResultReceipt"}` |
| `criteria` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/FlangeDiagnosticCriterion"}, "maxItems": 100, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `receipt_diagnostics_applicability_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `criteria[].maximum_absolute_value_plus_uncertainty` | `caller-defined metric unit` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_external_flange_diagnostic_screen`: Compare digest-pinned provider-reported FE diagnostics with caller-defined, evidence-backed limits after exact metric/category/definition/unit matching and review of uncertainty comparability. A result is a diagnostic screen only; it is not structural solver qualification, physical acceptance or seal qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.external_gasket_fe_field_import`

The adapter validates caller-supplied field metadata, array digests, direct location mapping, support data and exact solver-step time bindings against a structural provider receipt. It preserves only selected pressure, force, gap, compression and stress-tensor fields; it does not solve FE equations, interpolate fields or infer acceptance criteria. Pressure-to-force multiplication is used only when the caller supplies tributary area and reviews that lumped projection basis.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.external_gasket_fe_field_import.v1", "default": "matintegrity.external_gasket_fe_field_import.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `joint_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `physical_scope_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `provider_component_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `run_context` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/RunContext"}` |
| `node_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `gasket_contact_area_m2` | 예 | `{"items": {"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `contact_locations` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketFEContactLocation"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `field_selections` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketFEFieldSelection"}, "maxItems": 32, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `snapshots` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketFEContactSnapshot"}, "maxItems": 1000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `geometry_source_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_usage_license_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `geometry_evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `coordinate_and_contact_area_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `exact_solver_step_to_time_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `field_quantity_frame_and_unit_mapping_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `provider_field_array_normalization_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `history[].time_s` | `s` |
| `history[].response_field[].contact_force_N` | `N` |
| `history[].response_field[].mean_contact_pressure_Pa` | `Pa` |
| `history[].response_field[].contact_area_m2` | `m^2` |
| `history[].response_field[].contact_gap_m` | `m` |
| `history[].response_field[].gasket_compression_m` | `m` |
| `history[].response_field[].gasket_stress_components_Pa` | `Pa` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_finite_element_gasket_field_receipt_and_normalized_arrays`: Caller-authorized provider receipt, selected normalized FE arrays and exact provider digests.
- `caller_mesh_contact_location_area_and_coordinate_mapping`: Caller-mapped mesh nodes, contact areas, frames and direct one-to-one result locations.
- `caller_solver_step_time_and_support_boundary_records`: Caller-bound FE solver-step time and optional explicit support observations; no hidden interpolation.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.findley_miner_ordered_block_history`

Every block carries a computed, digest-consistent calibrated Findley life result for one shared asset, location and material condition. The caller supplies exact block order and explicitly reviews a linear cumulative damage rule with no sequence interaction. The calculation covers only the supplied finite cycle sequence and does not extrapolate remaining life or infer probability.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.findley_miner_block_history.v1", "default": "matintegrity.findley_miner_block_history.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `blocks` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/FindleyLifeCycleBlock"}, "maxItems": 10000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `damage_threshold` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `ordered_blocks_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `shared_asset_location_material_condition_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `linear_damage_rule_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `no_sequence_interaction_assumed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `total_supplied_cycles` | `cycle` |
| `cumulative_damage` | `1` |
| `damage_threshold` | `1` |
| `block_results[].cycles_to_failure` | `cycle` |
| `block_results[].damage_increment` | `1` |
| `first_threshold_crossing_in_supplied_sequence.cycle_count_at_crossing_in_supplied_sequence` | `cycle` |
| `first_threshold_crossing_in_supplied_sequence.cycle_offset_within_block` | `cycle` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_findley_life_to_ordered_miner_block_history`: For each caller-ordered cycle block, require a computed canonical-input-digest-consistent calibrated Findley life result with matching asset, location, time basis and material-condition identity. Under explicit caller review of linear damage, exact block order and absence of sequence interaction, sum cycles divided by the corresponding life over only the finite supplied sequence and bracket the first integer cycle crossing of the caller threshold. Preserve each result digest and return no probability, extrapolated remaining life, acceptance or qualification.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.fixed_fugacity_carbonate_to_scale_kinetics`

Use the exact computed fixed-fugacity carbonate history CO3 concentration, multiply by a caller-provided activity coefficient under the declared 1 mol/L standard state, add explicitly supplied activities for all other candidate-solid species, and screen one caller-selected phase with per-knot Ksp records. Every temperature/Ksp point must match an exact carbonate history knot; no thermodynamic constant or activity coefficient is inferred or interpolated. Only after all saturation screens compute, transfer their positive finite saturation ratios at exact time knots to the existing caller surface-scale law, which linearly reconstructs saturation only under its explicit review. No phase discovery, saturation equilibrium beyond the selected candidate, kinetic-coefficient derivation, corrosion/protection prediction or qualification is provided.

## `integration.gasket_fe_von_mises_caller_limit_screen`

Six imported symmetric Cauchy stress components in one caller-mapped Cartesian frame are reduced by the J2/von Mises invariant. The computed scalar is compared with an explicitly supplied evidence-bound caller limit at one declared material state and temperature. ## `integration.gasket_joint_spatial_resultant_balance`

Only exact-knot per-bolt forces from one computed multi-bolt joint result are reconciled with one computed static unilateral contact field. Planar moment arms are caller-evidenced coordinates relative to one named reference center; Mx=Σ(yF), My=−Σ(xF) for declared force magnitudes. External moment values and their sign convention are caller-supplied and digest-bound; upstream scalar separating force is used exactly once. Finite-node contact-area fraction and nodal pressure resultants are descriptors of the supplied mesh/discretization, not continuous-field integrals. Residual tolerance indicators are descriptive; no seal acceptance, local stress, leakage, code compliance, life or probability is inferred.

## `integration.gasket_leakage_pressure_inventory_decay`

Gas inventory follows a fixed-volume isothermal ideal-gas equation of state. Molar leak rate is evaluated from the caller's bilinear gasket calibration and linearly interpolated contact-pressure history. Contact pressures and downstream absolute pressure are prescribed; they do not change with gas inventory pressure.

Runtime 의존성: `scipy` 이름으로 실행 시점에 Python callable/provider를 주입한다. 해당 provider 객체는 JSON 입력에 포함되지 않으며, 입력 계약에 기록한 provider ID·revision·configuration/record digest와 Evidence가 실행계보를 식별한다.

| `leakage_history` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/GasketLeakageHistory"}` |
| `gas_volume_m3` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `gas_temperature_K` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `downstream_absolute_pressure_Pa` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `initial_upstream_absolute_pressure_Pa` | 예 | `{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `inventory_record_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `usage_license_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_gasket_leak_calibration_map`: Caller-supplied calibrated gasket leakage relation with declared conditions and provenance.
- `caller_gasket_contact_pressure_history`: Caller-supplied contact-pressure history that remains externally prescribed during the gas-inventory calculation.
- `caller_gasket_gas_inventory_volume_temperature_pressure`: Caller-supplied fixed gas volume, isothermal temperature and initial/downstream pressure record.
- `ideal_gas_inventory_balance_with_calibrated_leakage`: Fixed-volume isothermal ideal-gas inventory balance driven by a caller-calibrated leakage relation; no pressure-dependent gasket feedback is inferred.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.gasket_leakage_rate_threshold_events`

The source must be a digest-pinned computed gasket leakage history with explicit mol/s and s units. Excursion intervals use only caller-reviewed piecewise-linear interpolation between source knots. Thresholds are caller-owned comparison criteria and do not establish leak-tightness, acceptance, failure or probability.

입력 필드:

| `minimum_rate_mol_s` | 예 | `{"minimum": 0, "type": "number"}` |
| `maximum_rate_mol_s` | 아니오 | `{"anyOf": [{"exclusiveMinimum": 0, "type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null}` |
| `threshold_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |

구현 근거:

- `caller_gasket_leakage_rate_threshold`: Compare a computed digest-pinned caller-calibrated gasket leakage history with caller-provided lower and optional upper rate thresholds, preserving threshold provenance, Evidence, computational-use rights, units, context and reconstruction review. Locate threshold excursions only for the supplied piecewise-linear rate path and report finite time intervals/censoring; this is a conditional event summary, not seal acceptance, failure probability or qualification.

## `integration.gasket_leakage_scenario_exposure`

Only a digest-pinned computed finite correlated leakage scenario snapshot is accepted. Molar leak rate is multiplied by an explicit duration under a caller-reviewed constant-state assumption; no transient state or probability is inferred.

| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

## `integration.gasket_leakage_scenario_rate_interval`

Only two digest-pinned computed envelopes with identical joint/scenario/calibration identity and node order are accepted. Each matched scenario rate is integrated with a trapezoid that is exact for the explicitly reviewed linear-in-time rate reconstruction; no scenario probability or unsampled transient bound is inferred.

| `time_window_and_basis_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

## `integration.gasket_temperature_compression_joint_history`

Every load step uses the same caller bolt preloads/stiffnesses and sector data with its exact temperature-specific interpolated gasket curve. A single axial opening balances tension-only bolt springs, compression-only gasket sectors and caller separating load at each knot. The first step must balance initial preload against gasket force at initial compression; thermal shifts and external separating force are caller inputs thereafter.

## `integration.gasket_thermoelastic_expansion_joint_history`

Each component's free thermal change is its reference dimension times expm1 of the exact piecewise-linear integral of instantaneous alpha(T), interpreted as logarithmic strain. The calculated thermal shifts are passed into the existing temperature-interpolated quasi-static joint equilibrium at matching exact time/temperature knots. No thermal gradient, residual thermal stress, temperature extrapolation, hysteresis or material qualification is inferred.

구현 근거:

- `caller_bolt_and_gasket_sector_cte_temperature_tables`: Caller-supplied component-specific CTE(T) values with Evidence and temperature support for the identified bolt and gasket sectors.
- `caller_component_effective_free_dimensions_and_reference_temperature`: Caller-supplied effective free length/thickness dimensions and reference temperature for thermal strain conversion.
- `piecewise_linear_cte_thermal_strain_integral`: Independent trapezoidal integration of piecewise-linear CTE data over a bounded temperature interval; no out-of-range extrapolation.
- `temperature_dependent_bolt_gasket_joint_equilibrium`: Thermal expansion adapter that passes computed free dimensional changes to the existing caller temperature-curve joint solver.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.multi_bolt_joint_to_flange_contact_request`

Bolt force comes from a digest-pinned computed multi-bolt equilibrium AssessmentResult at one exact named knot. Bolt-to-node closure influence is a caller-supplied linear operator ordered by explicit bolt and flange contact-node identities. The base free-closure vector must exclude the exact bolt set represented by the influence matrix; the two contributions are superposed once. The output is a new typed FlangeContactFieldRequest. The downstream flange solver checks compliance support/symmetry/positive-semidefinite conditions and unilateral contact equilibrium. No FE response, local stress, leakage, seal acceptance, or qualification is provided.

입력 필드:

| 필드 | 필수 | 타입·제약 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 아니오 | `{"const": "matintegrity.multi_bolt_flange_contact_influence.v1", "default": "matintegrity.multi_bolt_flange_contact_influence.v1", "type": "string"}` |
| `assessment_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `bolt_load_result` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/AssessmentResult"}` |
| `bolt_load_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `selected_step_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `contact_template` | 예 | `{"$ref": "#/$defs/FlangeContactFieldRequest"}` |
| `bolt_ids` | 예 | `{"items": {"type": "string"}, "maxItems": 256, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `bolt_to_node_closure_matrix_m_N` | 예 | `{"items": {"items": {"type": "number"}, "type": "array"}, "maxItems": 256, "minItems": 2, "type": "array"}` |
| `influence_provider_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `influence_provider_revision` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `influence_configuration_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `influence_result_sha256` | 예 | `{"pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$", "type": "string"}` |
| `influence_usage_license_id` | 예 | `{"minLength": 1, "type": "string"}` |
| `influence_evidence` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Evidence"}, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `bolt_step_scope_and_lineage_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `bolt_order_to_operator_column_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `free_closure_excludes_declared_bolt_set_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `linear_operator_superposition_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `computational_use_authorized` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |

출력 단위:

| 필드 | 단위 |
|---|---|
| `selected_time_s` | `s` |
| `bolt_force_by_id_N` | `N` |
| `bolt_closure_contribution_by_node_m` | `m` |
| `total_free_closure_by_node_m` | `m` |
| `contact_request.free_closure_without_gasket_m` | `m` |
| `contact_request.flange_relative_compliance_matrix_m_N` | `m/N` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_multi_bolt_to_spatial_flange_contact_influence`: Apply a caller-provided, digest-pinned linear bolt-force-to-contact-node closure operator to the selected exact multi-bolt equilibrium knot, then compose it once with reviewed non-bolt free closure. No FE response, local stress or leakage is generated.
- `caller_spatial_flange_contact_compliance`: Solve a nodal unilateral contact complementarity problem from a caller-supplied symmetric positive-semidefinite relative flange compliance matrix, caller-composed free-closure vector, and local linear gasket stiffnesses. The active-set method requires nonnegative contact forces and gaps, checks the matrix support and preserves each provider result digest. It consumes but does not calculate the flange compliance operator, infer bolt/load composition, reconstruct local stress, predict leakage or establish sealing acceptance.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.tube_bundle_lame_stress_history`

Each tube is modeled as a homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic annular cylinder using the caller's current inner diameter and minimum wall. Internal and external absolute pressures are nonnegative, share one caller-reviewed Pa reference, and are evaluated only at exact supplied knots. The caller declares the axial end condition; plugged-tube pressure paths require a separate explicit review. Stress descriptors are not code acceptance, pressure capacity, remaining life, or qualification results.

No pressure capacity, code acceptance or remaining life is inferred.

## `integration.wet_co2_carbonate_transport_boundary_history`

The input must be a complete computed fixed-fugacity carbonate history or digest-bound Henry-carbonate adapter history. Every knot needs a source-pinned partition provider and Evidence; the exact point digest, solvent composition digest, temperature and corrected Henry record lineage are retained. Only the seven explicit carbonate/water boundary species are returned in mol/m3; unresolved ions, charge balance and full aqueous composition are not inferred. A complete history is mapped only when all exact knots pass; no interpolation or extrapolation is performed.

| `boundary_partitions` | 예 | `{"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/CarbonateBoundaryPartitionUse"}, "maxItems": 20000, "minItems": 1, "type": "array"}` |
| `history_clock_and_boundary_selection_reviewed` | 예 | `{"type": "boolean"}` |
| `maximum_point_mappings` | 아니오 | `{"default": 20000, "maximum": 20000, "minimum": 1, "type": "integer"}` |

| `temperature_K_history` | `K` |
| `concentration_mol_m3_history` | `mol/m3` |
| `history_point_count` | `count` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

구현 근거:

Preserve exact-knot order and digests; perform no temporal interpolation or full aqueous speciation.
- `caller_reviewed_co2star_partition_and_water_concentration`: Treat hydrate partition and water concentration as externally supplied, reviewed boundary composition inputs with source digest and license lineage. The adapter converts declared mol/L carbonate species into mol/m3 without inferring equilibrium constants or unreported ions.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.wet_co2_condensate_film_history`

The caller flux is the net retained water source per actual fixed wall-patch area, including condensation, evaporation, drainage and retention effects. Net flux and liquid density are constant within each exact time interval. Film areal inventory is nonnegative; a requested negative flux is clipped at dryout and excess sink request is reported separately. Equivalent thickness assumes spatially uniform full coverage and does not represent resolved droplets or surface morphology.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_aqueous_scale_sink_feedback`

Caller owns phase identity, stoichiometry, intrinsic phase flux law, and geometry inputs. Caller phase flux and geometry data are left-held on exact knots; no intra-knot chemistry or phase-selection law is inferred. Scale reaction source/sink terms are inserted in the same interval BDF RHS as the BV transport terms and are limited by shared cylindrical reactant supply. The bounded outer iteration is not a thermodynamic phase-selection, validated corrosion-life, or qualification model. Independent carrier ions, pH/speciation and gas equilibria are not solved unless supplied as transported species and caller flux histories.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_bv_wall_recession`

Integrated reaction extents and explicit aqueous elemental stoichiometry determine the alloy-element release per unit axial length. A uniform axisymmetric alloy with fixed caller density is mapped to bore radius by exact annular volume conservation at aligned knots. The mapping supports recession only and must agree with the separately supplied geometry history within a caller tolerance. The result replays one spatial mixed-potential calculation; it does not iterate electrochemistry on the newly generated geometry.

The caller supplies all state, thermodynamic, kinetics, stoichiometry, transport and diffusivity records. Only the selected solid's per-axial-metre inventory is iterated; wall recession and other phase inventories are fixed. - `caller_cylindrical_geometry_iteration_seed`: Caller-supplied initial geometry state used as the bounded replay seed.
- `bounded_picard_replay_of_caller_transport_saturation_and_scale_growth`: Fixed-order bounded Picard replay with per-knot inventory residual gates; it is sequential composition, not a monolithic multiphysics solver.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_finite_gas_stage_geometry_feedback`

Caller transfer, mass-action, BV and scale laws remain fixed/evidence-bound. The cylindrical radius is recalculated from live wall release and phase inventory at each BDF evaluation. A Lagrangian radial mesh conserves cell molar inventories as bore geometry changes; caller must review this mesh-motion assumption. Schema v2 is opt-in and requires an exact-knot caller shear law; detached solids are exported, excluded from aqueous source terms, and included in scale/global element closure. The gas, aqueous, scale and wall source ledgers close by element; this does not establish empirical validity.

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_mass_action_activities_for_stage_scale_kinetics`: Uses the caller's fixed, evidence-bound aqueous reaction network and standard states to provide activities to the selected scale kinetic law.
- `multireactant_cylindrical_supply_and_inventory_limiter_at_bdf_stages`: Shared cylindrical reactant-supply and live-solid-inventory limiter reevaluated at each BDF stage.
- `aqueous_mass_action_recomputed_from_stage_wall_composition`: Rebuilds caller linear component totals from each BDF-stage wall-cell molar composition and re-solves the declared log-activity mass-action system; no species or reaction topology is inferred.
- `caller_finite_gas_cylindrical_two_film_transfer_and_inventory`: Uses caller-evidenced fixed-capacity gas inventory, Henry relation, interfacial area and two-film coefficients for cylindrical stage coupling.
- `finite_gas_aqueous_bv_scale_element_balance`: Balances finite gas, aqueous species, scale phases, wall release and external radial exchange by element at each interval.
- `caller_finite_gas_inventory_initial_state`: Pins the initial finite-gas fugacity and capacity to caller-provided licensed evidence.
- `finite_gas_and_outer_liquid_stage_inventory_flux_limit`: Limits each BDF-stage two-film transfer rate by available finite gas or outer radial-cell liquid inventory over the interval remainder.
- `same_stage_cylindrical_radius_from_wall_and_scale_inventories`: Recomputes cylindrical bore and steel inner radii algebraically from current BDF-stage wall release and scale phase inventories.
- `lagrangian_radial_mesh_conserved_cell_inventory_transport`: Advances radial-cell molar inventories on a caller-reviewed Lagrangian mesh while the cylindrical inner boundary evolves.
- `caller_wall_shear_history`: Caller supplies licensed, digest-pinned wall-shear stress values at exact cylindrical geometry time knots.
- `caller_calibrated_shear_scale_detachment_law`: Caller supplies a digest-pinned threshold power law for scale detachment velocity; the implementation does not infer adhesion or detachment parameters.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_finite_gas_stage_speciation_scale_feedback`

Caller supplies a complete finite aqueous mass-action network, activity and equilibrium provider lineage, reaction formulae, natural-log Ksp and kinetic parameters with bound Evidence. Mass-action component constraints are rebuilt from stage wall concentrations and solved in log-activity coordinates at every BDF evaluation. The caller power law uses the current stage activities; radial supply, phase inventory and common geometry are bounded and updated in the coupled calculation. A caller fixed-capacity gas reservoir exchanges one declared neutral carbon-bearing aqueous species through caller-supplied Henry and two-film data at the outer radial cell.

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `caller_cylindrical_liquid_transfer_capacity_history`: Require the exact digest-pinned cylindrical wall-to-bulk transfer-capacity result and preserve its species, interval, geometry and hydraulics lineage.
- `caller_cylindrical_geometry_history`: Use the exact caller-provided cylindrical geometry knots as the time and wetted-area basis; no corrosion or deposition geometry is inferred.
- `caller_cylindrical_hydraulics_history`: Require the exact digest-pinned single-phase hydraulic knots used by the upstream transfer-capacity result.
- `caller_bulk_wall_liquid_concentration_records`: Caller supplies digest-pinned bulk and wall compartment concentrations and finite liquid volumes at every aligned knot, with licensed evidence.
- `caller_bulk_wall_external_inventory_exchange_records`: Caller supplies signed licensed external species inventory changes per interval for each liquid compartment; no gas/liquid reaction source is inferred.
- `finite_two_compartment_liquid_transfer_balance`: Convert an upstream per-segment transfer conductance and caller bulk-wall concentration difference into left-held signed molar exchange between finite liquid compartments, add explicit external inventory increments, and fail closed when either compartment inventory becomes negative or the closure residual exceeds tolerance. This is bookkeeping, not a mass-transfer or reaction model.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_geometry_coupled_history`

Each outer iteration reruns the transient cylindrical finite-volume species balance and common BV mixed potential on a candidate exact-knot geometry path. Wall elemental release is accumulated from the declared aqueous reaction stoichiometry and alloy inventory; target radius follows annular mass-volume balance with caller density. Caller scale phase inventories are fixed at their declared exact knots during all iterations; scale chemistry, precipitation kinetics and morphology are not solved. Geometry and wall-element residuals must pass the declared fixed-point tolerances and a final ordinary strict spatial solve. No interpolation between caller knots, field extrapolation, independent experimental validation, or design-life qualification is provided.

| `final_spatial_result.history[].mixed_potential_at_interval_end_V` | `V` |
| `final_spatial_result.interval_ledger[].reaction_extent_mol_m.*` | `mol/m` |

API 실행용 합성 입력:

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `bounded_picard_replay_of_spatial_bv_transport_and_cylindrical_recession`: Iterate an independently implemented, exact-knot radial finite-volume aqueous transport and caller-calibrated Butler-Volmer response against cylindrical steel-surface recession. Reconstruct the bore from the caller-fixed scale inventory, require per-element wall inventory and radius residual closure, then rerun the ordinary strict geometry balance. The bounded Picard method does not update scale chemistry or kinetics and has no independent physical qualification.
- `independent_transient_cylindrical_finite_volume_electrochemical_inventory`: Independently assemble a radial finite-volume transient species inventory over exact caller geometry knots, couple reviewed caller Butler–Volmer branches through a shared zero-current potential, and remap inventories across moving cylindrical geometry with explicit species, aqueous element/charge, wall-element and circuit closure ledgers. No reaction kinetics, thermodynamic property table, calibration or corrosion qualification is bundled.
- `caller_calibrated_butler_volmer_reaction_set`: Evaluate caller-calibrated anodic and cathodic Butler-Volmer branches at exact boundary temperature, with caller-defined reaction direction, electron count, species stoichiometry and calibration support. Calibration and reaction applicability remain caller responsibility.
- `degradation.wet_co2_cylindrical_scale_geometry_history`: Registered caller-evidence-bound geometry calculation that maps metal recession and phase line inventories into exact-knot cylindrical radii, layer thicknesses, areas and wetted perimeter.
- `caller_wet_co2_scale_phase_molar_volume`: Caller-provided phase molar volumes and evidence for line-inventory to cylindrical scale-volume conversion.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_geometry_fixed_point_controller`

A caller-owned runtime solver or bundled spatial-BV adapter must recompute declared physics for each supplied exact-knot radius path. The controller checks target radii and wall-element inventory residuals; its spatial adapter derives them from the bounded BV calculation. Damped Picard iteration is bounded by caller-selected iteration and tolerance limits; no convergence is claimed unless both geometry and inventory gates pass. The model is a coupling controller and does not supply chemistry, transport, electrochemical kinetics, empirical parameters, or corrosion qualification.

Runtime 의존성: `candidate_solver` 이름으로 실행 시점에 Python callable/provider를 주입한다. 해당 provider 객체는 JSON 입력에 포함되지 않으며, 입력 계약에 기록한 provider ID·revision·configuration/record digest와 Evidence가 실행계보를 식별한다.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_scale_recession_feedback`

Every outer iteration recalculates spatial BV transport, phase saturation and wall kinetics, multilayer cylindrical diffusion supply, phase inventory and common wall geometry. Phase kinetic and diffusion paths use caller-declared, independently reviewed transport inputs on identical exact geometry knots. Precipitation/dissolution inventory uses left-held flux and the corresponding left-knot cylinder area; scale inventory is not added as an aqueous reaction sink in the BV transport solve. The outer relaxed iteration is bounded and followed by a final strict metal wall geometry closure solve; no contraction or uniqueness guarantee is claimed. All phase selection, activity, solubility, kinetic coefficients, reactant supply mapping, alloy composition and cylindrical assumptions are caller supplied.

이 모델의 검토된 독립 합성 입력은 아직 `examples/model_inputs.json`에 없다. 위 입력 스키마를 사용하되, 모델별 prerequisite와 Evidence를 직접 구성한다.

구현 근거:

- `bounded_feedback_of_caller_scale_kinetics_diffusion_supply_and_bv_recession`: Iterate the registered cylindrical spatial BV/recession solver with caller wall-saturation kinetics, exact annular multilayer diffusion supply, phase inventory updates and cylindrical geometry. Saturation kinetics/transport and BV transport remain separate caller calculations; scale precipitation is not inserted as an aqueous sink in the BV ODE.
- `independent_transient_cylindrical_finite_volume_electrochemical_inventory`: Independently assemble a radial finite-volume transient species inventory over exact caller geometry knots, couple reviewed caller Butler–Volmer branches through a shared zero-current potential, and remap inventories across moving cylindrical geometry with explicit species, aqueous element/charge, wall-element and circuit closure ledgers. No reaction kinetics, thermodynamic property table, calibration or corrosion qualification is bundled.
- `caller_cylindrical_transient_species_history_for_wall_saturation`: Caller-paired transient cylindrical wall-adjacent concentration history at exact chemistry knots.
- `caller_wet_co2_wall_saturation_scale_kinetics_result`: Caller-provided digest-bound saturation and scale-kinetics result at aligned cylindrical geometry knots.
- `caller_cylindrical_phase_solution_diffusivity_records`: Caller-supplied per-phase and solution-film diffusivity values with evidence and exact species mapping.
- `cylindrical_multilayer_radial_diffusion_resistance`: Independent sum of exact logarithmic radial Fick resistances across caller annular layers and solution film.
- `independent_cylindrical_annular_scale_inventory_volume_closure`: Map exact-knot caller-selected solid line inventory through its evidence-bound molar volume into the cylindrical annular volume used by radial transport and steel-recession geometry.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_stage_speciation_scale_feedback`

Caller supplies a complete finite aqueous mass-action network, activity and equilibrium provider lineage, reaction formulae, natural-log Ksp and kinetic parameters with bound Evidence. Optionally, a caller-supplied, evidence-bound Davies A parameter and water-mass conversion are iterated self-consistently with each BDF-stage wall-composition mass-action solve; Davies support and single-liquid limits are enforced. Alternatively, a caller-supplied, evidence-bound SIT parameter/interaction set can be iterated at each BDF stage; its embedded aqueous template must exactly match the fixed stage-speciation template and only one optional activity model may be selected. Schema v4 or v5 enables caller-supplied, evidence-bound B-dot parameters at each BDF stage; the embedded aqueous template must exactly match, and activity modes are mutually exclusive. Schema v5 optionally applies exact-knot caller shear and per-phase evidence-bound threshold detachment within the BDF phase-inventory state; detached solid is recorded as an element export, not returned to the aqueous solution. Mass-action component constraints are rebuilt from stage wall concentrations and solved in log-activity coordinates at every BDF evaluation. The caller power law uses the current stage activities; radial supply, phase inventory and common geometry are bounded and updated in the coupled calculation.

구현 근거:

- `caller_mass_action_activities_for_stage_scale_kinetics`: Uses the caller's fixed, evidence-bound aqueous reaction network and standard states to provide activities to the selected scale kinetic law.
- `multireactant_cylindrical_supply_and_inventory_limiter_at_bdf_stages`: Shared cylindrical reactant-supply and live-solid-inventory limiter reevaluated at each BDF stage.
- `aqueous_mass_action_recomputed_from_stage_wall_composition`: Rebuilds caller linear component totals from each BDF-stage wall-cell molar composition and re-solves the declared log-activity mass-action system; no species or reaction topology is inferred.
- `caller_general_aqueous_mass_action_speciation`: Solve a caller-defined square single-phase aqueous network in natural-log dimensionless activities. Use caller-supplied fixed activity coefficients and temperature-matched log10 equilibrium constants; solve caller-provided linear species amount and/or charge constraints after normalization by declared positive scales. A damped Newton method with finite-range checks and line search returns species activities, concentrations, balance closure, reaction residuals and full input/provider digests only within the declared tolerance. At a computed root, solve the converged Jacobian for implicit local derivatives of log activities and concentrations with respect to each log10(K), constraint target and fixed ln(gamma), without finite differencing. If explicitly reviewed, propagate a finite symmetric positive-semidefinite caller parameter covariance through those derivatives using first-order JΣJᵀ; condition and finite checks can make sensitivities unavailable while preserving the equilibrium result. No automatic electroneutrality, ionic-strength iteration, water balance, gas/solid phase, precipitation, kinetics, corrosion, or acceptance is inferred.
- [USGS PHREEQC 3 documentation: Davies activity-coefficient model](https://water.usgs.gov/water-resources/software/PHREEQC/documentation/phreeqc3-html/phreeqc3-50.htm) (`usgs_phreeqc_davies_activity_coefficients`)
- [USGS WSP 2254: Davies approximation for aqueous activity coefficients](https://pubs.usgs.gov/wsp/wsp2254/pdf/wsp2254a.pdf) (`usgs_davies_ionic_strength_approximation`)
- `molality_to_molarity_activity_standard_state_bridge`: Map a molality-standard-state coefficient to a molarity-standard-state coefficient by equating the same dimensionless activity: gamma_c*c/(1 mol/L) = gamma_m*m/(1 mol/kg-water), with m=c/w and caller-supplied w in kg-water/L-solution, giving gamma_c=gamma_m/w. Require review of the water-mass conversion and standard-state mapping, preserve both coefficients, and fail closed outside finite numeric range. This algebraic basis does not infer solution water content or validate an activity model.
- [OECD Nuclear Energy Agency Thermochemical Database Project: SIT method](https://www.oecd-nea.org/upload/docs/application/pdf/2020-09/tdb2_2020-09-02_11-51-54_735.pdf) (`nea_thermochemical_database_sit_method`)
- [USGS PHREEQC 3 documentation: SIT aqueous model data block](https://water.usgs.gov/water-resources/software/PHREEQC/documentation/phreeqc3-html/phreeqc3-46.htm) (`usgs_phreeqc_sit_model_documentation`)
- [USGS PHREEQC 3 documentation: LLNL extended Debye-Huckel B-dot activity model](https://water.usgs.gov/water-resources/software/PHREEQC/documentation/phreeqc3-html/phreeqc3-26.htm) (`usgs_phreeqc_llnl_bdot_activity`)
- `caller_wall_shear_history`: Caller supplies licensed, digest-pinned wall-shear stress values at exact cylindrical geometry time knots.
- `caller_calibrated_shear_scale_detachment_law`: Caller supplies a digest-pinned threshold power law for scale detachment velocity; the implementation does not infer adhesion or detachment parameters.

`computed`는 선언된 모델의 계산 완료 상태다. 구조 안전·규격 적합·외부 실험 검증의 의미는 아니다. 중첩 입력의 전체 정의는 `describe()`의 `$defs`를 확인한다.

## `integration.wet_co2_cylindrical_steady_hydraulics`

The circular bore is represented by the exact area and wetted perimeter of the supplied geometry history. Flow is single phase, steady at each exact geometry knot and fully developed along a straight segment. Colebrook-White is solved only in turbulent support; the transitional regime is not interpolated.
